verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת שָׁאוּל וְדָוִד שָׁב מֵהַכּוֹת אֶת־הָעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בְּצִקְלָג יָמִים שְׁנָיִם׃
verses.english: It was after the death of Sha’ul—David had returned from striking the Amalek[ites]—that David stayed in Tziklag for two days.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ בָּא מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה מֵעִם שָׁאוּל וּבְגָדָיו קְרֻעִים וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיְהִי בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּפֹּל אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ׃
verses.english: And it was on the third day,that here, a man was coming from the camp, from Sha’ul,with his garments torn and earth on his head;and it was, when he came to David, that he flung himself on the ground and bowed low.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָּוִד אֵי מִזֶּה תָּבוֹא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מִמַּחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל נִמְלָטְתִּי׃
verses.english: David said to him:Where are you coming from?He said to him:From the camp of Israel have I escaped!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד מֶה־הָיָה הַדָּבָר הַגֶּד־נָא לִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֲשֶׁר־נָס הָעָם מִן־הַמִּלְחָמָה וְגַם־הַרְבֵּה נָפַל מִן־הָעָם וַיָּמֻתוּ וְגַם שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ מֵתוּ׃
verses.english: David said to him:How did the matter go? Now tell me!He said:[It was] that the fighting-people fled from the battle,and also many fell of the fighting-people, and they died;and also Sha’ul and Yehonatan his son died.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ אֵיךְ יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־מֵת שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: David said to the lad, the one telling him:How do you know that Sha’ul and Yehonatan his son are dead?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ נִקְרֹא נִקְרֵיתִי בְּהַר הַגִּלְבֹּעַ וְהִנֵּה שָׁאוּל נִשְׁעָן עַל־חֲנִיתוֹ וְהִנֵּה הָרֶכֶב וּבַעֲלֵי הַפָּרָשִׁים הִדְבִּקֻהוּ׃
verses.english: The lad, the one telling him, said:I chanced, yes, chanced upon Mount Gilboa,and here, Sha’ul was leaning on his spear,and here, the charioteers and the horsemen were pressing-him-hard.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן אַחֲרָיו וַיִּרְאֵנִי וַיִּקְרָא אֵלָי וָאֹמַר הִנֵּנִי׃
verses.english: He faced about behind him and saw me;he called out to me,and I said: Here I am.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי מִי־אָתָּה ויאמר [וָאֹמַר] אֵלָיו עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹכִי׃
verses.english: He said to me:Who are you?I said to him:I am an Amalekite.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי עֲמָד־נָא עָלַי וּמֹתְתֵנִי כִּי אֲחָזַנִי הַשָּׁבָץ כִּי־כָל־עוֹד נַפְשִׁי בִּי׃
verses.english: He said to me:Now stand over me and dispatch me,for dizziness has come upon me,though there is still life in me!

verses.hebrew: וָאֶעֱמֹד עָלָיו וַאֲמֹתְתֵהוּ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי לֹא יִחְיֶה אַחֲרֵי נִפְלוֹ וָאֶקַּח הַנֵּזֶר אֲשֶׁר עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְאֶצְעָדָה אֲשֶׁר עַל־זְרֹעוֹ וָאֲבִיאֵם אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הֵנָּה׃
verses.english: So I stood over him and dispatched him,since I knew that he could not live after his having fallen;then I took the diadem that was on his headand the bracelet that was on his arm,and have brought them to my lord here.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲזֵק דָּוִד בבגדו [בִּבְגָדָיו] וַיִּקְרָעֵם וְגַם כָּל־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃
verses.english: David took hold of his clothes and tore them,and likewise all the men that were with him;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְפְּדוּ וַיִּבְכּוּ וַיָּצֻמוּ עַד־הָעָרֶב עַל־שָׁאוּל וְעַל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וְעַל־עַם יְהוָה וְעַל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי נָפְלוּ בֶּחָרֶב׃
verses.english: they beat [the breast] and wept and fasted until sunsetover Sha’ul and over Yehonatan his son,over the fighting-people of YHWH). and over the House of Israel,since they had fallen by the sword.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַנַּעַר הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ אֵי מִזֶּה אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר בֶּן־אִישׁ גֵּר עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹכִי׃
verses.english: Then David said to the lad, the one telling him:Where are you from?He said:I am the son of a sojourner man, an Amalekite.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד אֵיךְ לֹא יָרֵאתָ לִשְׁלֹחַ יָדְךָ לְשַׁחֵת אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: David said to him:How were you not afraidto stretch out your hand to bring YHWH’s anointed one to ruin?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא דָוִד לְאַחַד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר גַּשׁ פְּגַע־בּוֹ וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיָּמֹת׃
verses.english: And David called to one of the serving-ladsand said:Approach, attack him!And he struck him down, so that he died.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו דָּוִד דמיך [דָּמְךָ] עַל־רֹאשֶׁךָ כִּי פִיךָ עָנָה בְךָ לֵאמֹר אָנֹכִי מֹתַתִּי אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: David said to him:Your blood be on your head!For your mouth bore witness against you, saying:I myself dispatched YHWH’s anointed one!

verses.hebrew: וַיְקֹנֵן דָּוִד אֶת־הַקִּינָה הַזֹּאת עַל־שָׁאוּל וְעַל־יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: Now David sang-dirge with this dirgeover Sha’ul and over Yehonatan his son,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְלַמֵּד בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה קָשֶׁת הִנֵּה כְתוּבָה עַל־סֵפֶר הַיָּשָׁר׃
verses.english: he said:To teach the Children of Judah the bow,here, it is written in the Record of the Upright:

verses.hebrew: הַצְּבִי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־בָּמוֹתֶיךָ חָלָל אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבּוֹרִים׃
verses.english: O beauty of Israel, on your heights are the slain:how have the mighty fallen!

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּגִּידוּ בְגַת אַל־תְּבַשְּׂרוּ בְּחוּצֹת אַשְׁקְלוֹן פֶּן־תִּשְׂמַחְנָה בְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים פֶּן־תַּעֲלֹזְנָה בְּנוֹת הָעֲרֵלִים׃
verses.english: Tell it not in Gat,spread not the news in Ashkelon’s streets,lest they rejoice, the daughters of the Philistines,lest they exult, the daughters of the Foreskinned Ones!

verses.hebrew: הָרֵי בַגִּלְבֹּעַ אַל־טַל וְאַל־מָטָר עֲלֵיכֶם וּשְׂדֵי תְרוּמֹת כִּי שָׁם נִגְעַל מָגֵן גִּבּוֹרִים מָגֵן שָׁאוּל בְּלִי מָשִׁיחַ בַּשָּׁמֶן׃
verses.english: O hills of Gilboa, let there be no dew, no rain upon you,or surging of the [watery] deeps for sedei terumot). ,for there lies-soiled the shield of the mighty, the shield of Sha’ul,no more anointed with oil.

verses.hebrew: מִדַּם חֲלָלִים מֵחֵלֶב גִּבּוֹרִים קֶשֶׁת יְהוֹנָתָן לֹא נָשׂוֹג אָחוֹר וְחֶרֶב שָׁאוּל לֹא תָשׁוּב רֵיקָם׃
verses.english: From the blood of the slain, from the sword of the mighty for helev, “fat.”,Yehonatan’s bow never turned back, Sha’ul’s sword never returned empty.

verses.hebrew: שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן הַנֶּאֱהָבִים וְהַנְּעִימִם בְּחַיֵּיהֶם וּבְמוֹתָם לֹא נִפְרָדוּ מִנְּשָׁרִים קַלּוּ מֵאֲרָיוֹת גָּבֵרוּ׃
verses.english: Sha’ul and Yehonatan, those beloved and delightful ones—in their lives and in their deaths they were not parted;they were swifter than eagles, they were mightier than lions!

verses.hebrew: בְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־שָׁאוּל בְּכֶינָה הַמַּלְבִּשְׁכֶם שָׁנִי עִם־עֲדָנִים הַמַּעֲלֶה עֲדִי זָהָב עַל לְבוּשְׁכֶן׃
verses.english: O daughters of Israel, weep over Sha’ul,who clothed you in scarlet together with luxuries,who with golden ornaments decked your apparel!

verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבֹּרִים בְּתוֹךְ הַמִּלְחָמָה יְהוֹנָתָן עַל־בָּמוֹתֶיךָ חָלָל׃
verses.english: How have the mighty fallen, in the midst of battle,Yehonatan slain on your heights—

verses.hebrew: צַר־לִי עָלֶיךָ אָחִי יְהוֹנָתָן נָעַמְתָּ לִּי מְאֹד נִפְלְאַתָה אַהֲבָתְךָ לִי מֵאַהֲבַת נָשִׁים׃
verses.english: I am distraught over you, my brother Yehonatan,you were very delightful to me;more wonderful was your love to methan the love of women!

verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ נָפְלוּ גִבּוֹרִים וַיֹּאבְדוּ כְּלֵי מִלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: How have the mighty fallen,yes, perished the weapons of battle!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהוָה לֵאמֹר הַאֶעֱלֶה בְּאַחַת עָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָיו עֲלֵה וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אָנָה אֶעֱלֶה וַיֹּאמֶר חֶבְרֹנָה׃
verses.english: It was [some time] after thisthat David inquired of YHWH, saying:Shall I go up into one of the towns of Judah?YHWH said to him:Go up!David said:To where shall I go up?He said:To Hevron.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל שָׁם דָּוִד וְגַם שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו אֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵלִית וַאֲבִיגַיִל אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי׃
verses.english: So David went up there,and also his two wives,Ahinoam the Yizre’elite, and Avigayil the wife of Naval the Carmelite.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנָשָׁיו אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ הֶעֱלָה דָוִד אִישׁ וּבֵיתוֹ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּעָרֵי חֶבְרוֹן׃
verses.english: As for his men who were with him, David brought them up, each one and his household,and they settled in the towns of Hevron.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אַנְשֵׁי יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ־שָׁם אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֲשֶׁר קָבְרוּ אֶת־שָׁאוּל׃
verses.english: And the men of Judah came and anointed David there as king over the House of Judah ….They told David, saying:The men of Yavesh-Gil’ad have buried Sha’ul.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם בְּרֻכִים אַתֶּם לַיהוָה אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם הַחֶסֶד הַזֶּה עִם־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם עִם־שָׁאוּל וַתִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: So David sent messengers to the men of Yavesh-Gil’ad;he said to them:Blessed are you of YHWH,in that you did this act-of-loyalty to your lord, to Sha’ul,by burying him!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יַעַשׂ־יְהוָה עִמָּכֶם חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת וְגַם אָנֹכִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אִתְּכֶם הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: So-now,may God show you loyalty and faithfulness,and I too will do this act-of-good to you,in exchange for your having done this thing!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה תֶּחֱזַקְנָה יְדֵיכֶם וִהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־חַיִל כִּי־מֵת אֲדֹנֵיכֶם שָׁאוּל וְגַם־אֹתִי מָשְׁחוּ בֵית־יְהוּדָה לְמֶלֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And now,let your hands be strengthenedand be valiant ones,for your lord Sha’ul is dead,and already it is I [whom] the House of Judah has anointed as king over them.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר שַׂר־צָבָא אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאוּל לָקַח אֶת־אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל וַיַּעֲבִרֵהוּ מַחֲנָיִם׃
verses.english: But Avner son of Ner, commander of the armed-forces that belonged to Sha’ul,had taken Ish-Boshet son of Sha’ul, and had had him cross over to Mahanayim;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּמְלִכֵהוּ אֶל־הַגִּלְעָד וְאֶל־הָאֲשׁוּרִי וְאֶל־יִזְרְעֶאל וְעַל־אֶפְרַיִם וְעַל־בִּנְיָמִן וְעַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלֹּה׃
verses.english: he had made him king over Gil’ad, over the Geshurites, and over Yizre’el,over Efrayim and over Binyamin—over Israel, all of it.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל בְּמָלְכוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנִים מָלָךְ אַךְ בֵּית יְהוּדָה הָיוּ אַחֲרֵי דָוִד׃
verses.english: Forty years old was Ish-Boshet son of Sha’ul when he began to reign as king over Israel,and for two years he reigned as king.But the House of Judah was [following] after David.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דָוִד מֶלֶךְ בְּחֶבְרוֹן עַל־בֵּית יְהוּדָה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים׃
verses.english: And the number of days that David was king in Hevron, over the House of Judah,was seven years and six months.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר וְעַבְדֵי אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל מִמַּחֲנַיִם גִּבְעוֹנָה׃
verses.english: Now Avner son of Ner went out, along with the servants of Ish-Boshet son of Sha’ul, from Mahanayim to Giv’on,

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וְעַבְדֵי דָוִד יָצְאוּ וַיִּפְגְּשׁוּם עַל־בְּרֵכַת גִּבְעוֹן יַחְדָּו וַיֵּשְׁבוּ אֵלֶּה עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה מִזֶּה וְאֵלֶּה עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה מִזֶּה׃
verses.english: while Yoav son of Tzeruya and David’s servants went out [as well].They met them by the Pool of Giv’on together,and they sat down, these by the pool on this-side,and those by the pool on that-side.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְנֵר אֶל־יוֹאָב יָקוּמוּ נָא הַנְּעָרִים וִישַׂחֲקוּ לְפָנֵינוּ וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב יָקֻמוּ׃
verses.english: Avner said to Yoav:Let the fighting-lads arise and hold-a-contest) is the same as that used in Judg. 16:25 to describe the blind Shimshon’s “providing amusement” for the Philistines; B-R translate both with “dance” (here, “do a war dance”). before us!Yoav said:Let them arise!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְמִסְפָּר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לְבִנְיָמִן וּלְאִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מֵעַבְדֵי דָוִד׃
verses.english: So they arose and crossed over by number:twelve for Binyamin and for Ish-Boshet son of Sha’ul,and twelve of David’s servants.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲזִקוּ אִישׁ בְּרֹאשׁ רֵעֵהוּ וְחַרְבּוֹ בְּצַד רֵעֵהוּ וַיִּפְּלוּ יַחְדָּו וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא חֶלְקַת הַצֻּרִים אֲשֶׁר בְּגִבְעוֹן׃
verses.english: And each one took hold of his neighbor’s head,with his sword [thrust] into his neighbor’s side,and they fell together.So that place was called: Helkat Ha-Tzurim/Field of the Sword-Edges, which is in Giv’on.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה קָשָׁה עַד־מְאֹד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּנָּגֶף אַבְנֵר וְאַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי עַבְדֵי דָוִד׃
verses.english: Now the battle was rough—exceedingly so—on that day,and Avner and the men of Israel were defeated before David’s servants.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ־שָׁם שְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה יוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי וַעֲשָׂהאֵל וַעֲשָׂהאֵל קַל בְּרַגְלָיו כְּאַחַד הַצְּבָיִם אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה׃
verses.english: Now three of the sons of Tzeruya were there: Yoav, Avishai, and Asa’el;and Asa’el was swift of feet, like one of the gazelles that is in the open-field.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדֹּף עֲשָׂהאֵל אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וְלֹא־נָטָה לָלֶכֶת עַל־הַיָּמִין וְעַל־הַשְּׂמֹאול מֵאַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר׃
verses.english: Asa’el pursued after Avner;he did not swerve to go to the right or to the left from after Avner.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן אַבְנֵר אַחֲרָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הַאַתָּה זֶה עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי׃
verses.english: But Avner faced about after himand said:Is this you, Asa’el?He said:[It is] I.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַבְנֵר נְטֵה לְךָ עַל־יְמִינְךָ אוֹ עַל־שְׂמֹאלֶךָ וֶאֱחֹז לְךָ אֶחָד מֵהַנְּעָרִים וְקַח־לְךָ אֶת־חֲלִצָתוֹ וְלֹא־אָבָה עֲשָׂהאֵל לָסוּר מֵאַחֲרָיו׃
verses.english: Avner said to him:Swerve you to your right or to your left,and seize for yourself one of our fighting-lads [instead], and take yourself his armor!But Asa’el would not turn aside from [going] after him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד אַבְנֵר לֵאמֹר אֶל־עֲשָׂהאֵל סוּר לְךָ מֵאַחֲרָי לָמָּה אַכֶּכָּה אַרְצָה וְאֵיךְ אֶשָּׂא פָנַי אֶל־יוֹאָב אָחִיךָ׃
verses.english: Once again Avner said to Asa’el:Turn you aside from [going] after me;why should I strike you to the ground—for how could I lift my face to Yoav your brother?

verses.hebrew: וַיְמָאֵן לָסוּר וַיַּכֵּהוּ אַבְנֵר בְּאַחֲרֵי הַחֲנִית אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וַתֵּצֵא הַחֲנִית מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּפָּל־שָׁם וַיָּמָת תחתו [תַּחְתָּיו] וַיְהִי כָּל־הַבָּא אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־נָפַל שָׁם עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיָּמֹת וַיַּעֲמֹדוּ׃
verses.english: But he refused to turn aside,so Avner struck him with the afterpart of the spear, in the abdomen,so that the spear came out after him;he fell there and died on the spot.And it was: all who came to the place where Asa’el had fallen and died, stopped,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדְּפוּ יוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וְהַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בָּאָה וְהֵמָּה בָּאוּ עַד־גִּבְעַת אַמָּה אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי־גִיחַ דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר גִּבְעוֹן׃
verses.english: but Yoav and Avishai pursued after Avner.Now when the sun had come in,they came to the Hill of Amma, that faces Gi’ah,on the way to the Wilderness of Giv’on.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַבְּצוּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיִּהְיוּ לַאֲגֻדָּה אֶחָת וַיַּעַמְדוּ עַל רֹאשׁ־גִּבְעָה אֶחָת׃
verses.english: And the Children of Binyamin gathered themselves [to follow] after Avner;they became a single groupand stopped at the top of a hill.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְנֵר אֶל־יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלָנֶצַח תֹּאכַל חֶרֶב הֲלוֹא יָדַעְתָּה כִּי־מָרָה תִהְיֶה בָּאַחֲרוֹנָה וְעַד־מָתַי לֹא־תֹאמַר לָעָם לָשׁוּב מֵאַחֲרֵי אֲחֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And Avner called out to Yoav;he said:Is it forever that the sword must devour?Do you not knowthat it will be bitter afterward?Until when will you not bid the fighting-people to turn back from [going] after their brothers?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב חַי הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי לוּלֵא דִּבַּרְתָּ כִּי אָז מֵהַבֹּקֶר נַעֲלָה הָעָם אִישׁ מֵאַחֲרֵי אָחִיו׃
verses.english: Yoav said:By the life of God,indeed, had you only spoken,indeed, already in the morning the people would have gone up, each one from [going] after his brother!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַע יוֹאָב בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיַּעַמְדוּ כָּל־הָעָם וְלֹא־יִרְדְּפוּ עוֹד אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא־יָסְפוּ עוֹד לְהִלָּחֵם׃
verses.english: Then Yoav gave-a-blast on the shofar: The ram’s horn, often used in the Bible for signaling., and all the people stopped;they no longer pursued after Israel,and no longer continued to do battle.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְנֵר וַאֲנָשָׁיו הָלְכוּ בָּעֲרָבָה כֹּל הַלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיֵּלְכוּ כָּל־הַבִּתְרוֹן וַיָּבֹאוּ מַחֲנָיִם׃
verses.english: Now Avner and his men went through the Plain all that night;they crossed the Jordanand went through the whole canyon, and came to Mahanayim.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב שָׁב מֵאַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת־כָּל־הָעָם וַיִּפָּקְדוּ מֵעַבְדֵי דָוִד תִּשְׁעָה־עָשָׂר אִישׁ וַעֲשָׂה־אֵל׃
verses.english: Now when Yoav returned from [going] after Avner,he gathered all the people,and there were counted-missing of David’s servants nineteen men along with Asa’el,

verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדֵי דָוִד הִכּוּ מִבִּנְיָמִן וּבְאַנְשֵׁי אַבְנֵר שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים אִישׁ מֵתוּ׃
verses.english: while David’s servants struck down some of Binyamin, among Avner’s servants—three hundred and sixty men died.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־עֲשָׂהאֵל וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּקֶבֶר אָבִיו אֲשֶׁר בֵּית לָחֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ כָל־הַלַּיְלָה יוֹאָב וַאֲנָשָׁיו וַיֵּאֹר לָהֶם בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃
verses.english: And they carried Asa’el away and buried him in the burial-place of his father, which is in Bet-Lehem.Then they went all night, Yoav and his men,with light breaking upon them in Hevron.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲרֻכָּה בֵּין בֵּית שָׁאוּל וּבֵין בֵּית דָּוִד וְדָוִד הֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק וּבֵית שָׁאוּל הֹלְכִים וְדַלִּים׃
verses.english: And the war was long-lasting between the House of Sha’ul and the House of David;David went on becoming stronger, while the House of Sha’ul went on becoming weaker.

verses.hebrew: וילדו [וַיִּוָּלְדוּ] לְדָוִד בָּנִים בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיְהִי בְכוֹרוֹ אַמְנוֹן לַאֲחִינֹעַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִת׃
verses.english: Now sons were born to David in Hevron:his firstborn was Amnon, by Ahinoam the Yezre’elite,

verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁנֵהוּ כִלְאָב לאביגל [לַאֲ‍בִיגַיִל] אֵשֶׁת נָבָל הַכַּרְמְלִי וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁי אַבְשָׁלוֹם בֶּן־מַעֲכָה בַּת־תַּלְמַי מֶלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר׃
verses.english: and his second was Kil’av, by Avigayil wife of Naval, the Carmelite,and the third was Avshalom son of Maakha, daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur,

verses.hebrew: וְהָרְבִיעִי אֲדֹנִיָּה בֶן־חַגִּית וְהַחֲמִישִׁי שְׁפַטְיָה בֶן־אֲבִיטָל׃
verses.english: and the fourth was Adoniyya son of Haggit,and the fifth was Shefatya son of Avital,

verses.hebrew: וְהַשִּׁשִּׁי יִתְרְעָם לְעֶגְלָה אֵשֶׁת דָּוִד אֵלֶּה יֻלְּדוּ לְדָוִד בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃
verses.english: and the sixth was Yitre’am, by Egla wife of David.These were born to David in Hevron.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹת הַמִּלְחָמָה בֵּין בֵּית שָׁאוּל וּבֵין בֵּית דָּוִד וְאַבְנֵר הָיָה מִתְחַזֵּק בְּבֵית שָׁאוּל׃
verses.english: And it was,when there was war between the House of Sha’ul and the House of David,that Avner was gaining strength in the House of Sha’ul.

verses.hebrew: וּלְשָׁאוּל פִּלֶגֶשׁ וּשְׁמָהּ רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אַבְנֵר מַדּוּעַ בָּאתָה אֶל־פִּילֶגֶשׁ אָבִי׃
verses.english: Now Sha’ul had a concubine, her name was Ritzpa daughter of Aya.And [Ish-Boshet] said to Avner:For-what-reason did you come in to my father’s concubine?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר לְאַבְנֵר מְאֹד עַל־דִּבְרֵי אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר הֲרֹאשׁ כֶּלֶב אָנֹכִי אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה הַיּוֹם אֶעֱשֶׂה־חֶסֶד עִם־בֵּית שָׁאוּל אָבִיךָ אֶל־אֶחָיו וְאֶל־מֵרֵעֵהוּ וְלֹא הִמְצִיתִךָ בְּיַד־דָּוִד וַתִּפְקֹד עָלַי עֲוֺן הָאִשָּׁה הַיּוֹם׃
verses.english: Avner became exceedingly agitated over the words of Ish-Boshet;he said:Am I the head of a dog belonging to Judah?Today I do an act-of-loyalty to the House of Sha’ul your father,for his brothers and for his friends,and have not let you come into David’s hand—yet you account me with a fault concerning a woman today!

verses.hebrew: כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה אֱלֹהִים לְאַבְנֵר וְכֹה יֹסִיף לוֹ כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה לְדָוִד כִּי־כֵן אֶעֱשֶׂה־לּוֹ׃
verses.english: Thus may God do to Avner, and thus may he add to him;indeed, [just] as YHWH swore to David,indeed, thus I will do to him—

verses.hebrew: לְהַעֲבִיר הַמַּמְלָכָה מִבֵּית שָׁאוּל וּלְהָקִים אֶת־כִּסֵּא דָוִד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל־יְהוּדָה מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃
verses.english: to have the kingship cross over from the House of Sha’ul,to establish the throne of David over Israel and over Judah,from Dan to Be’er-Sheva!

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יָכֹל עוֹד לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־אַבְנֵר דָּבָר מִיִּרְאָתוֹ אֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: He was not able to answer Avner another word, out of his fear of him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְנֵר מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד תחתו [תַּחְתָּיו] לֵאמֹר לְמִי־אָרֶץ לֵאמֹר כָּרְתָה בְרִיתְךָ אִתִּי וְהִנֵּה יָדִי עִמָּךְ לְהָסֵב אֵלֶיךָ אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And Avner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying:Whose is [the] land?Cut your covenant with me,Here, my hand is with you, to bring all Israel around to you!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר טוֹב אֲנִי אֶכְרֹת אִתְּךָ בְּרִית אַךְ דָּבָר אֶחָד אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֵל מֵאִתְּךָ לֵאמֹר לֹא־תִרְאֶה אֶת־פָּנַי כִּי אִם־לִפְנֵי הֱבִיאֲךָ אֵת מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל בְּבֹאֲךָ לִרְאוֹת אֶת־פָּנָי׃
verses.english: He said:Good,I myself will cut a covenant with you;but one thing I will require, rendered “request” or “inquire” elsewhere. of you, namely:you are not to see my faceunless you first bring Mikhal daughter of Sha’ul, when you come to see my face.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל לֵאמֹר תְּנָה אֶת־אִשְׁתִּי אֶת־מִיכַל אֲשֶׁר אֵרַשְׂתִּי לִי בְּמֵאָה עָרְלוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: So David sent messengers to Ish-Boshet son of Sha’ul, saying:Give over my wife, Mikhal,whom I betrothed to myself for a hundred Philistine foreskins!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וַיִּקָּחֶהָ מֵעִם אִישׁ מֵעִם פַּלְטִיאֵל בֶּן־לוש [לָיִשׁ׃]
verses.english: Ish-Boshet sent and took her from [her] husband, from Paltiel son of Layish.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אִתָּהּ אִישָׁהּ הָלוֹךְ וּבָכֹה אַחֲרֶיהָ עַד־בַּחֻרִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְנֵר לֵךְ שׁוּב וַיָּשֹׁב׃
verses.english: And her husband went with her, going along and weeping behind her, as far as Bahurim.Then Avner said to him:Go, turn back! And he turned back.

verses.hebrew: וּדְבַר־אַבְנֵר הָיָה עִם־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר גַּם־תְּמוֹל גַּם־שִׁלְשֹׁם הֱיִיתֶם מְבַקְשִׁים אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עֲלֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: Now the word of Avner was with the elders of Israel, saying:Even yesterday, even [the] day-before, you have been seeking [to set] David as king over you.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה עֲשׂוּ כִּי יְהוָה אָמַר אֶל־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר בְּיַד דָּוִד עַבְדִּי הוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמִיַּד כָּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: So-now, do it!For YHWH has said of David, saying:By the hand of David my servantI will deliver my people Israel from the hand of the Philistines and from the hand of all their enemies!

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר גַּם־אַבְנֵר בְּאָזְנֵי בִנְיָמִין וַיֵּלֶךְ גַּם־אַבְנֵר לְדַבֵּר בְּאָזְנֵי דָוִד בְּחֶבְרוֹן אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְעֵינֵי כָּל־בֵּית בִּנְיָמִן׃
verses.english: Avner spoke likewise in the hearing of Binyamin,and Avner went likewise to speak in the hearing of David in Hevronall that was good in the eyes of Israel and in the eyes of all the House of Binyamin.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אַבְנֵר אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹן וְאִתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים אֲנָשִׁים וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד לְאַבְנֵר וְלַאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ מִשְׁתֶּה׃
verses.english: And Avner came to David in Hevron,—with him were twenty men—and David made a drinkfest for Avner and for the men who were with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְנֵר אֶל־דָּוִד אָקוּמָה וְאֵלֵכָה וְאֶקְבְּצָה אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִכְרְתוּ אִתְּךָ בְּרִית וּמָלַכְתָּ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תְּאַוֶּה נַפְשֶׁךָ וַיְּשַׁלַּח דָּוִד אֶת־אַבְנֵר וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: Then Avner said to David:Let me arise, let me go,and let me gather all Israel to my lord king,that they may cut a covenant with youand that you may become king according to all that your appetite craves.So David sent Avner away,and he went off in peace.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה עַבְדֵי דָוִד וְיוֹאָב בָּא מֵהַגְּדוּד וְשָׁלָל רָב עִמָּם הֵבִיאוּ וְאַבְנֵר אֵינֶנּוּ עִם־דָּוִד בְּחֶבְרוֹן כִּי שִׁלְּחוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: Now here, David’s servants and Yoav came back from raiding, and abundant spoils they brought with them—but Avner was not with David in Hevron,for he had sent him off, and he had gone away in peace.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב וְכָל־הַצָּבָא אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ בָּאוּ וַיַּגִּדוּ לְיוֹאָב לֵאמֹר בָּא־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: When Yoav and all the forces that were with him came, [someone] told Yoav, saying:Avner the son of Ner came to the king,but he sent him off and he went away in peace!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עָשִׂיתָה הִנֵּה־בָא אַבְנֵר אֵלֶיךָ לָמָּה־זֶּה שִׁלַּחְתּוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ׃
verses.english: So Yoav came to the king and said:What have you done?Here, Avner came to you—why now did you send him off,so that he has gone, yes, gone?

verses.hebrew: יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר כִּי לְפַתֹּתְךָ בָּא וְלָדַעַת אֶת־מוֹצָאֲךָ וְאֶת־מבואך [מוֹבָאֶךָ] וְלָדַעַת אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עֹשֶׂה׃
verses.english: You know Avner the son of Ner:indeed, to dupe you he came,to gain knowledge of your going out and your coming in,and to gain knowledge of all that you are doing!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא יוֹאָב מֵעִם דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אַחֲרֵי אַבְנֵר וַיָּשִׁבוּ אֹתוֹ מִבּוֹר הַסִּרָה וְדָוִד לֹא יָדָע׃
verses.english: So Yoav went out from David,and he sent messengers after Avner;they returned him from the cistern of Sira,but David did not know [about it].

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב אַבְנֵר חֶבְרוֹן וַיַּטֵּהוּ יוֹאָב אֶל־תּוֹךְ הַשַּׁעַר לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ בַּשֶּׁלִי וַיַּכֵּהוּ שָׁם הַחֹמֶשׁ וַיָּמָת בְּדַם עֲשָׂה־אֵל אָחִיו׃
verses.english: Avner returned to Hevron,and Yoav took him to the inner-part of the gate, to speak with him quietly,but he struck him in the abdomen, so that he died,[in exchange] for the blood of Asa’el his brother.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד מֵאַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיֹּאמֶר נָקִי אָנֹכִי וּמַמְלַכְתִּי מֵעִם יְהוָה עַד־עוֹלָם מִדְּמֵי אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר׃
verses.english: David heard [of it], after this,and said:Clear-of-blame am I and my kingdom by YHWH, for the ages,from the blood of Avner son of Ner—

verses.hebrew: יָחֻלוּ עַל־רֹאשׁ יוֹאָב וְאֶל כָּל־בֵּית אָבִיו וְאַל־יִכָּרֵת מִבֵּית יוֹאָב זָב וּמְצֹרָע וּמַחֲזִיק בַּפֶּלֶךְ וְנֹפֵל בַּחֶרֶב וַחֲסַר־לָחֶם׃
verses.english: may it alight on the head of Yoav and on all his Father’s House;may there never be cut off from the House of Yoav[anyone] with a flow, or with tzaraat A skin disease (not leprosy) which in the Bible usually indicates some wrongdoing on the part of the victim. Its physical appearance suggested deterioration and hence death, although it was probably not a serious condition in and of itself. ,or [a male] taking hold of a spindle, or one falling by the sword, or one lacking food!

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אָחִיו הָרְגוּ לְאַבְנֵר עַל אֲשֶׁר הֵמִית אֶת־עֲשָׂהאֵל אֲחִיהֶם בְּגִבְעוֹן בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: Now Yoav and Avishai his brother had killed Avneron account that he had caused the death of Asa’el their brother at Giv’on, in battle.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יוֹאָב וְאֶל־כָּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ קִרְעוּ בִגְדֵיכֶם וְחִגְרוּ שַׂקִּים וְסִפְדוּ לִפְנֵי אַבְנֵר וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד הֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֵי הַמִּטָּה׃
verses.english: And David said to Yoav and to all the people that were with him:Tear your garments and gird yourselves with sackcloth,and beat [the breast] before Avner!Now King David [himself] walked after the bier.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִשָּׂא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־קוֹלוֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ אֶל־קֶבֶר אַבְנֵר וַיִּבְכּוּ כָּל־הָעָם׃
verses.english: They buried Avner in Hevron,and the king lifted up his voice and wept upon the burial-place of Avner,and all the people wept.

verses.hebrew: וַיְקֹנֵן הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אַבְנֵר וַיֹּאמַר הַכְּמוֹת נָבָל יָמוּת אַבְנֵר׃
verses.english: And the king intoned-a-dirge over Avner; he said:Like the death of a vile one, should Avner have died?

verses.hebrew: יָדֶךָ לֹא־אֲסֻרוֹת וְרַגְלֶיךָ לֹא־לִנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם הֻגָּשׁוּ כִּנְפוֹל לִפְנֵי בְנֵי־עַוְלָה נָפָלְתָּ וַיֹּסִפוּ כָל־הָעָם לִבְכּוֹת עָלָיו׃
verses.english: Your hands were not bound,your feet were not put in double-bronze;like one falling before the corrupt you fell!And all the people continued to weep over him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא כָל־הָעָם לְהַבְרוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד לֶחֶם בְּעוֹד הַיּוֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַע דָּוִד לֵאמֹר כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יֹסִיף כִּי אִם־לִפְנֵי בוֹא־הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֶטְעַם־לֶחֶם אוֹ כָל־מְאוּמָה׃
verses.english: Then all the people came to nourish David with bread while it was daylight,but David swore, saying:Thus may God do to me, and thus may he add,if before the coming in of the sun I taste bread or anything [else]!

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הָעָם הִכִּירוּ וַיִּיטַב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעֵינֵי כָל־הָעָם טוֹב׃
verses.english: All the people took note, and it was good in their eyes;like all that the king did, in the eyes of the people it was good.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדְעוּ כָל־הָעָם וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כִּי לֹא הָיְתָה מֵהַמֶּלֶךְ לְהָמִית אֶת־אַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר׃
verses.english: So all the people and all Israel knew on that daythat it had not been from the king to cause the death of Avner son of Ner.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הֲלוֹא תֵדְעוּ כִּי־שַׂר וְגָדוֹל נָפַל הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: The king said to his servants:Do you not knowthat a commander and a great [man] has fallen in Israel this day?

verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם רַךְ וּמָשׁוּחַ מֶלֶךְ וְהָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה קָשִׁים מִמֶּנִּי יְשַׁלֵּם יְהוָה לְעֹשֵׂה הָרָעָה כְּרָעָתוֹ׃
verses.english: As for me, today I am softhearted, though anointed as king,while these men, the sons of Tzeruya, are too rough for me!May YHWH pay back the doer of evil in accordance with his evil-deed!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע בֶּן־שָׁאוּל כִּי מֵת אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּרְפּוּ יָדָיו וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נִבְהָלוּ׃
verses.english: The son of Sha’ul heard that Avner was dead in Hevron,and his hands grew slack,while all Israel were terrified.

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים שָׂרֵי־גְדוּדִים הָיוּ בֶן־שָׁאוּל שֵׁם הָאֶחָד בַּעֲנָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי רֵכָב בְּנֵי רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֶרֹתִי מִבְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן כִּי גַּם־בְּאֵרוֹת תֵּחָשֵׁב עַל־בִּנְיָמִן׃
verses.english: Now two men, commanders of raiding-bands, belonged to the son of Sha’ul;the name of the one was Baana, and the name of the second was Rekhav,sons of Rimmon the Be’erotite, of the Children of Binyamin.—For Be’erot too was reckoned to Binyamin:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרְחוּ הַבְּאֵרֹתִים גִּתָּיְמָה וַיִּהְיוּ־שָׁם גָּרִים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: the Be’erotites had got away to Gittayim,and they have continued sojourning there, until this day.—

verses.hebrew: וְלִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל בֵּן נְכֵה רַגְלָיִם בֶּן־חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים הָיָה בְּבֹא שְׁמֻעַת שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן מִיִּזְרְעֶאל וַתִּשָּׂאֵהוּ אֹמַנְתּוֹ וַתָּנֹס וַיְהִי בְּחָפְזָהּ לָנוּס וַיִּפֹּל וַיִּפָּסֵחַ וּשְׁמוֹ מְפִיבֹשֶׁת׃
verses.english: Now Yehonatan son of Sha’ul had a son, stricken in the feet;he had been five years old when the tidings had come of Sha’ul and Yehonatan, from Yizre’el,and his caretaker had lifted him up and fled.It was in her haste to flee that he had fallen and been made lame.—His name was Mefiboshet trad. English “Mephibosheth.” The name means “from the Mouth of Baal/Boshet.” The original form of the name, mentioned in I Chron. 8:34 and 9:40, is “Merib-baal.”.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי־רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי רֵכָב וּבַעֲנָה וַיָּבֹאוּ כְּחֹם הַיּוֹם אֶל־בֵּית אִישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וְהוּא שֹׁכֵב אֵת מִשְׁכַּב הַצָּהֳרָיִם׃
verses.english: So the sons of Rimmon the Be’erotite, Rekhav and Baana, wentand came, at the heat of the day, to the house of Ish-Boshet,while he was lying down for the noonday nap, from the same root (sh-k-b), “to lie down,” that echoes in this chapter, emphasizing the heinousness of the murder..

verses.hebrew: וְהֵנָּה בָּאוּ עַד־תּוֹךְ הַבַּיִת לֹקְחֵי חִטִּים וַיַּכֻּהוּ אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וְרֵכָב וּבַעֲנָה אָחִיו נִמְלָטוּ׃
verses.english: And here, when they came into the midst of the house, as fetchers of wheat,they struck him in the abdomen;then Rekhav and Baana his brother escaped.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַבַּיִת וְהוּא־שֹׁכֵב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ בַּחֲדַר מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וַיַּכֻּהוּ וַיְמִתֻהוּ וַיָּסִירוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיֵּלְכוּ דֶּרֶךְ הָעֲרָבָה כָּל־הַלָּיְלָה׃
verses.english: —They had come into the housewhile he was lying on his couch, in his bedroom,and had struck him down and caused his death,and had removed his head.—They took his headand went off, by way of the Plain, all night,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִאוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה־רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל אֹיִבְךָ אֲשֶׁר בִּקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ נְקָמוֹת הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה מִשָּׁאוּל וּמִזַּרְעוֹ׃
verses.english: and they brought the head of Ish-Boshet to David at Hevron,and said to the king:Here is the head of Ish-Boshet son of Sha’ul your enemy, who sought your life—YHWH has granted vengeance to my lord king this day on Sha’ul and on his seed!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן דָּוִד אֶת־רֵכָב וְאֶת־בַּעֲנָה אָחִיו בְּנֵי רִמּוֹן הַבְּאֵרֹתִי וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם חַי־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־פָּדָה אֶת־נַפְשִׁי מִכָּל־צָרָה׃
verses.english: David answered Rekhav and Baana his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Be’erotite;he said to them:By the life of YHWH,who has saved my life from every trouble:

verses.hebrew: כִּי הַמַּגִּיד לִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה־מֵת שָׁאוּל וְהוּא־הָיָה כִמְבַשֵּׂר בְּעֵינָיו וָאֹחֲזָה בוֹ וָאֶהְרְגֵהוּ בְּצִקְלָג אֲשֶׁר לְתִתִּי־לוֹ בְּשֹׂרָה׃
verses.english: indeed, the one telling me, saying: Here, Sha’ul is dead!,though he was like a bearer-of-[good]-news in his [own] eyes,I seized him and killed him in Tziklag,one to whom I might have given [reward for the] news!

verses.hebrew: אַף כִּי־אֲנָשִׁים רְשָׁעִים הָרְגוּ אֶת־אִישׁ־צַדִּיק בְּבֵיתוֹ עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וְעַתָּה הֲלוֹא אֲבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּמוֹ מִיֶּדְכֶם וּבִעַרְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: More so, when guilty men have killed an innocent man in his house, in his bedroom!So-now,should I not seek-satisfaction for his blood at your hand,and eradicate you from the land?

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו דָּוִד אֶת־הַנְּעָרִים וַיַּהַרְגוּם וַיְקַצְּצוּ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶם וַיִּתְלוּ עַל־הַבְּרֵכָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן וְאֵת רֹאשׁ אִישׁ־בֹּשֶׁת לָקָחוּ וַיִּקְבְּרוּ בְקֶבֶר־אַבְנֵר בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃
verses.english: So David commanded the fighting-lads,and they killed them and chopped off their hands and their feetand hung them up by the pool in Hevron,while the head of Ish-Boshet they tookand buried in the burial-place of Avner in Hevron.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ כָּל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־דָּוִד חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֵאמֹר הִנְנוּ עַצְמְךָ וּבְשָׂרְךָ אֲנָחְנוּ׃
verses.english: All the staff-bearers (usually “tribes”) thus, parallel to “elders” in v.3. of Israel came to David in Hevron;they said, saying:Here we are—your bone and your flesh are we!

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֶתְמוֹל גַּם־שִׁלְשׁוֹם בִּהְיוֹת שָׁאוּל מֶלֶךְ עָלֵינוּ אַתָּה הייתה [הָיִיתָ] מוציא [הַמּוֹצִיא] והמבי [וְהַמֵּבִיא] אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה לְךָ אַתָּה תִרְעֶה אֶת־עַמִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לְנָגִיד עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Even yesterday, even the day-before, when Sha’ul was king over us,it was you who took out and brought back Israel [in battle],and YHWH said to you:You shall shepherd my people Israel,you shall be Nagid over Israel!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ כָּל־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹנָה וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד בְּרִית בְּחֶבְרוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hevron,and King David cut a covenant with them at Hevron, in the presence of YHWH,and they anointed David as king over Israel.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה דָּוִד בְּמָלְכוֹ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה מָלָךְ׃
verses.english: Thirty years old was David when he became king;for forty years he reigned as king:

verses.hebrew: בְּחֶבְרוֹן מָלַךְ עַל־יְהוּדָה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים וּבִירוּשָׁלִַם מָלַךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה עַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה׃
verses.english: in Hevron he reigned as king over Judah for seven years and six months,and in Jerusalem he reigned as king for thirty-three years, over all Israel and Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲנָשָׁיו יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶל־הַיְבֻסִי יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּאמֶר לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר לֹא־תָבוֹא הֵנָּה כִּי אִם־הֱסִירְךָ הַעִוְרִים וְהַפִּסְחִים לֵאמֹר לֹא־יָבוֹא דָוִד הֵנָּה׃
verses.english: Now the king and his men went to Jerusalem, to the Yevusites, the settled-folk of the region,but they said to David, saying:You are not to enter here!—For the blind and the lame had incited them for hesir., saying:David is not to enter here!—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכֹּד דָּוִד אֵת מְצֻדַת צִיּוֹן הִיא עִיר דָּוִד׃
verses.english: But David captured the Fortress of Zion, the Jerusalem hill just north of David’s city which became the Temple Mount; not the present Mount Zion.—that is the city of David.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא כָּל־מַכֵּה יְבֻסִי וְיִגַּע בַּצִּנּוֹר וְאֶת־הַפִּסְחִים וְאֶת־הַעִוְרִים שנאו [שְׂנֻאֵי] נֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד עַל־כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ עִוֵּר וּפִסֵּחַ לֹא יָבוֹא אֶל־הַבָּיִת׃
verses.english: And David said on that day:Whoever strikes down a Yevusiteand reaches the water-shaft … ,since the lame and the blind are hated by David’s very self;therefore they say:The blind and the lame are not to enter the Temple-House!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב דָּוִד בַּמְּצֻדָה וַיִּקְרָא־לָהּ עִיר דָּוִד וַיִּבֶן דָּוִד סָבִיב מִן־הַמִּלּוֹא וָבָיְתָה׃
verses.english: David settled in the fortress,and he called it the City of David;and David built all around, from the Earthfill and inward.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד הָלוֹךְ וְגָדוֹל וַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת עִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: And David went on and on becoming great;YHWH, God of the Forces-On-High, was with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִירָם מֶלֶךְ־צֹר מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד וַעֲצֵי אֲרָזִים וְחָרָשֵׁי עֵץ וְחָרָשֵׁי אֶבֶן קִיר וַיִּבְנוּ־בַיִת לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: Hiram king of Tyre. He provides both David and his son Shelomo with building materials, principally cedar wood. The name, known in Phoenician, means “My [Divine] Brother Is Exalted.” As for Tyre, along with Sidon, the other great port city in Phoenicia, it was a major base for the sailor/traders of the eastern Mediterranean. sent messengers to David,along with cedar wood and wood carvers and stone wall carvers;they built a palace-house for David.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע דָּוִד כִּי־הֱכִינוֹ יְהוָה לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכִי נִשֵּׂא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ בַּעֲבוּר עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And David knew that YHWH had established him as king over Israel,and that he had exalted his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד עוֹד פִּלַגְשִׁים וְנָשִׁים מִירוּשָׁלִַם אַחֲרֵי בֹּאוֹ מֵחֶבְרוֹן וַיִּוָּלְדוּ עוֹד לְדָוִד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת׃
verses.english: David took more concubines and wives in Jerusalem, after his coming back from Hevron,and more [children] were born to David, sons and daughters.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הַיִּלֹּדִים לוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם שַׁמּוּעַ וְשׁוֹבָב וְנָתָן וּשְׁלֹמֹה׃
verses.english: And these are the names of those born to him in Jerusalem:Shammua and Shovav,Natan trad. English “Nathan.” This is not the important court prophet who appears first in Chap. 7. The name is notable in its echoing of David’s dear friend Yehonatan. and Shelomo,

verses.hebrew: וְיִבְחָר וֶאֱלִישׁוּעַ וְנֶפֶג וְיָפִיעַ׃
verses.english: Yivhar and Elishua, Nefeg and Yafi’a,

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁמָע וְאֶלְיָדָע וֶאֱלִיפָלֶט׃
verses.english: Elishama, Elyada and Elifelet.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־מָשְׁחוּ אֶת־דָּוִד לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲלוּ כָל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד וַיֵּרֶד אֶל־הַמְּצוּדָה׃
verses.english: The Philistines heard that they had anointed David as king over Israel,so all the Philistines went up to seek out David.David heard, and he went down to the fortress.

verses.hebrew: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים בָּאוּ וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃
verses.english: Now the Philistines had comeand had spread out in the Valley of the Shades, ancestral spirits who were also understood to be primeval giants. The location of the valley is today a residential neighborhood in the southern part of West Jerusalem..

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהוָה לֵאמֹר הַאֶעֱלֶה אֶל־פְּלִשְׁתִּים הֲתִתְּנֵם בְּיָדִי וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־דָּוִד עֲלֵה כִּי־נָתֹן אֶתֵּן אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּים בְּיָדֶךָ׃
verses.english: So David inquired of YHWH, saying:Shall I go up against the Philistines?Will you give them into my hand?YHWH said to David:Go up,for I will give, yes, give the Philistines into your hand!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד בְּבַעַל־פְּרָצִים וַיַּכֵּם שָׁם דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר פָּרַץ יְהוָה אֶת־אֹיְבַי לְפָנַי כְּפֶרֶץ מָיִם עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בַּעַל פְּרָצִים׃
verses.english: David came to Baal-Peratzim/Master of Bursting Forth,and David struck them there;he said:YHWH has burst my enemies before me like a bursting forth of water!Therefore they called the name of that place Baal-Peratzim/Master of Bursting Forth.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַזְבוּ־שָׁם אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וַיִּשָּׂאֵם דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו׃
verses.english: They abandoned their idols there,and David and his men carried them off.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִפוּ עוֹד פְּלִשְׁתִּים לַעֲלוֹת וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃
verses.english: But the Philistines went up again,and spread out in the Valley of the Shades.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד בַּיהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תַעֲלֶה הָסֵב אֶל־אַחֲרֵיהֶם וּבָאתָ לָהֶם מִמּוּל בְּכָאִים׃
verses.english: So David inquired of YHWH,and he said:You are not to go up;lead [your men] around, behind them,and come at them in front of the balsam-trees as a place-name..

verses.hebrew: וִיהִי בשמעך [כְּשָׁמְעֲךָ] אֶת־קוֹל צְעָדָה בְּרָאשֵׁי הַבְּכָאִים אָז תֶּחֱרָץ כִּי אָז יָצָא יְהוָה לְפָנֶיךָ לְהַכּוֹת בְּמַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: And let it be:when you hear the sound of marching on the tops of the balsam-trees, then you are to act-decisively,for then YHWH will go out before you, to strike down the camp of the Philistines.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד כֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יְהוָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים מִגֶּבַע עַד־בֹּאֲךָ גָזֶר׃
verses.english: David did thus, as YHWH had commanded him;he struck the Philistines from Geva until where-you-come to Gezer.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד דָּוִד אֶת־כָּל־בָּחוּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃
verses.english: David continued [gathering] every hand-picked [man] in Israel, thirty thousand as a military unit or division, thus making for more realistic numbers..

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ מִבַּעֲלֵי יְהוּדָה לְהַעֲלוֹת מִשָּׁם אֵת אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא שֵׁם שֵׁם יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים עָלָיו׃
verses.english: And David arose and went, along with all the fighting-people who were with him, from Baala in Judah,to bring up from there the Coffer of God, over which was called the name, is sham, “there,” earlier in the verse. of YHWH of the Forces-On-High, [The One] Seated on the Winged-Sphinxes.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־עֲגָלָה חֲדָשָׁה וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ מִבֵּית אֲבִינָדָב אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה וְעֻזָּא וְאַחְיוֹ בְּנֵי אֲבִינָדָב נֹהֲגִים אֶת־הָעֲגָלָה חֲדָשָׁה׃
verses.english: They mounted the Coffer of God on a new wagonand transported it from the house of Avinadav, which is in Giv’a,while Uzza and Ahyo, the sons of Avinadav, were driving the new wagon.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ מִבֵּית אֲבִינָדָב אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּבְעָה עִם אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וְאַחְיוֹ הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵי הָאָרוֹן׃
verses.english: They transported it from the house of Avinadav that is in Giv’a, with the Coffer of God,with Ahyo walking in front of the Coffer.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד וְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מְשַׂחֲקִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה בְּכֹל עֲצֵי בְרוֹשִׁים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת וּבִנְבָלִים וּבְתֻפִּים וּבִמְנַעַנְעִים וּבְצֶלְצֶלִים׃
verses.english: Now David and the whole house of Israel were dancing in the presence of YHWH,with all the fir wood [instruments] here it is ’atzei veroshim).,with lyres and with lutes and with timbrels,with rattles and with cymbals.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־גֹּרֶן נָכוֹן וַיִּשְׁלַח עֻזָּא אֶל־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאחֶז בּוֹ כִּי שָׁמְטוּ הַבָּקָר׃
verses.english: They came to the threshing-floor of Nakhon,and Uzza stretched out [his hand] to the Coffer of God and took hold of it,for the oxen had let it slip.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בְּעֻזָּה וַיַּכֵּהוּ שָׁם הָאֱלֹהִים עַל־הַשַּׁל וַיָּמָת שָׁם עִם אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: YHWH’s anger flared up at Uzza,and God struck him down there because of [his] carelessness, so that he died there,beside the Coffer of God.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר לְדָוִד עַל אֲשֶׁר פָּרַץ יְהוָה פֶּרֶץ בְּעֻזָּה וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And David was agitated over [the fact] that YHWH had burst forth, a bursting forth against Uzza,so that place is called Peretz Uzza/Bursting Forth [at] Uzza,until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרָא דָוִד אֶת־יְהוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵיךְ יָבוֹא אֵלַי אֲרוֹן יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And David was fearful of God on that day;he said:How will the Coffer of YHWH [ever] come to me?

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־אָבָה דָוִד לְהָסִיר אֵלָיו אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהוָה עַל־עִיר דָּוִד וַיַּטֵּהוּ דָוִד בֵּית עֹבֵד־אֱדוֹם הַגִּתִּי׃
verses.english: And David would not remove the Coffer of YHWH from him to the City of David,so David turned it aside to the house of Oved-Edom the Gittite.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב אֲרוֹן יְהוָה בֵּית עֹבֵד אֱדֹם הַגִּתִּי שְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהוָה אֶת־עֹבֵד אֱדֹם וְאֶת־כָּל־בֵּיתוֹ׃
verses.english: The Coffer stayed at the house of Oved-Edom the Gittite for three months,and YHWH blessed Oved-Edom and all his household.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לֵאמֹר בֵּרַךְ יְהוָה אֶת־בֵּית עֹבֵד אֱדֹם וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ בַּעֲבוּר אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיַּעַל אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים מִבֵּית עֹבֵד אֱדֹם עִיר דָּוִד בְּשִׂמְחָה׃
verses.english: It was told to King David, saying:YHWH has blessed the house of Oved-Edom and all that is his, on account of the Coffer of God;so David went and brought up the Coffer of God from the house of Oved-Edom to the City of David, with rejoicing.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי צָעֲדוּ נֹשְׂאֵי אֲרוֹן־יְהוָה שִׁשָּׁה צְעָדִים וַיִּזְבַּח שׁוֹר וּמְרִיא׃
verses.english: It was,when those transporting the Coffer of YHWH had stepped forward six steps,that he sacrificed an ox and a fatling.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד מְכַרְכֵּר בְּכָל־עֹז לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְדָוִד חָגוּר אֵפוֹד בָּד׃
verses.english: And David was whirling with all [his] might in the presence of YHWH;David was girded with an efod of linen of linen: A common loincloth, not a priestly vestment (McCarter 1984)..

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד וְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מַעֲלִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהוָה בִּתְרוּעָה וּבְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃
verses.english: Now David and all the House of Israel were bringing up the Coffer of YHWH with shouting and with the sound of the shofar;

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אֲרוֹן יְהוָה בָּא עִיר דָּוִד וּמִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל נִשְׁקְפָה בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן וַתֵּרֶא אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד מְפַזֵּז וּמְכַרְכֵּר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַתִּבֶז לוֹ בְּלִבָּהּ׃
verses.english: and as the Coffer of YHWH was coming into the City of David,Mikhal daughter of Sha’ul was looking out through the window:she saw King David leaping and whirling. in the presence of YHWH,and she despised him in her heart.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִאוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן יְהוָה וַיַּצִּגוּ אֹתוֹ בִּמְקוֹמוֹ בְּתוֹךְ הָאֹהֶל אֲשֶׁר נָטָה־לוֹ דָּוִד וַיַּעַל דָּוִד עֹלוֹת לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וּשְׁלָמִים׃
verses.english: They brought the Coffer of YHWHand set it in its place, in the middle of the tent that David had spread out for it.And David offered up offerings-up in the presence of YHWH, and shalom-offerings.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל דָּוִד מֵהַעֲלוֹת הָעוֹלָה וְהַשְּׁלָמִים וַיְבָרֶךְ אֶת־הָעָם בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת׃
verses.english: [When] David had finished offering up the offering-up and the shalom-offerings,he blessed the people in the name of YHWH of the Forces-On-High,

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַלֵּק לְכָל־הָעָם לְכָל־הֲמוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמֵאִישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה לְאִישׁ חַלַּת לֶחֶם אַחַת וְאֶשְׁפָּר אֶחָד וַאֲשִׁישָׁה אֶחָת וַיֵּלֶךְ כָּל־הָעָם אִישׁ לְבֵיתוֹ׃
verses.english: and divided up [food] for the whole people, for the whole throng of Israel, from man to woman—for each: one cake of bread, one roll, and one raisin-cake—and all the people went off, each one to his house.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב דָּוִד לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ וַתֵּצֵא מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַתֹּאמֶר מַה־נִּכְבַּד הַיּוֹם מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר נִגְלָה הַיּוֹם לְעֵינֵי אַמְהוֹת עֲבָדָיו כְּהִגָּלוֹת נִגְלוֹת אַחַד הָרֵקִים׃
verses.english: Then David returned to bless his household;but Mikhal daughter of Sha’ul went out to meet Davidand said:How he has gotten honor today, the king of Israel,who has exposed himself today before the eyes of his servants’ maids—like one of [those] empty-men. LXX, adding a letter, reads “dancers” (rkdym) here. exposes himself!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־מִיכַל לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בִּי מֵאָבִיךְ וּמִכָּל־בֵּיתוֹ לְצַוֺּת אֹתִי נָגִיד עַל־עַם יְהוָה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשִׂחַקְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: David said to Mikhal:In the presence of YHWH, who chose me over your father and over all his house, to commission me as Nagid over the people of YHWH, over Israel:I’ll dance in the presence of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וּנְקַלֹּתִי עוֹד מִזֹּאת וְהָיִיתִי שָׁפָל בְּעֵינָי וְעִם־הָאֲמָהוֹת אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתְּ עִמָּם אִכָּבֵדָה׃
verses.english: and will hold-myself-lightly more than this;I’ll be lowly in my own eyes—with the serving-maids of whom you spoke,with them I’ll get honor I’ll get honor: A sarcastic sexual reference.!

verses.hebrew: וּלְמִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל לֹא־הָיָה לָהּ יָלֶד עַד יוֹם מוֹתָהּ׃
verses.english: And Mikhal daughter of Sha’ul had no childuntil the day of her death.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־יָשַׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּבֵיתוֹ וַיהוָה הֵנִיחַ־לוֹ מִסָּבִיב מִכָּל־אֹיְבָיו׃
verses.english: Now it waswhen the king sat in his house—YHWH had given-him-rest, round about, from all his enemies—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־נָתָן הַנָּבִיא רְאֵה נָא אָנֹכִי יוֹשֵׁב בְּבֵית אֲרָזִים וַאֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים יֹשֵׁב בְּתוֹךְ הַיְרִיעָה׃
verses.english: that the king said to Natan the prophet:Now see:I stay in a house of cedars,while the Coffer of God stays in the midst of a curtained-shrine!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבְךָ לֵךְ עֲשֵׂה כִּי יְהוָה עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: Natan said to the king:All that is in your heart, go, do,for YHWH is with you.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיְהִי דְּבַר־יְהוָה אֶל־נָתָן לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: But it was on that very nightthat the word of YHWH [came] to Natan, saying:

verses.hebrew: לֵךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל־עַבְדִּי אֶל־דָּוִד כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הַאַתָּה תִּבְנֶה־לִּי בַיִת לְשִׁבְתִּי׃
verses.english: Go and say to my servant, to David:Thus says YHWH:Will you build me a house to stay in?

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יָשַׁבְתִּי בְּבַיִת לְמִיּוֹם הַעֲלֹתִי אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וָאֶהְיֶה מִתְהַלֵּךְ בְּאֹהֶל וּבְמִשְׁכָּן׃
verses.english: For I have not stayed in a housefrom the day of my bringing up the Children of Israel from Egypt until this day;but I have been going about in Tent and in Dwelling.

verses.hebrew: בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בְּכָל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲדָבָר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶת־אַחַד שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי לִרְעוֹת אֶת־עַמִּי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר לָמָּה לֹא־בְנִיתֶם לִי בֵּית אֲרָזִים׃
verses.english: Wherever I have been going about among all the Children of Israel,have I ever spoken a word with one of the judge-leaders (“tribes”) as shofetei; see I Chron. 17:6 and v.11 below. of Israel whom I commisioned to shepherd my people Israel, saying:Why have you not built me a house of cedars?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כֹּה־תֹאמַר לְעַבְדִּי לְדָוִד כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֲנִי לְקַחְתִּיךָ מִן־הַנָּוֶה מֵאַחַר הַצֹּאן לִהְיוֹת נָגִיד עַל־עַמִּי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: So-now,thus are you to say to my servant, to David:Thus says YHWH of the Forces-On-High:I myself took you from the pasture, from [following] after the flock,to be Nagid over my people, over Israel.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶהְיֶה עִמְּךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלַכְתָּ וָאַכְרִתָה אֶת־כָּל־אֹיְבֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ וְעָשִׂתִי לְךָ שֵׁם גָּדוֹל כְּשֵׁם הַגְּדֹלִים אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: I have been with you wherever you have gone,and have cut off all your enemies from before you.And I will make you a great name,like the name of the great-ones who are on the earth,

verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי מָקוֹם לְעַמִּי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וּנְטַעְתִּיו וְשָׁכַן תַּחְתָּיו וְלֹא יִרְגַּז עוֹד וְלֹא־יֹסִיפוּ בְנֵי־עַוְלָה לְעַנּוֹתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה׃
verses.english: and I will make a place for my people, for Israel:I will plant them,and they will dwell beneath it,so that they will shudder no more,so that malicious ones will not continue to afflict them, as in former-times,

verses.hebrew: וּלְמִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי שֹׁפְטִים עַל־עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַהֲנִיחֹתִי לְךָ מִכָּל־אֹיְבֶיךָ וְהִגִּיד לְךָ יְהוָה כִּי־בַיִת יַעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: from the day that I commisioned judges over my people Israel.And I will give-you-rest from all your enemies.YHWH has told you that YHWH will make you a house:

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִמְלְאוּ יָמֶיךָ וְשָׁכַבְתָּ אֶת־אֲבֹתֶיךָ וַהֲקִימֹתִי אֶת־זַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִמֵּעֶיךָ וַהֲכִינֹתִי אֶת־מַמְלַכְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: when your days are fulfilledand you lie beside your fathers,I will raise up your seed after you,one who comes out from your body,and I will make his kingdom firm.

verses.hebrew: הוּא יִבְנֶה־בַּיִת לִשְׁמִי וְכֹנַנְתִּי אֶת־כִּסֵּא מַמְלַכְתּוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: He will build a house to my name,and I will make his kingly throne firm for the ages;

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי אֶהְיֶה־לּוֹ לְאָב וְהוּא יִהְיֶה־לִּי לְבֵן אֲשֶׁר בְּהַעֲוֺתוֹ וְהֹכַחְתִּיו בְּשֵׁבֶט אֲנָשִׁים וּבְנִגְעֵי בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: I will be to him as a father,and he will be to me as a son.When he commits-iniquity,I will rebuke him with the staff of men, and with the blows of humans;

verses.hebrew: וְחַסְדִּי לֹא־יָסוּר מִמֶּנּוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי מֵעִם שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי מִלְּפָנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: but my loyal-love I will not turn aside from him,as I turned aside from Sha’ul, from whom I turned aside before you.

verses.hebrew: וְנֶאְמַן בֵּיתְךָ וּמַמְלַכְתְּךָ עַד־עוֹלָם לְפָנֶיךָ כִּסְאֲךָ יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן עַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: Secure will be your house and your kingdom for the ages before me;your throne will be firm for the ages!

verses.hebrew: כְּכֹל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וּכְכֹל הַחִזָּיוֹן הַזֶּה כֵּן דִּבֶּר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד׃
verses.english: According to all these words and according to all this vision,thus did Natan speak to David.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֵּשֶׁב לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אָנֹכִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וּמִי בֵיתִי כִּי הֲבִיאֹתַנִי עַד־הֲלֹם׃
verses.english: King David came and sat in the presence of YHWH;he said:Who am I, my Lord YHWH,and who is my household,that you have brought me this far?

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְטַן עוֹד זֹאת בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה וַתְּדַבֵּר גַּם אֶל־בֵּית־עַבְדְּךָ לְמֵרָחוֹק וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָדָם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃
verses.english: And still this was too small in your eyes, my Lord YHWH—you have also spoken of your servant’s house in a distant-time!This is the rule for a man-of-status, my Lord YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וּמַה־יּוֹסִיף דָּוִד עוֹד לְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה׃
verses.english: And what more can David speak further to you,since you yourself know your servant, my Lord YHWH?

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲבוּר דְּבָרְךָ וּכְלִבְּךָ עָשִׂיתָ אֵת כָּל־הַגְּדוּלָּה הַזֹּאת לְהוֹדִיעַ אֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: For the sake of your word and in accordance with your heartyou have done all this greatness,to make it known to your servant.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן גָּדַלְתָּ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה כִּי־אֵין כָּמוֹךָ וְאֵין אֱלֹהִים זוּלָתֶךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַעְנוּ בְּאָזְנֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Therefore you are great, my Lord YHWH;indeed, there is none like youand no God beside youaccording to all that we have heard with our ears.

verses.hebrew: וּמִי כְעַמְּךָ כְּיִשְׂרָאֵל גּוֹי אֶחָד בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ־אֱלֹהִים לִפְדּוֹת־לוֹ לְעָם וְלָשׂוּם לוֹ שֵׁם וְלַעֲשׂוֹת לָכֶם הַגְּדוּלָּה וְנֹרָאוֹת לְאַרְצֶךָ מִפְּנֵי עַמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ לְּךָ מִמִּצְרַיִם גּוֹיִם וֵאלֹהָיו׃
verses.english: And who is like your people, like Israel,a singular nation on earth,whom God went forth to redeem for himself as a people,to make for himself a nameand to do for you great things, and awe-inspiring [acts] for your land,before your people whom you redeemed for yourself from Egypt,[driving out] nations and their gods?

verses.hebrew: וַתְּכוֹנֵן לְךָ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ לְעָם עַד־עוֹלָם וְאַתָּה יְהוָה הָיִיתָ לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃
verses.english: You have made your people Israel firm, as a people for yourself for the ages,and you, O YHWH, you have become God for them.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ עַל־עַבְדְּךָ וְעַל־בֵּיתוֹ הָקֵם עַד־עוֹלָם וַעֲשֵׂה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃
verses.english: So-now, O YHWH God,as for the word that you have spoken about your servant and about his house—establish [it] for the ages,and do as you have spoken.

verses.hebrew: וְיִגְדַּל שִׁמְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם לֵאמֹר יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהִים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵית עַבְדְּךָ דָוִד יִהְיֶה נָכוֹן לְפָנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: And may your name be great for the ages, saying:YHWH of the Forces-On-High is God over Israel,and the house of your servant David—may it be firm before you!

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל גָּלִיתָה אֶת־אֹזֶן עַבְדְּךָ לֵאמֹר בַּיִת אֶבְנֶה־לָּךְ עַל־כֵּן מָצָא עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־לִבּוֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּל אֵלֶיךָ אֶת־הַתְּפִלָּה הַזֹּאת׃
verses.english: For you, O YHWH of the Forces-On-High, God of Israel,have bared your servant’s ear, saying:A house will I build for you;therefore your servant has found his heart to pray to you this prayer.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אַתָּה־הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים וּדְבָרֶיךָ יִהְיוּ אֱמֶת וַתְּדַבֵּר אֶל־עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַטּוֹבָה הַזֹּאת׃
verses.english: So-now, my Lord YHWH,you are God, and your words are truth;you have spoken this good [thing] to your servant.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הוֹאֵל וּבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית עַבְדְּךָ לִהְיוֹת לְעוֹלָם לְפָנֶיךָ כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה דִּבַּרְתָּ וּמִבִּרְכָתְךָ יְבֹרַךְ בֵּית־עַבְדְּךָ לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: So-now,be pleased and bless the house of your servant,to be in your presence for the ages,for you, my Lord YHWH, you have spoken it,and through your blessing may the house of your servant be blessed for the ages!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיַּךְ דָּוִד אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּכְנִיעֵם וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֶת־מֶתֶג הָאַמָּה מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: It was [some time] after thisthat David struck the Philistines and humbled them,and David took Meteg Amma would yield “from Gat to Amma.” from the hand of the Philistines.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ אֶת־מוֹאָב וַיְמַדְּדֵם בַּחֶבֶל הַשְׁכֵּב אוֹתָם אַרְצָה וַיְמַדֵּד שְׁנֵי־חֲבָלִים לְהָמִית וּמְלֹא הַחֶבֶל לְהַחֲיוֹת וַתְּהִי מוֹאָב לְדָוִד לַעֲבָדִים נֹשְׂאֵי מִנְחָה׃
verses.english: Then he struck Moav,and he measured them with a rope, making them lie down on the ground—he measured two rope-lengths for putting to deathand a full rope-length for letting [them] live.And Moav became servants to David, bearers of tribute.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ דָּוִד אֶת־הֲדַדְעֶזֶר בֶּן־רְחֹב מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה בְּלֶכְתּוֹ לְהָשִׁיב יָדוֹ בִּנְהַר־[פְּרָת׃]
verses.english: Then David struck Hadad. An ancient Near Eastern storm god, usually identified with Baal. ’ezer/Hadad is Help, son of Rehov, king of Tzova,as he was going to restore his monument at the River;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכֹּד דָּוִד מִמֶּנּוּ אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת פָּרָשִׁים וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ רַגְלִי וַיְעַקֵּר דָּוִד אֶת־כָּל־הָרֶכֶב וַיּוֹתֵר מִמֶּנּוּ מֵאָה רָכֶב׃
verses.english: David took from him a thousand and seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand men, foot-soldiers,and David maimed all the chariot-horses, and left of them [only] a hundred chariot-horses.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא אֲרַם דַּמֶּשֶׂק לַעְזֹר לַהֲדַדְעֶזֶר מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה וַיַּךְ דָּוִד בַּאֲרָם עֶשְׂרִים־וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃
verses.english: And Arameans from Damascus came, to help Hadad’ezer king of Tzova,and David struck down from Aram twenty thousand men.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם דָּוִד נְצִבִים בַּאֲרַם דַּמֶּשֶׂק וַתְּהִי אֲרָם לְדָוִד לַעֲבָדִים נוֹשְׂאֵי מִנְחָה וַיֹּשַׁע יְהוָה אֶת־דָּוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלָךְ׃
verses.english: David put standing-garrisons at Aram of Damascus,and Aram became servants to David, bearers of tribute.Thus YHWH delivered David wherever he went.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח דָּוִד אֵת שִׁלְטֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ אֶל עַבְדֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר וַיְבִיאֵם יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: And David took the gold bow cases that were upon Hadad’ezer’s servantsand brought them to Jerusalem,

verses.hebrew: וּמִבֶּטַח וּמִבֵּרֹתַי עָרֵי הֲדַדְעָזֶר לָקַח הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד נְחֹשֶׁת הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃
verses.english: while from Betah and from Berotai, Hadad’ezer’s towns,King David took an exceedingly great [amount of] bronze.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע תֹּעִי מֶלֶךְ חֲמָת כִּי הִכָּה דָוִד אֵת כָּל־חֵיל הֲדַדְעָזֶר׃
verses.english: And To’i king of Hamat heard that David had struck down Hadad’ezer’s entire army,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח תֹּעִי אֶת־יוֹרָם־בְּנוֹ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ־דָּוִד לִשְׁאָל־לוֹ לְשָׁלוֹם וּלְבָרֲכוֹ עַל אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם בַּהֲדַדְעֶזֶר וַיַּכֵּהוּ כִּי־אִישׁ מִלְחֲמוֹת תֹּעִי הָיָה הֲדַדְעָזֶר וּבְיָדוֹ הָיוּ כְּלֵי־כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי־זָהָב וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת׃
verses.english: so To’i sent Yoram his son to King David,to inquire of his welfare and to give-him-blessingon account of his waging battle against Hadad’ezer, and [that] he had struck him down,—for a man waging battle with To’i was Hadad’ezer—and in his hand were objects of silver and objects of gold and objects of bronze.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֹתָם הִקְדִּישׁ הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד לַיהוָה עִם־הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר הִקְדִּישׁ מִכָּל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר כִּבֵּשׁ׃
verses.english: These too David hallowed to YHWH,with the silver and the gold that he had hallowed from all the nations that he had subdued:

verses.hebrew: מֵאֲרָם וּמִמּוֹאָב וּמִבְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמֵעֲמָלֵק וּמִשְּׁלַל הֲדַדְעֶזֶר בֶּן־רְחֹב מֶלֶךְ צוֹבָה׃
verses.english: from Edom and from Moav, and from the Children of Ammon,from the Philistines and from Amalek,and from the spoil of Hadad’ezer son of Rehov, king of Tzova.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ דָּוִד שֵׁם בְּשֻׁבוֹ מֵהַכּוֹתוֹ אֶת־אֲרָם בְּגֵיא־מֶלַח שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר אָלֶף׃
verses.english: And David made a name [for himself] on his return from striking Edom in the Valley of Salt, eighteen thousand [dead].

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם בֶּאֱדוֹם נְצִבִים בְּכָל־אֱדוֹם שָׂם נְצִבִים וַיְהִי כָל־אֱדוֹם עֲבָדִים לְדָוִד וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהוָה אֶת־דָּוִד בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר הָלָךְ׃
verses.english: He put garrisons in Edom—throughout all Edom he put garrisons—and all Edom became servants to David.Thus YHWH delivered David wherever he went.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְלֹךְ דָּוִד עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי דָוִד עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה לְכָל־עַמּוֹ׃
verses.english: David reigned as king over all Israel,and David instituted justice and equity for all his people.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה עַל־הַצָּבָא וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד מַזְכִּיר׃
verses.english: Now Yoav son of Tzeruya was [The One] Over the Armed-Forces,and Yehoshafat son of Ahilud was Herald,

verses.hebrew: וְצָדוֹק בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב וַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים וּשְׂרָיָה סוֹפֵר׃
verses.english: and Tzadok trad. English “Zadok.” Ancestor of the predominant priestly family under the Davidic dynasty. son of Ahituv and Avimelekh son of Evyatar were priests,and Seraya was scribe,

verses.hebrew: וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וּבְנֵי דָוִד כֹּהֲנִים הָיוּ׃
verses.english: and Benayahu son of Yehoyada was [The One Over] the Kereitites and the Peleitites,while the sons of David—they were priests.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד הֲכִי יֶשׁ־עוֹד אֲשֶׁר נוֹתַר לְבֵית שָׁאוּל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה עִמּוֹ חֶסֶד בַּעֲבוּר יְהוֹנָתָן׃
verses.english: David said:Is there yet anyone that remains from the House of Sha’ul?—so that I may show him loyalty for the sake of Yehonatan.

verses.hebrew: וּלְבֵית שָׁאוּל עֶבֶד וּשְׁמוֹ צִיבָא וַיִּקְרְאוּ־לוֹ אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו הַאַתָּה צִיבָא וַיֹּאמֶר עַבְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Now the House of Sha’ul had a servant, his name was Tziva trad. English “Zibah.”,and they called him to David.The king said to him:Are you Tziva?He said:Your servant.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַאֶפֶס עוֹד אִישׁ לְבֵית שָׁאוּל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה עִמּוֹ חֶסֶד אֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ עוֹד בֵּן לִיהוֹנָתָן נְכֵה רַגְלָיִם׃
verses.english: The king said:Is there no one still [alive] from the House of Sha’ul,that I may show him the loyalty of God?Tziva said to the king:There is still a son of Yehonatan, stricken in the feet.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵיפֹה הוּא וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה־הוּא בֵּית מָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל בְּלוֹ דְבָר׃
verses.english: The king said to him:Where is he?Tziva said to the king:Here, he is at the house of Makhir son of Ammiel, in Lo-Devar.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מִבֵּית מָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל מִלּוֹ דְבָר׃
verses.english: So King David sent and had him taken from the house of Makhir son of Ammiel, from Lo-Devar.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל אֶל־דָּוִד וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד מְפִיבֹשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה עַבְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: And Mefiboshet son of Yehonatan son of Sha’ul came to David,and he flung himself on his face and bowed low.David said: Mefiboshet!He said:Here is your servant.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָוִד אַל־תִּירָא כִּי עָשֹׂה אֶעֱשֶׂה עִמְּךָ חֶסֶד בַּעֲבוּר יְהוֹנָתָן אָבִיךָ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִי לְךָ אֶת־כָּל־שְׂדֵה שָׁאוּל אָבִיךָ וְאַתָּה תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִי תָּמִיד׃
verses.english: David said to him:Do not be afraid,for I will show, yes, show you loyalty for the sake of Yehonatan your father;I will return to you all the lands of Sha’ul your [grand]father,and you, you will eat bread at my table regularly.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ וַיֹּאמֶר מֶה עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי פָנִיתָ אֶל־הַכֶּלֶב הַמֵּת אֲשֶׁר כָּמוֹנִי׃
verses.english: He bowed low and said:What is your servant,that you have turned your face toward a dead dog like me?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צִיבָא נַעַר שָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה לְשָׁאוּל וּלְכָל־בֵּיתוֹ נָתַתִּי לְבֶן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: The king called Tziva, Sha’ul’s serving-lad, and said to him:All that belonged to Sha’ul and to all his household, I give to your lord’s [grand]son;

verses.hebrew: וְעָבַדְתָּ לּוֹ אֶת־הָאֲדָמָה אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וַעֲבָדֶיךָ וְהֵבֵאתָ וְהָיָה לְבֶן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ לֶּחֶם וַאֲכָלוֹ וּמְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ יֹאכַל תָּמִיד לֶחֶם עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִי וּלְצִיבָא חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר בָּנִים וְעֶשְׂרִים עֲבָדִים׃
verses.english: you are to work the ground for him, you and your children and your servants,and you are to bring in [the produce], so that it may be food for your lord’s grandson, and he may eat it,while Mefiboshet, your lord’s grandson, shall eat bread regularly at my table.—Now Tziva had fifteen sons and twenty servants.—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יְצַוֶּה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־עַבְדּוֹ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה עַבְדֶּךָ וּמְפִיבֹשֶׁת אֹכֵל עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִי כְּאַחַד מִבְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Tziva said to the king:According to all that my lord king commands his servant,thus will your servant do.So Mefiboshet was eating at David’s table, like one of the king’s sons.

verses.hebrew: וְלִמְפִיבֹשֶׁת בֵּן־קָטָן וּשְׁמוֹ מִיכָא וְכֹל מוֹשַׁב בֵּית־צִיבָא עֲבָדִים לִמְפִיבֹשֶׁת׃
verses.english: Now Mefiboshet had a young son, his name was Mikha trad. English “Micah.” The previous bearer of this name was the morally compromised protagonist of Judg. 17–18.,while all those dwelling in Tziva’s house were servants to Mefiboshet.

verses.hebrew: וּמְפִיבֹשֶׁת יֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלִַם כִּי עַל־שֻׁלְחַן הַמֶּלֶךְ תָּמִיד הוּא אֹכֵל וְהוּא פִּסֵּחַ שְׁתֵּי רַגְלָיו׃
verses.english: And Mefiboshet stayed in Jerusalem,for at the king’s table he ate regularly.Now he was lame in his two feet.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיָּמָת מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ חָנוּן בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: It was [some time] after thisthat the king of the Children of Ammon died,and Hanun his son became king in his stead.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶעֱשֶׂה־חֶסֶד עִם־חָנוּן בֶּן־נָחָשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אָבִיו עִמָּדִי חֶסֶד וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד לְנַחֲמוֹ בְּיַד־עֲבָדָיו אֶל־אָבִיו וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי דָוִד אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: David said:I will show loyalty to Hanun son of Nahash,as his father showed loyalty to me.So David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants, for his father,and David’s servants came to the land of the Children of Ammon.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שָׂרֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן אֶל־חָנוּן אֲדֹנֵיהֶם הַמְכַבֵּד דָּוִד אֶת־אָבִיךָ בְּעֵינֶיךָ כִּי־שָׁלַח לְךָ מְנַחֲמִים הֲלוֹא בַּעֲבוּר חֲקוֹר אֶת־הָעִיר וּלְרַגְּלָהּ וּלְהָפְכָהּ שָׁלַח דָּוִד אֶת־עֲבָדָיו אֵלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: But the officials of the Children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord:Is David [really] honoring your father in your eyes,when he sends you comforters?Isn’t it for the sake of spying out the town, to explore it and to overthrow itthat David has sent his servants to you?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח חָנוּן אֶת־עַבְדֵי דָוִד וַיְגַלַּח אֶת־חֲצִי זְקָנָם וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־מַדְוֵיהֶם בַּחֵצִי עַד שְׁתוֹתֵיהֶם וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם׃
verses.english: So Hanun took David’s servants,he shaved off half their beards and cut their clothes in half, as far as their buttocks,and then he sent them off.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח לִקְרָאתָם כִּי־הָיוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים נִכְלָמִים מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁבוּ בִירֵחוֹ עַד־יְצַמַּח זְקַנְכֶם וְשַׁבְתֶּם׃
verses.english: They told David,and he sent [men] to meet them,for the men were exceedingly humiliated.The king said:Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown;then you may return.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן כִּי נִבְאֲשׁוּ בְּדָוִד וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וַיִּשְׂכְּרוּ אֶת־אֲרַם בֵּית־רְחוֹב וְאֶת־אֲרַם צוֹבָא עֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף רַגְלִי וְאֶת־מֶלֶךְ מַעֲכָה אֶלֶף אִישׁ וְאִישׁ טוֹב שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃
verses.english: The Children of Ammon saw that they had made-themselves-reek to David,so the Children of Ammon sent and hired Arameans from Bet-Rehov and Arameans from Tzova, twenty thousand foot-soldiers,the king of Maakha, [with] a thousand men,and men of Tov, twelve thousand men.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע דָּוִד וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־יוֹאָב וְאֵת כָּל־הַצָּבָא הַגִּבֹּרִים׃
verses.english: David heard,and he sent Yoav and all the armed-forces, the mighty-men.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיַּעַרְכוּ מִלְחָמָה פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר וַאֲרַם צוֹבָא וּרְחוֹב וְאִישׁ־טוֹב וּמַעֲכָה לְבַדָּם בַּשָּׂדֶה׃
verses.english: And the Children of Ammon went out and arranged-ranks for battle, at the entrance to the gate,while the Arameans from Tzova and Rehov and the men of Tov and Maakha were alone in the open-field.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא יוֹאָב כִּי־הָיְתָה אֵלָיו פְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה מִפָּנִים וּמֵאָחוֹר וַיִּבְחַר מִכֹּל בְּחוּרֵי בישראל [יִשְׂרָאֵל] וַיַּעֲרֹךְ לִקְרַאת אֲרָם׃
verses.english: And Yoav saw that the face of battle was upon him, in front and in back,so he chose from all the choice-warriors in Israeland arranged-ranks to meet the Arameans,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת יֶתֶר הָעָם נָתַן בְּיַד אַבְשַׁי אָחִיו וַיַּעֲרֹךְ לִקְרַאת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: while the rest of the fighting-people he placed in the hand of Avishai his brother,and arranged-ranks to meet the Children of Ammon.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם־תֶּחֱזַק אֲרָם מִמֶּנִּי וְהָיִתָה לִּי לִישׁוּעָה וְאִם־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן יֶחֱזְקוּ מִמְּךָ וְהָלַכְתִּי לְהוֹשִׁיעַ לָךְ׃
verses.english: He said:If Aram is too strong for me,you will be deliverance for me,and if the Children of Ammon are too strong for you,I will go to deliver you!

verses.hebrew: חֲזַק וְנִתְחַזַּק בְּעַד־עַמֵּנוּ וּבְעַד עָרֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַיהוָה יַעֲשֶׂה הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינָיו׃
verses.english: Be strong and let us be strengthened, on behalf of our people and on behalf of the towns of our God,while YHWH—may he do what is good in his eyes!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּשׁ יוֹאָב וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה בַּאֲרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפָּנָיו׃
verses.english: And Yoav approached, and the fighting-people who were with him, for battle against Aram,and they fled before him.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן רָאוּ כִּי־נָס אֲרָם וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפְּנֵי אֲבִישַׁי וַיָּבֹאוּ הָעִיר וַיָּשָׁב יוֹאָב מֵעַל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיָּבֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: Now when the Children of Ammon saw that Aram had fled,they fled before Avishai and came back to the town.Then Yoav turned from [attacking] the Children of Ammon, and came back to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֲרָם כִּי נִגַּף לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּאָסְפוּ יָחַד׃
verses.english: And Aram saw that they were defeated before Israel,so they gathered together,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הֲדַדְעֶזֶר וַיֹּצֵא אֶת־אֲרָם אֲשֶׁר מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וַיָּבֹאוּ חֵילָם וְשׁוֹבַךְ שַׂר־צְבָא הֲדַדְעֶזֶר לִפְנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: and Hadad’ezer sent and brought out the Arameans who were across the River, so that they came to Helam,with Shovakh commander of Hadad’ezer’s forces in front of them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְדָוִד וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיָּבֹא חֵלָאמָה וַיַּעַרְכוּ אֲרָם לִקְרַאת דָּוִד וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ עִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: It was told to David,so he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan, and came to Helam,and the Arameans arrayed-ranks to meet David, and waged battle with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנָס אֲרָם מִפְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּהֲרֹג דָּוִד מֵאֲרָם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף פָּרָשִׁים וְאֵת שׁוֹבַךְ שַׂר־צְבָאוֹ הִכָּה וַיָּמָת שָׁם׃
verses.english: And the Arameans fled before Israel;David killed seven hundred charioteers and forty thousand horsemen from Aram,while Shovakh, the commander of Hadad’ezer’s forces, he struck down, so that he died there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ כָל־הַמְּלָכִים עַבְדֵי הֲדַדְעֶזֶר כִּי נִגְּפוּ לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּשְׁלִמוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּעַבְדוּם וַיִּרְאוּ אֲרָם לְהוֹשִׁיעַ עוֹד אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: And all the kings, Hadad’ezer’s servants, saw that they had been defeated before Israel,so they made-peace with Israel and served them,for the Arameans were afraid to deliver the Children of Ammon any longer.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִתְשׁוּבַת הַשָּׁנָה לְעֵת צֵאת הַמַּלְאכִים וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶת־יוֹאָב וְאֶת־עֲבָדָיו עִמּוֹ וְאֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּשְׁחִתוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיָּצֻרוּ עַל־רַבָּה וְדָוִד יוֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: Now it was at the turning of the year, at the time of kings’ going forth,that David sent Yoav and his servants with him, and all Israel:they wrought-ruin to the Children of Ammon and besieged Rabba,while David stayed in Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לְעֵת הָעֶרֶב וַיָּקָם דָּוִד מֵעַל מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וַיִּתְהַלֵּךְ עַל־גַּג בֵּית־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּרְא אִשָּׁה רֹחֶצֶת מֵעַל הַגָּג וְהָאִשָּׁה טוֹבַת מַרְאֶה מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Now it was around the time of sunsetthat David arose from his lying-place and went-for-a-walk on the roof of the king’s house,and he saw a woman washing herself, from on the roof—the woman was exceedingly fair of appearance.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד וַיִּדְרֹשׁ לָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא־זֹאת בַּת־שֶׁבַע בַּת־אֱלִיעָם אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי׃
verses.english: David sent and inquired after the woman,and they said: Is this not Bat-Sheva trad. English “Bathsheba.” daughter of Eliam, wife of Uriyya the Hittite trad. English “Uriah.” He was a high-ranking soldier in David’s army. The name is ironically a pious Israelite one, meaning “YHWH Is My Light.” The Hittites mentioned here are not to be confused with the earlier great empire in Anatolia (modern Turkey); as in Gen. 23, the term probably refers to a local Canaanite group.?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד מַלְאָכִים וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַתָּבוֹא אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ וְהִיא מִתְקַדֶּשֶׁת מִטֻּמְאָתָהּ וַתָּשָׁב אֶל־בֵּיתָהּ׃
verses.english: David sent messengers, and he had her taken:she came to him and he lay with her—now she had just purified herself in other contexts denotes “hallowing”; here it is simply the non-priestly word for purification. from her state-of-tum’a Bat-Sheva’s washing occurs at the end of her menstrual period, during which intercourse would have been forbidden because of ritual pollution (tum’a; see Lev. 18:19). It means that the forthcoming child could not be Uriyya’s. Bat-Sheva is here also at her most fertile, twelve days or so after the onset of menstruation.—and then she returned to her house.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר הָאִשָּׁה וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתַּגֵּד לְדָוִד וַתֹּאמֶר הָרָה אָנֹכִי׃
verses.english: The woman became pregnant;she sent [word] and had it told to David, she said:I am pregnant!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶל־יוֹאָב שְׁלַח אֵלַי אֶת־אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב אֶת־אוּרִיָּה אֶל־דָּוִד׃
verses.english: So David sent [word] to Yoav:Send me Uriyya the Hittite.And Yoav sent Uriyya to David.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אוּרִיָּה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁאַל דָּוִד לִשְׁלוֹם יוֹאָב וְלִשְׁלוֹם הָעָם וְלִשְׁלוֹם הַמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: Uriyya came to him,and David asked after the welfare of Yoav, the welfare of the fighting-people, and the welfare of the battle;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְאוּרִיָּה רֵד לְבֵיתְךָ וּרְחַץ רַגְלֶיךָ וַיֵּצֵא אוּרִיָּה מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתֵּצֵא אַחֲרָיו מַשְׂאַת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: then David said to Uriyya:Go down to your house and wash your feet!Uriyya went out of the king’s house,and after him went out a portion from the king,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אוּרִיָּה פֶּתַח בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת כָּל־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנָיו וְלֹא יָרַד אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃
verses.english: but Uriyya lay down at the entrance to the king’s house, with all his lord’s servants;he did not go down to his house.
