verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר לֹא־יָרַד אוּרִיָּה אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אוּרִיָּה הֲלוֹא מִדֶּרֶךְ אַתָּה בָא מַדּוּעַ לֹא־יָרַדְתָּ אֶל־בֵּיתֶךָ׃
verses.english: They told David, saying:Uriyya has not gone down to his house.David said to Uriyya:Isn’t it from a [long] journey that you have come?For-what-reason have you not gone down to your house?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אוּרִיָּה אֶל־דָּוִד הָאָרוֹן וְיִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה יֹשְׁבִים בַּסֻּכּוֹת וַאדֹנִי יוֹאָב וְעַבְדֵי אֲדֹנִי עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה חֹנִים וַאֲנִי אָבוֹא אֶל־בֵּיתִי לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת וְלִשְׁכַּב עִם־אִשְׁתִּי חַיֶּךָ וְחֵי נַפְשֶׁךָ אִם־אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Uriyya said to David:The Coffer and Israel and Judah are staying at Sukkot,my lord Yoav and my lord’s servants are camping on the surface of the open-field—and I, I should come into my houseto eat and to drink and to lie with my wife?By your life and by your [very] self: If I were to do this thing … !

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אוּרִיָּה שֵׁב בָּזֶה גַּם־הַיּוֹם וּמָחָר אֲשַׁלְּחֶךָּ וַיֵּשֶׁב אוּרִיָּה בִירוּשָׁלִַם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וּמִמָּחֳרָת׃
verses.english: David said to Uriyya:Stay here today as well; tomorrow I will send you off.So Uriyya stayed in Jerusalem on that day.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ דָוִד וַיֹּאכַל לְפָנָיו וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיְשַׁכְּרֵהוּ וַיֵּצֵא בָעֶרֶב לִשְׁכַּב בְּמִשְׁכָּבוֹ עִם־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנָיו וְאֶל־בֵּיתוֹ לֹא יָרָד׃
verses.english: Now on the morrow David had him called, and he ate and drank in his presence,and he made him drunk.He went out in the evening to lie down in his lying-place with his lord’s servants,but to his house he did not go down.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּכְתֹּב דָּוִד סֵפֶר אֶל־יוֹאָב וַיִּשְׁלַח בְּיַד אוּרִיָּה׃
verses.english: So it was in the morningthat David wrote a letter, signifying a written document (which I usually render as “record”). to Yoav and sent it by the hand of Uriyya,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב בַּסֵּפֶר לֵאמֹר הָבוּ אֶת־אוּרִיָּה אֶל־מוּל פְּנֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַחֲזָקָה וְשַׁבְתֶּם מֵאַחֲרָיו וְנִכָּה וָמֵת׃
verses.english: and he wrote in the letter, saying:Put Uriyya facing the strongest [point of] battle,and turn back behind him, so that he is struck down and dies.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁמוֹר יוֹאָב אֶל־הָעִיר וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־אוּרִיָּה אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יָדַע כִּי אַנְשֵׁי־חַיִל שָׁם׃
verses.english: So it waswhen Yoav had observed the city,that he placed Uriyya at the place where he knew that there were men of valor;

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ אֶת־יוֹאָב וַיִּפֹּל מִן־הָעָם מֵעַבְדֵי דָוִד וַיָּמָת גַּם אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי׃
verses.english: the men of the city went out and did battle with Yoav,and there fell some of the fighting-people, of David’s servants,and there died also Uriyya the Hittite.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב וַיַּגֵּד לְדָוִד אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: Yoav sent and had David told all the details about the battle;

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אֶת־הַמַּלְאָךְ לֵאמֹר כְּכַלּוֹתְךָ אֵת כָּל־דִּבְרֵי הַמִּלְחָמָה לְדַבֵּר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: he charged the messenger, saying:When you have finished reporting everything about the battle to the king,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם־תַּעֲלֶה חֲמַת הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאָמַר לְךָ מַדּוּעַ נִגַּשְׁתֶּם אֶל־הָעִיר לְהִלָּחֵם הֲלוֹא יְדַעְתֶּם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יֹרוּ מֵעַל הַחוֹמָה׃
verses.english: it will be:if the king’s anger starts up and he says to you:For-what-reason did you draw near the city to do battle?Did you not know that they would shoot down from on the wall?

verses.hebrew: מִי־הִכָּה אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־יְרֻבֶּשֶׁת הֲלוֹא־אִשָּׁה הִשְׁלִיכָה עָלָיו פֶּלַח רֶכֶב מֵעַל הַחוֹמָה וַיָּמָת בְּתֵבֵץ לָמָּה נִגַּשְׁתֶּם אֶל־הַחוֹמָה וְאָמַרְתָּ גַּם עַבְדְּךָ אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי מֵת׃
verses.english: Who struck down Avimelekh son of Yerubboshet trad. English “Abimelech.” The reference is to a son of Gid’on who in Judg. 9 proclaims himself king over the men of Shekhem and, not surprisingly, meets an untoward end. Yoav’s message, if delivered, would be a not-so-subtle dig at David’s behavior, by citing another well-known royal disaster involving a woman. —did not a woman throw down on him a riding millstone from on the wall,so that he died at Tevetz?Why did you approach the wall?—Then you are to say:Also your servant Uriyya the Hittite is dead.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמַּלְאָךְ וַיָּבֹא וַיַּגֵּד לְדָוִד אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ יוֹאָב׃
verses.english: The messenger went off, he came and told David all that Yoav had sent him [to say];

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמַּלְאָךְ אֶל־דָּוִד כִּי־גָבְרוּ עָלֵינוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּצְאוּ אֵלֵינוּ הַשָּׂדֶה וַנִּהְיֶה עֲלֵיהֶם עַד־פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר׃
verses.english: the messenger said to David:Indeed, the men were mightier than we, they went out at us in the open-field;we were upon them, up to the entrance to the gate,

verses.hebrew: ויראו [וַיֹּרוּ] המוראים [הַמּוֹרִים] אֶל־עֲבָדֶךָ מֵעַל הַחוֹמָה וַיָּמוּתוּ מֵעַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם עַבְדְּךָ אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי מֵת׃
verses.english: but the shooters shot down at your servants from on the wall,so that there died some of the king’s servants,and also your servant Uriyya the Hittite is dead.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַמַּלְאָךְ כֹּה־תֹאמַר אֶל־יוֹאָב אַל־יֵרַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כִּי־כָזֹה וְכָזֶה תֹּאכַל הֶחָרֶב הַחֲזֵק מִלְחַמְתְּךָ אֶל־הָעִיר וְהָרְסָהּ וְחַזְּקֵהוּ׃
verses.english: David said to the messenger:Say thus to Yoav:Do not let this thing be evil in your eyes,for like this and like that the sword devours!Strengthen your battle against the city and destroy it!And [you] strengthen him!

verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁמַע אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה כִּי־מֵת אוּרִיָּה אִישָׁהּ וַתִּסְפֹּד עַל־בַּעְלָהּ׃
verses.english: Uriyya’s wife heard that her husband was dead,so she beat [the breast] for her lord.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר הָאֵבֶל וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד וַיַּאַסְפָהּ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַתְּהִי־לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד לוֹ בֵּן וַיֵּרַע הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה דָוִד בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: But when the mourning-period was past, David sent and had her brought to his house;she became his wife, and she bore him a son.But the thing that David had done was evil in the eyes of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוָה אֶת־נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים הָיוּ בְּעִיר אֶחָת אֶחָד עָשִׁיר וְאֶחָד רָאשׁ׃
verses.english: and YHWH sent Natan to David;he came to him and said to him:There were two men in a certain town,one rich and one poor.

verses.hebrew: לְעָשִׁיר הָיָה צֹאן וּבָקָר הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃
verses.english: The rich one had flocks and herds, exceedingly many,

verses.hebrew: וְלָרָשׁ אֵין־כֹּל כִּי אִם־כִּבְשָׂה אַחַת קְטַנָּה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה וַיְחַיֶּהָ וַתִּגְדַּל עִמּוֹ וְעִם־בָּנָיו יַחְדָּו מִפִּתּוֹ תֹאכַל וּמִכֹּסוֹ תִשְׁתֶּה וּבְחֵיקוֹ תִשְׁכָּב וַתְּהִי־לוֹ כְּבַת׃
verses.english: while the poor one had nothing at all except for one little lamb which he had bought;he kept-it-alive, and it grew up with him, together with his children:from his morsel it would eat, from his cup it would drink, in his bosom it would lie—it became to him like a daughter/bat Echoing the leading lady’s name..

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הֵלֶךְ לְאִישׁ הֶעָשִׁיר וַיַּחְמֹל לָקַחַת מִצֹּאנוֹ וּמִבְּקָרוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת לָאֹרֵחַ הַבָּא־לוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־כִּבְשַׂת הָאִישׁ הָרָאשׁ וַיַּעֲשֶׂהָ לָאִישׁ הַבָּא אֵלָיו׃
verses.english: A journey-walker came to the rich man,but he thought-it-a-pity to take from his flocks or from his herds, to make ready for the wayfarer who had come to him,so he took the poor man’s lamb and made it ready for the man who had come to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף דָּוִד בָּאִישׁ מְאֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־נָתָן חַי־יְהוָה כִּי בֶן־מָוֶת הָאִישׁ הָעֹשֶׂה זֹאת׃
verses.english: David’s anger flared up exceedingly against the man,and he said to Natan:By the life of YHWH,indeed, a son of death is the man who does this!

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַכִּבְשָׂה יְשַׁלֵּם אַרְבַּעְתָּיִם עֵקֶב אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְעַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חָמָל׃
verses.english: And for the lamb he shall pay fourfold part of the female character’s name.,because he did this thing, and since he had no pity!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד אַתָּה הָאִישׁ כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָנֹכִי הִצַּלְתִּיךָ מִיַּד שָׁאוּל׃
verses.english: Natan said to David:You are the man!Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:I myself anointed you king over Israel,I myself rescued you from the hand of Sha’ul,

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת־בֵּית אֲדֹנֶיךָ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁי אֲדֹנֶיךָ בְּחֵיקֶךָ וָאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה וְאִם־מְעָט וְאֹסִפָה לְּךָ כָּהֵנָּה וְכָהֵנָּה׃
verses.english: I gave you the house of your lord, and the women of your lord into your bosom,I gave you the House of Israel and Judah—and as if [that were] too little, I would have added yet this and that to you.

verses.hebrew: מַדּוּעַ בָּזִיתָ אֶת־דְּבַר יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בעינו [בְּעֵינַי] אֵת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי הִכִּיתָ בַחֶרֶב וְאֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ לָקַחְתָּ לְּךָ לְאִשָּׁה וְאֹתוֹ הָרַגְתָּ בְּחֶרֶב בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: For-what-reason have you despised the word of YHWH, to do what is evil in my eyes?Uriyya the Hittite you have struck down by the sword,and his wife you have taken for yourself as a wife—while him you have killed by means of the sword of the Children of Ammon!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לֹא־תָסוּר חֶרֶב מִבֵּיתְךָ עַד־עוֹלָם עֵקֶב כִּי בְזִתָנִי וַתִּקַּח אֶת־אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: So-now—the sword shall not depart from your house for the ages,because you despised me and took the wife of Uriyya the Hittite to be a wife for you!

verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הִנְנִי מֵקִים עָלֶיךָ רָעָה מִבֵּיתֶךָ וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶת־נָשֶׁיךָ לְעֵינֶיךָ וְנָתַתִּי לְרֵעֶיךָ וְשָׁכַב עִם־נָשֶׁיךָ לְעֵינֵי הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ הַזֹּאת׃
verses.english: Thus says YHWH:Here, I will raise up against your [person]evil from your house;I will take away your womenfrom before your eyes,I will give them to your fellowand he will lie with your women,under the eyes of this sun.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ בַסָּתֶר וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה נֶגֶד כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנֶגֶד הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.english: For you, you did it in secret.,but I, I will do this thing in front of all Israel and in front of the sun.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־נָתָן חָטָאתִי לַיהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר נָתָן אֶל־דָּוִד גַּם־יְהוָה הֶעֱבִיר חַטָּאתְךָ לֹא תָמוּת׃
verses.english: David said to Natan:I have sinned against YHWH!Natan said to David:As for YHWH, he has transferred your sin—you will not die;

verses.hebrew: אֶפֶס כִּי־נִאֵץ נִאַצְתָּ אֶת־אֹיְבֵי יְהוָה בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה גַּם הַבֵּן הַיִּלּוֹד לְךָ מוֹת יָמוּת׃
verses.english: nevertheless, because you have scorned, yes, scorned “YHWH’s enemies” by this thing,as for the son who is born to you: he must die, yes, die!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ נָתָן אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּגֹּף יְהוָה אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה אֵשֶׁת־אוּרִיָּה לְדָוִד וַיֵּאָנַשׁ׃
verses.english: Natan went back to his house.And YHWH attacked the child that Uriyya’s wife had borne to David, so that he became sick.

verses.hebrew: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִים בְּעַד הַנָּעַר וַיָּצָם דָּוִד צוֹם וּבָא וְלָן וְשָׁכַב אָרְצָה׃
verses.english: David besought God on behalf of the boy,and David fasted a fast;he would come and spend-the-night lying on the ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ זִקְנֵי בֵיתוֹ עָלָיו לַהֲקִימוֹ מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא אָבָה וְלֹא־בָרָא אִתָּם לָחֶם׃
verses.english: And the elders of his house arose about him to raise him up from the ground,but he was unwilling and would not be nourished with food with them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיָּמָת הַיָּלֶד וַיִּרְאוּ עַבְדֵי דָוִד לְהַגִּיד לוֹ כִּי־מֵת הַיֶּלֶד כִּי אָמְרוּ הִנֵּה בִהְיוֹת הַיֶּלֶד חַי דִּבַּרְנוּ אֵלָיו וְלֹא־שָׁמַע בְּקוֹלֵנוּ וְאֵיךְ נֹאמַר אֵלָיו מֵת הַיֶּלֶד וְעָשָׂה רָעָה׃
verses.english: Now it was on the seventh day that the child died.David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said:Here, while the child was alive, we spoke to him, but he did not hearken to our voice;so how can we say to him: The child is dead? He might do evil!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא דָּוִד כִּי עֲבָדָיו מִתְלַחֲשִׁים וַיָּבֶן דָּוִד כִּי מֵת הַיָּלֶד וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הֲמֵת הַיֶּלֶד וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵת׃
verses.english: David saw that his servants were whispering [among themselves];and David understood that the child was dead.David said to his servants:Is the child dead?They said:[He is] dead.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם דָּוִד מֵהָאָרֶץ וַיִּרְחַץ וַיָּסֶךְ וַיְחַלֵּף שמלתו [שִׂמְלֹתָיו] וַיָּבֹא בֵית־יְהוָה וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיָּבֹא אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיִּשְׁאַל וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ לֶחֶם וַיֹּאכַל׃
verses.english: Then David arose from the ground;he washed, and poured [oil on himself], and changed his clothes,and he came into the house of YHWH and bowed down;then he came back to his house, requested that they put food before him, and ate.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עֲבָדָיו אֵלָיו מָה־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָה בַּעֲבוּר הַיֶּלֶד חַי צַמְתָּ וַתֵּבְךְּ וְכַאֲשֶׁר מֵת הַיֶּלֶד קַמְתָּ וַתֹּאכַל לָחֶם׃
verses.english: His servants said to him:What [kind of] thing is this that you have done?For the sake of the living child, you fasted and wept,but now that the child is dead, you arise and eat food!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּעוֹד הַיֶּלֶד חַי צַמְתִּי וָאֶבְכֶּה כִּי אָמַרְתִּי מִי יוֹדֵעַ יחנני [וְחַנַּנִי] יְהוָה וְחַי הַיָּלֶד׃
verses.english: He said:As long as the child was still alive, I fasted and wept,for I said [to myself]: Who knows, perhaps YHWH will be gracious to me, and the child will live!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מֵת לָמָּה זֶּה אֲנִי צָם הַאוּכַל לַהֲשִׁיבוֹ עוֹד אֲנִי הֹלֵךְ אֵלָיו וְהוּא לֹא־יָשׁוּב אֵלָי׃
verses.english: But now he is dead—why, then, should I fast?Can I make him return again?I may go to him,but he will not return to me.

verses.hebrew: וַיְנַחֵם דָּוִד אֵת בַּת־שֶׁבַע אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִמָּהּ וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן ויקרא [וַתִּקְרָא] אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שְׁלֹמֹה וַיהוָה אֲהֵבוֹ׃
verses.english: David comforted Bat-Sheva his wife;he came to her and lay with her,and she bore a son and called his name Shelomo/Peace.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח בְּיַד נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יְדִידְיָהּ בַּעֲבוּר יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Now YHWH loved him, and he sent by the hand of Natan the Prophet;he called his name Yedidya, by the grace of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלָּחֶם יוֹאָב בְּרַבַּת בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־עִיר הַמְּלוּכָה׃
verses.english: Yoav waged battle against Rabba of the Children of Ammon and captured the royal city;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב מַלְאָכִים אֶל־דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר נִלְחַמְתִּי בְרַבָּה גַּם־לָכַדְתִּי אֶת־עִיר הַמָּיִם׃
verses.english: then Yoav sent mesengers to Davidand said:I have waged battle against Rabba;I have also captured the water city.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֱסֹף אֶת־יֶתֶר הָעָם וַחֲנֵה עַל־הָעִיר וְלָכְדָהּ פֶּן־אֶלְכֹּד אֲנִי אֶת־הָעִיר וְנִקְרָא שְׁמִי עָלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: So-now,gather the rest of the fighting-people and encamp against the city, and capture it,lest I myself take the city, and my own name be called over it!

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף דָּוִד אֶת־כָּל־הָעָם וַיֵּלֶךְ רַבָּתָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בָּהּ וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ׃
verses.english: So David gathered all the fighting-people and went to Rabba;he waged battle against it and captured it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עֲטֶרֶת־מַלְכָּם מֵעַל רֹאשׁוֹ וּמִשְׁקָלָהּ כִּכַּר זָהָב וְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה וַתְּהִי עַל־רֹאשׁ דָּוִד וּשְׁלַל הָעִיר הוֹצִיא הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Then he took their king’s crown from off his head—its weight was a talent of gold, with a precious stone—and it was [put] on David’s head,while the spoils of the city he brought out, exceedingly much.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ הוֹצִיא וַיָּשֶׂם בַּמְּגֵרָה וּבַחֲרִצֵי הַבַּרְזֶל וּבְמַגְזְרֹת הַבַּרְזֶל וְהֶעֱבִיר אוֹתָם במלכן [בַּמַּלְבֵּן] וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה לְכֹל עָרֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וַיָּשָׁב דָּוִד וְכָל־הָעָם יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: As for the people who were in it, he brought them out and set [them to work] with the saw, and with picks of bronze, and with axes of bronze,and had them pass through the brick-kiln.Thus he would do with all the towns of the Children of Ammon.Then David and all the fighting-people returned to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וּלְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בֶּן־דָּוִד אָחוֹת יָפָה וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר וַיֶּאֱהָבֶהָ אַמְנוֹן בֶּן־דָּוִד׃
verses.english: It was [some time] after this:now Avshalom. The name combines “Father” (figuratively God, or actually David) and “Peace/Well-being.” son of David had a beautiful sister—her name was Tamar. Her name means “date-palm.” ,and Amnon. Tamar and Avshalom’s half brother and heir to the throne. His name ironically connotes “faithful.” son of David fell in love with her.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֶר לְאַמְנוֹן לְהִתְחַלּוֹת בַּעֲבוּר תָּמָר אֲחֹתוֹ כִּי בְתוּלָה הִיא וַיִּפָּלֵא בְּעֵינֵי אַמְנוֹן לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהּ מְאוּמָה׃
verses.english: And Amnon was distressed to [the point of] being sick because of Tamar his sister—indeed, she was a nubile-girl here probably refers to a young woman of marriageable age rather than to a virgin per se; the reason for Tamar’s being forbidden to Amnon appears to lie elsewhere (Wenham). —and it seemed impossible in Amnon’s eyes to do anything to her.

verses.hebrew: וּלְאַמְנוֹן רֵעַ וּשְׁמוֹ יוֹנָדָב בֶּן־שִׁמְעָה אֲחִי דָוִד וְיוֹנָדָב אִישׁ חָכָם מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Now Amnon had a friend—his name was Yonadav trad. English “Jonadab.” In v.5 the name has the alternate “Yehonadav.” son of Shim’a, David’s brother,and Yonadav was an exceedingly worldly-wise connotes not only intellectual but also practical wisdom. See also 14:2ff. and 20:16 below. man.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מַדּוּעַ אַתָּה כָּכָה דַּל בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר הֲלוֹא תַּגִּיד לִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַמְנוֹן אֶת־תָּמָר אֲחוֹת אַבְשָׁלֹם אָחִי אֲנִי אֹהֵב׃
verses.english: He said to him:For-what-reason are you so haggard, O son of the king, morning after morning?Won’t you tell me?Amnon said to him:Tamar—the sister), producing “a series of gasping sighs,” and Rendsburg (1998–99) includes it as an example of (emotionally) “confused language.”—of Avshalom—my brother—I love!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהוֹנָדָב שְׁכַב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבְךָ וְהִתְחָל וּבָא אָבִיךָ לִרְאוֹתֶךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו תָּבֹא נָא תָמָר אֲחוֹתִי וְתַבְרֵנִי לֶחֶם וְעָשְׂתָה לְעֵינַי אֶת־הַבִּרְיָה לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֶרְאֶה וְאָכַלְתִּי מִיָּדָהּ׃
verses.english: Yehonadav said to him:Lie down on your lying-place and feign-sickness,and when your father comes to see you, say to him:Now let Tamar my sister comeand nourish me with some food;let her make the nourishment ready before my eyes, in order that I may see it,and I will eat from her hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אַמְנוֹן וַיִּתְחָל וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ לִרְאֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ תָּבוֹא־נָא תָּמָר אֲחֹתִי וּתְלַבֵּב לְעֵינַי שְׁתֵּי לְבִבוֹת וְאֶבְרֶה מִיָּדָהּ׃
verses.english: So Amnon lay down and feigned-sickness,and when the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king:Now let Tamar my sister comeand heat two heartcakes. The verb appears also in the Song of Songs (4:9), to indicate sexual arousal. heartcakes: Heb. levivot; others, simply “cakes,” but the “heart” (Heb. leiv, leivav) motif is central to the Avshalom stories, as I have argued in the Introduction to this section. Shaped foods were known in the ancient Near East (Prof. Chaim Cohen, personal communication). before my eyes,that I may be nourished from her hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח דָּוִד אֶל־תָּמָר הַבַּיְתָה לֵאמֹר לְכִי נָא בֵּית אַמְנוֹן אָחִיךְ וַעֲשִׂי־לוֹ הַבִּרְיָה׃
verses.english: David sent [word] to Tamar, in the palace-house, saying:Pray go to the house of Amnon your brotherand make him some nourishment.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ תָּמָר בֵּית אַמְנוֹן אָחִיהָ וְהוּא שֹׁכֵב וַתִּקַּח אֶת־הַבָּצֵק ותלוש [וַתָּלָשׁ] וַתְּלַבֵּב לְעֵינָיו וַתְּבַשֵּׁל אֶת־הַלְּבִבוֹת׃
verses.english: So Tamar went to the house of Amnon her brother, while he was lying down.She took some dough, kneaded it, heated it before his eyes, and boiled the heartcakes;

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח אֶת־הַמַּשְׂרֵת וַתִּצֹק לְפָנָיו וַיְמָאֵן לֶאֱכוֹל וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן הוֹצִיאוּ כָל־אִישׁ מֵעָלַי וַיֵּצְאוּ כָל־אִישׁ מֵעָלָיו׃
verses.english: then she took the pot and placed it before him,but he refused to eat.Amnon said:Have everyone go out from me!And everyone went out from him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַמְנוֹן אֶל־תָּמָר הָבִיאִי הַבִּרְיָה הַחֶדֶר וְאֶבְרֶה מִיָּדֵךְ וַתִּקַּח תָּמָר אֶת־הַלְּבִבוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂתָה וַתָּבֵא לְאַמְנוֹן אָחִיהָ הֶחָדְרָה׃
verses.english: Amnon said to Tamar:Bring the nourishment into the inner-room, so that I may be nourished from your hand!So Tamar took the heartcakes that she had made, and brought them to Amnon her brother into the inner-room.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּגֵּשׁ אֵלָיו לֶאֱכֹל וַיַּחֲזֶק־בָּהּ וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ בּוֹאִי שִׁכְבִי עִמִּי אֲחוֹתִי׃
verses.english: She brought them close to him to eat,but he overpowered her and said to her:Come, lie with me, sister!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַל־אָחִי אַל־תְּעַנֵּנִי כִּי לֹא־יֵעָשֶׂה כֵן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַל־תַּעֲשֵׂה אֶת־הַנְּבָלָה הַזֹּאת׃
verses.english: She said to him:No, brother, don’t force me,for such is not to be done in Israel—don’t do this vile thing!

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אָנָה אוֹלִיךְ אֶת־חֶרְפָּתִי וְאַתָּה תִּהְיֶה כְּאַחַד הַנְּבָלִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַתָּה דַּבֶּר־נָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי לֹא יִמְנָעֵנִי מִמֶּךָּ׃
verses.english: As for me, where would I take my disgrace?And as for you, you would be like one of the vile ones in Israel!So-now, just speak to the king—indeed, he will not withhold me from you!

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹלָהּ וַיֶּחֱזַק מִמֶּנָּה וַיְעַנֶּהָ וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֹתָהּ׃
verses.english: But he would not hearken to her voice;he overpowered her and forced her, and lay with her.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂנָאֶהָ אַמְנוֹן שִׂנְאָה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד כִּי גְדוֹלָה הַשִּׂנְאָה אֲשֶׁר שְׂנֵאָהּ מֵאַהֲבָה אֲשֶׁר אֲהֵבָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ אַמְנוֹן קוּמִי לֵכִי׃
verses.english: Then Amnon hated her with an exceedingly great hatred—indeed, greater was the hatred with which he hated her than the love with which he had loved her.Amnon said to her:Get up! Go!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אַל־אוֹדֹת הָרָעָה הַגְּדוֹלָה הַזֹּאת מֵאַחֶרֶת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתָ עִמִּי לְשַׁלְּחֵנִי וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁמֹעַ לָהּ׃
verses.english: She said to him:About this great evil—more than the other thing that you did to me—sending me away … !But he would not hearken to her;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־נַעֲרוֹ מְשָׁרְתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁלְחוּ־נָא אֶת־זֹאת מֵעָלַי הַחוּצָה וּנְעֹל הַדֶּלֶת אַחֲרֶיהָ׃
verses.english: he called to his attending ladand said:Just send this one away from me, outside,and lock the door behind her!

verses.hebrew: וְעָלֶיהָ כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים כִּי כֵן תִּלְבַּשְׁןָ בְנוֹת־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַבְּתוּלֹת מְעִילִים וַיֹּצֵא אוֹתָהּ מְשָׁרְתוֹ הַחוּץ וְנָעַל הַדֶּלֶת אַחֲרֶיהָ׃
verses.english: —Now on her was an ornamented tunic,for thus were the king’s nubile daughters clothed in robes.—So his attendant brought her outside, and locked the door behind her.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח תָּמָר אֵפֶר עַל־רֹאשָׁהּ וּכְתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ קָרָעָה וַתָּשֶׂם יָדָהּ עַל־רֹאשָׁהּ וַתֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְזָעָקָה׃
verses.english: And Tamar put ashes on her head,while the ornamented tunic that was on her she tore;she put her hands on her headand went along, going along and crying out.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אַבְשָׁלוֹם אָחִיהָ הַאֲמִינוֹן אָחִיךְ הָיָה עִמָּךְ וְעַתָּה אֲחוֹתִי הַחֲרִישִׁי אָחִיךְ הוּא אַל־תָּשִׁיתִי אֶת־לִבֵּךְ לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַתֵּשֶׁב תָּמָר וְשֹׁמֵמָה בֵּית אַבְשָׁלוֹם אָחִיהָ׃
verses.english: Avshalom her brother said to her:Has Amnon your brother been with you?For now, sister, be silent—he is your brother;do not take this thing to heart!So Tamar stayed, desolate, in the house of Avshalom her brother.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד שָׁמַע אֵת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיִּחַר לוֹ מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Now when King David heard about all these things,he was exceedingly agitated.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־דִבֶּר אַבְשָׁלוֹם עִם־אַמְנוֹן לְמֵרָע וְעַד־טוֹב כִּי־שָׂנֵא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־אַמְנוֹן עַל־דְּבַר אֲשֶׁר עִנָּה אֵת תָּמָר אֲחֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: And Avshalom would not speak with Amnon, [anything] from evil to good,for Avshalom hated Amnon over the fact that he had forced Tamar his sister.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי לִשְׁנָתַיִם יָמִים וַיִּהְיוּ גֹזְזִים לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּבַעַל חָצוֹר אֲשֶׁר עִם־אֶפְרָיִם וַיִּקְרָא אַבְשָׁלוֹם לְכָל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Now it was at two-years’ timethat they were shearing [sheep] for Avshalom in Baal Hatzor that is near Efrayim,and Avshalom invited all the king’s sons.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־נָא גֹזְזִים לְעַבְדֶּךָ יֵלֶךְ־נָא הַמֶּלֶךְ וַעֲבָדָיו עִם־עַבְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Avshalom came to the kingand said:Now here, your servant is having shearing [done];now let the king and his servants go with your servant.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אַל־בְּנִי אַל־נָא נֵלֵךְ כֻּלָּנוּ וְלֹא נִכְבַּד עָלֶיךָ וַיִּפְרָץ־בּוֹ וְלֹא־אָבָה לָלֶכֶת וַיְבָרֲכֵהוּ׃
verses.english: The king said to Avshalom:No, my son, now we cannot go, all of us;let us not weigh-heavily on you!He pressed him, but he would not go,and he gave him farewell-blessing.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם וָלֹא יֵלֶךְ־נָא אִתָּנוּ אַמְנוֹן אָחִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה יֵלֵךְ עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: Avshalom said:If not, now let Amnon my brother go with us.The king said to him:Why should he go with you?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְרָץ־בּוֹ אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיִּשְׁלַח אִתּוֹ אֶת־אַמְנוֹן וְאֵת כָּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: But Avshalom pressed him,so he sent Amnon with him, along with all the king’s sons.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־נְעָרָיו לֵאמֹר רְאוּ נָא כְּטוֹב לֵב־אַמְנוֹן בַּיַּיִן וְאָמַרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם הַכּוּ אֶת־אַמְנוֹן וַהֲמִתֶּם אֹתוֹ אַל־תִּירָאוּ הֲלוֹא כִּי אָנֹכִי צִוִּיתִי אֶתְכֶם חִזְקוּ וִהְיוּ לִבְנֵי־חָיִל׃
verses.english: And Avshalom charged his serving-lads, saying:Now take note: when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine,and I say to you: Strike down Amnon!,then put him to death—do not be afraid!Have not I myself charged you?Be strong, be valiant ones!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ נַעֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם לְאַמְנוֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיָּקֻמוּ כָּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּרְכְּבוּ אִישׁ עַל־פִּרְדּוֹ וַיָּנֻסוּ׃
verses.english: So Avshalom’s lads did to Amnon as Avshalom had charged,and all the king’s sons arose and mounted each on his mule, and they fled.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הֵמָּה בַדֶּרֶךְ וְהַשְּׁמֻעָה בָאָה אֶל־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר הִכָּה אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־כָּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא־נוֹתַר מֵהֶם אֶחָד׃
verses.english: It was, when they were on the way,that the rumor came to David, namely:Avshalom has struck down all the king’s sons;not one of them is left!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיִּשְׁכַּב אָרְצָה וְכָל־עֲבָדָיו נִצָּבִים קְרֻעֵי בְגָדִים׃
verses.english: The king arose and tore his garments, and lay down on the ground,while all his servants stood [over him] with torn garments.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יוֹנָדָב בֶּן־שִׁמְעָה אֲחִי־דָוִד וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־יֹאמַר אֲדֹנִי אֵת כָּל־הַנְּעָרִים בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ הֵמִיתוּ כִּי־אַמְנוֹן לְבַדּוֹ מֵת כִּי־עַל־פִּי אַבְשָׁלוֹם הָיְתָה שׂוּמָה מִיּוֹם עַנֹּתוֹ אֵת תָּמָר אֲחֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: But Yonadav son of Shim’a, David’s brother, spoke up and said:Let not my lord think that all the lads, the king’s sons,have been put-to-death,for Amnon alone has died;for by Avshalom’s mouth it has been determined since the time of his forcing Tamar his sister.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אַל־יָשֵׂם אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־לִבּוֹ דָּבָר לֵאמֹר כָּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ מֵתוּ כִּי־אִם־אַמְנוֹן לְבַדּוֹ מֵת׃
verses.english: So-now,do not let the king take the matter to heart, saying: All the king’s sons have died,for Amnon alone has died,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיִּשָּׂא הַנַּעַר הַצֹּפֶה אֶת־עינו [עֵינָיו] וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה עַם־רַב הֹלְכִים מִדֶּרֶךְ אַחֲרָיו מִצַּד הָהָר׃
verses.english: and Avshalom has gotten away.And the serving-lad standing watch lifted up his eyes and saw:now here, many people were going away on the road behind him, from the side of the hill.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹנָדָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה בְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ בָּאוּ כִּדְבַר עַבְדְּךָ כֵּן הָיָה׃
verses.english: Yonadav said to the king:Here, the king’s sons have come;exactly as your servant’s word, so it was!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה בְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ בָּאוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ וְגַם־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל־עֲבָדָיו בָּכוּ בְּכִי גָּדוֹל מְאֹד׃
verses.english: And it was, when he finished speaking,that here, the king’s sons came;they lifted up their voices and wept,and also the king and all his servants wept, an exceedingly great weeping.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בָּרַח וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־תַּלְמַי בֶּן־עמיחור [עַמִּיהוּד] מֶלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל־בְּנוֹ כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: —Now Avshalom had gotten away;he had gone to Talmai son of Ammihud, king of Geshur.—And he mourned for his son all the days.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם בָּרַח וַיֵּלֶךְ גְּשׁוּר וַיְהִי־שָׁם שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: Now Avshalom had gotten away and gone to Geshur,and he was there for three years.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּכַל דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ לָצֵאת אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם כִּי־נִחַם עַל־אַמְנוֹן כִּי־מֵת׃
verses.english: Then the king’s spirit was spent for going out against) in Hebrew, and “David” (Heb. d-w-d) could easily be an orthographic error for “spirit” (r-w-h). Some interpreters feel that David really is pining for Avshalom, but, as Alter (1999) points out, in the next chapter the king refuses to see him. Avshalom,for he was consoled concerning Amnon, for he was dead.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרֻיָה כִּי־לֵב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: And Yoav son of Tzeruya knewthat the king’s heart was toward Avshalom,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יוֹאָב תְּקוֹעָה וַיִּקַּח מִשָּׁם אִשָּׁה חֲכָמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הִתְאַבְּלִי־נָא וְלִבְשִׁי־נָא בִגְדֵי־אֵבֶל וְאַל־תָּסוּכִי שֶׁמֶן וְהָיִית כְּאִשָּׁה זֶה יָמִים רַבִּים מִתְאַבֶּלֶת עַל־מֵת׃
verses.english: so Yoav sent to Tekoa;he fetched from there a worldly-wise womanand said to her:Pray feign-mourning, pray clothe yourself in garments of mourning;do not pour oil [on yourself],but be like a woman [who] these many days has been mourning over the dead.

verses.hebrew: וּבָאת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְדִבַּרְתְּ אֵלָיו כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיָּשֶׂם יוֹאָב אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים בְּפִיהָ׃
verses.english: You are to come to the kingand are to speak to him according to these words …And Yoav put the words in her mouth.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַתְּקֹעִית אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתִּפֹּל עַל־אַפֶּיהָ אַרְצָה וַתִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַתֹּאמֶר הוֹשִׁעָה הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: So the Tekoite woman talked to the king:she flung herself on her nostrils to the earth and bowed low,and said:Deliver [me], O king!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לָּךְ וַתֹּאמֶר אֲבָל אִשָּׁה־אַלְמָנָה אָנִי וַיָּמָת אִישִׁי׃
verses.english: The king said to her:What [ails] you?She said:Alas, I am a widow woman—my husband died.

verses.hebrew: וּלְשִׁפְחָתְךָ שְׁנֵי בָנִים וַיִּנָּצוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בַּשָּׂדֶה וְאֵין מַצִּיל בֵּינֵיהֶם וַיַּכּוֹ הָאֶחָד אֶת־הָאֶחָד וַיָּמֶת אֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: Now your handmaid had two sons,but the two of them scuffled in the open-field, with no rescuer between them;the one struck down the other-one and caused his death.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה קָמָה כָל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה עַל־שִׁפְחָתֶךָ וַיֹּאמְרוּ תְּנִי אֶת־מַכֵּה אָחִיו וּנְמִתֵהוּ בְּנֶפֶשׁ אָחִיו אֲשֶׁר הָרָג וְנַשְׁמִידָה גַּם אֶת־הַיּוֹרֵשׁ וְכִבּוּ אֶת־גַּחַלְתִּי אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאָרָה לְבִלְתִּי שום־[שִׂים־] לְאִישִׁי שֵׁם וּשְׁאֵרִית עַל־פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה׃
verses.english: And here, the whole clan has arisen against your handmaid and has said:Give over the one who struck down his brother,that we may put him to death for the life of his brother, whom he killed;we want to destroy [him]! Even the heir! his father’s heir, or that they want to kill him for the property as well (Alter 1999). So they will extinguish my ember that remains,providing no name or survivor for my husband on the face of the earth.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה לְכִי לְבֵיתֵךְ וַאֲנִי אֲצַוֶּה עָלָיִךְ׃
verses.english: The king said to the woman:Go back to your house,and I myself will issue-a-command regarding you.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַתְּקוֹעִית אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלַי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הֶעָוֺן וְעַל־בֵּית אָבִי וְהַמֶּלֶךְ וְכִסְאוֹ נָקִי׃
verses.english: The Tekoite woman said to the king:On me, my lord king, be the iniquity, and on my Father’s House,but the king and his throne are clear [of blame].

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַמְדַבֵּר אֵלַיִךְ וַהֲבֵאתוֹ אֵלַי וְלֹא־יֹסִיף עוֹד לָגַעַת בָּךְ׃
verses.english: The king said:The one who speaks [amiss] to you, have him brought to me—he will not continue to harm you!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר יִזְכָּר־נָא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מהרבית [מֵהַרְבַּת] גֹּאֵל הַדָּם לְשַׁחֵת וְלֹא יַשְׁמִידוּ אֶת־בְּנִי וַיֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהוָה אִם־יִפֹּל מִשַּׂעֲרַת בְּנֵךְ אָרְצָה׃
verses.english: She said:Pray let the king be mindful of YHWH your God—too much might the blood redeemer bring-ruin—so that they do not destroy my son!He said:By the life of YHWH,if a hair of your son should fall to the ground … !

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה תְּדַבֶּר־נָא שִׁפְחָתְךָ אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר וַיֹּאמֶר דַּבֵּרִי׃
verses.english: Then the woman said:Pray let your handmaid speak a word to my lord king.He said:Speak.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה וְלָמָּה חָשַׁבְתָּה כָּזֹאת עַל־עַם אֱלֹהִים וּמִדַּבֵּר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כְּאָשֵׁם לְבִלְתִּי הָשִׁיב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־נִדְּחוֹ׃
verses.english: The woman said:Now why have you planned in this way against God’s people?By the king speaking this word, [he is] as one guilty,by not letting his banished one return.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־מוֹת נָמוּת וְכַמַּיִם הַנִּגָּרִים אַרְצָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא יֵאָסֵפוּ וְלֹא־יִשָּׂא אֱלֹהִים נֶפֶשׁ וְחָשַׁב מַחֲשָׁבוֹת לְבִלְתִּי יִדַּח מִמֶּנּוּ נִדָּח׃
verses.english: For we will die, yes, die,like water running on the ground, which cannot be gathered up.But God will not carry a life away;he will plan plans, to not keep the banished one banished from him.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתִי לְדַבֵּר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲדֹנִי אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה כִּי יֵרְאֻנִי הָעָם וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁפְחָתְךָ אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אוּלַי יַעֲשֶׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דְּבַר אֲמָתוֹ׃
verses.english: So-now,[the reason] that I have come to speak this word to the king, my lord,is that the people made me afraid.Your handmaid said [to herself]: Let me now speak to the king;perhaps the king will act on his maidservant’s word.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִשְׁמַע הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהַצִּיל אֶת־אֲמָתוֹ מִכַּף הָאִישׁ לְהַשְׁמִיד אֹתִי וְאֶת־בְּנִי יַחַד מִנַּחֲלַת אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Indeed, the king will hearkento rescue his maidservant from the grasp of the [avenging] man,from destroying me and my son together, away from God’s inheritance.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁפְחָתְךָ יִהְיֶה־נָּא דְּבַר־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לִמְנוּחָה כִּי כְּמַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים כֵּן אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לִשְׁמֹעַ הַטּוֹב וְהָרָע וַיהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יְהִי עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: And your handmaid said [to herself]:Now may the word of my lord king be for [my] rest,for like a messenger of God, so is my lord king,to hear out the good and the evil—may YHWH your God be with you!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה אַל־נָא תְכַחֲדִי מִמֶּנִּי דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי שֹׁאֵל אֹתָךְ וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה יְדַבֶּר־נָא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: The king answered, he said to the woman:Do not conceal from me a thing that I ask of you!The woman said:Pray let my lord king speak.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ הֲיַד יוֹאָב אִתָּךְ בְּכָל־זֹאת וַתַּעַן הָאִשָּׁה וַתֹּאמֶר חֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־אִשׁ לְהֵמִין וּלְהַשְׂמִיל מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־עַבְדְּךָ יוֹאָב הוּא צִוָּנִי וְהוּא שָׂם בְּפִי שִׁפְחָתְךָ אֵת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: The king said:Is the hand of Yoav with you in all this?The woman answered and said:By your life, my lord king,there is no turning-right or turning-left from all that my lord king has spoken;indeed, your servant Yoav himself commanded me—he himself put in the mouth of your handmaid all these words.

verses.hebrew: לְבַעֲבוּר סַבֵּב אֶת־פְּנֵי הַדָּבָר עָשָׂה עַבְדְּךָ יוֹאָב אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַאדֹנִי חָכָם כְּחָכְמַת מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים לָדַעַת אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: In order to reverse the face of the matterdid your servant Yoav do this thing;but my lord is wise,like the wisdom of a messenger of God,to know all that is on earth!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יוֹאָב הִנֵּה־נָא עָשִׂיתִי אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וְלֵךְ הָשֵׁב אֶת־הַנַּעַר אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: Then the king said to Yoav:Here now, I have done this thing.So go, return the lad Avshalom!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֹּל יוֹאָב אֶל־פָּנָיו אַרְצָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ וַיְבָרֶךְ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב הַיּוֹם יָדַע עַבְדְּךָ כִּי־מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דְּבַר עבדו [עַבְדֶּךָ׃]
verses.english: Yoav flung himself on his face to the ground and bowed low, and he blessed the king;Yoav said:Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your eyes, my lord king,[given] that the king has acted upon your servant’s word!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם יוֹאָב וַיֵּלֶךְ גְּשׁוּרָה וַיָּבֵא אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: And Yoav arose and went to Geshur,and he brought Avshalom to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ יִסֹּב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וּפָנַי לֹא יִרְאֶה וַיִּסֹּב אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וּפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא רָאָה׃
verses.english: The king said:Let him turn round to his house,but my face he is not to see!So Avshalom turned to his house,but the king’s face he did not see.

verses.hebrew: וּכְאַבְשָׁלוֹם לֹא־הָיָה אִישׁ־יָפֶה בְּכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַלֵּל מְאֹד מִכַּף רַגְלוֹ וְעַד קָדְקֳדוֹ לֹא־הָיָה בוֹ מוּם׃
verses.english: Now like Avshalom there was no man as beautiful throughout all Israel, so exceedingly to be praised;from the sole of his foot to his crown,there was no defect in him.

verses.hebrew: וּבְגַלְּחוֹ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וְהָיָה מִקֵּץ יָמִים לַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר יְגַלֵּחַ כִּי־כָבֵד עָלָיו וְגִלְּחוֹ וְשָׁקַל אֶת־שְׂעַר רֹאשׁוֹ מָאתַיִם שְׁקָלִים בְּאֶבֶן הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: When he shaved his head—it used to be that at the end of the year, [every] year,he would shave it, for it was heavy upon him and [he had] to shave it—he would weigh the hair of his head: two hundred shekel-weights, by the king’s [weighing-]stone.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּלְדוּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם שְׁלוֹשָׁה בָנִים וּבַת אַחַת וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר הִיא הָיְתָה אִשָּׁה יְפַת מַרְאֶה׃
verses.english: And there were born to Avshalom three sons and one daughter, whose name was Tamar;she was a woman beautiful of appearance.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב אַבְשָׁלוֹם בִּירוּשָׁלִַם שְׁנָתַיִם יָמִים וּפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לֹא רָאָה׃
verses.english: And Avshalom stayed in Jerusalem for two-years’ time,but the king’s face he did not see.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־יוֹאָב לִשְׁלֹחַ אֹתוֹ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא אָבָה לָבוֹא אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁלַח עוֹד שֵׁנִית וְלֹא אָבָה לָבוֹא׃
verses.english: So Avshalom sent to Yoav, to send him to the king,but he would not come to him.He sent again, a second-time,but he would not come.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו רְאוּ חֶלְקַת יוֹאָב אֶל־יָדִי וְלוֹ־שָׁם שְׂעֹרִים לְכוּ והוצתיה [וְהַצִּיתוּהָ] בָאֵשׁ וַיַּצִּתוּ עַבְדֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־הַחֶלְקָה בָּאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: So he said to his servants:See, Yoav’s plot is near me, and he has barley there;go, kindle it with fire!And Avshalom’s servants kindled the plot with fire.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם יוֹאָב וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם הַבָּיְתָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לָמָּה הִצִּיתוּ עֲבָדֶךָ אֶת־הַחֶלְקָה אֲשֶׁר־לִי בָּאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: And Yoav arose and came to Avshalom at the house;he said to him:Why did your servants kindle the plot that belongs to me with fire?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־יוֹאָב הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר בֹּא הֵנָּה וְאֶשְׁלְחָה אֹתְךָ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר לָמָּה בָּאתִי מִגְּשׁוּר טוֹב לִי עֹד אֲנִי־שָׁם וְעַתָּה אֶרְאֶה פְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאִם־יֶשׁ־בִּי עָוֺן וֶהֱמִתָנִי׃
verses.english: Avshalom said to Yoav:Here, I had sent [word] to you, saying:Come here, I wish to send you to the king, to say:Why did I come back from Geshur?It would have been better for me [if] I were still there!So-now,let me see the king’s face,and if there be any iniquity in me, let him put me to death!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לוֹ עַל־אַפָּיו אַרְצָה לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשַּׁק הַמֶּלֶךְ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: So Yoav came to the king and told him,and he called for Avshalom;he came to the king and bowed low to him, on his nostrils to the earth, before the king,and the king kissed Avshalom.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מֵאַחֲרֵי כֵן וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ אַבְשָׁלוֹם מֶרְכָּבָה וְסֻסִים וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ רָצִים לְפָנָיו׃
verses.english: It was, [some time] after this,that Avshalom prepared himself a chariot and horses,with fifty men running before him.

verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁכִּים אַבְשָׁלוֹם וְעָמַד עַל־יַד דֶּרֶךְ הַשָּׁעַר וַיְהִי כָּל־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ־רִיב לָבוֹא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לַמִּשְׁפָּט וַיִּקְרָא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֵי־מִזֶּה עִיר אַתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר מֵאַחַד שִׁבְטֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: And Avshalom would start-early;he would stand by the road of the main-gate,and it was that everyone who had a case-for-quarrel coming before the king, for judgment,Avshalom would call to him, and would say:From what town are you?And he would say:From a certain one of the tribes of Israel is your servant.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אַבְשָׁלוֹם רְאֵה דְבָרֶךָ טוֹבִים וּנְכֹחִים וְשֹׁמֵעַ אֵין־לְךָ מֵאֵת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Then Avshalom would say to him:See, your words are good and correct,but you have no one to hear on the part of the king!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם מִי־יְשִׂמֵנִי שֹׁפֵט בָּאָרֶץ וְעָלַי יָבוֹא כָּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ־רִיב וּמִשְׁפָּט וְהִצְדַּקְתִּיו׃
verses.english: And Avshalom said:O who would make me judge in the land,[that] every man might come to me who had a case-for-quarrel or a matter-for-judgment—I would declare him in the right!

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בִּקְרָב־אִישׁ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לוֹ וְשָׁלַח אֶת־יָדוֹ וְהֶחֱזִיק לוֹ וְנָשַׁק לוֹ׃
verses.english: So it would be, when a man would come near, to bow low to him,that he would stretch out his hand and take hold of him, and kiss him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אַבְשָׁלוֹם כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹאוּ לַמִּשְׁפָּט אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְגַנֵּב אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־לֵב אַנְשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And Avshalom did according to this matter for all Israel who would come for adjudication to the king;thus Avshalom stole away the heart of the men of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלֲכָה נָּא וַאֲשַׁלֵּם אֶת־נִדְרִי אֲשֶׁר־נָדַרְתִּי לַיהוָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃
verses.english: It was at the end of four years, that Avshalom said to the king:Now let me go, that I may pay my vow that I vowed to YHWH in Hevron,

verses.hebrew: כִּי־נֵדֶר נָדַר עַבְדְּךָ בְּשִׁבְתִּי בִגְשׁוּר בַּאֲרָם לֵאמֹר אִם־ישיב [יָשׁוֹב] יְשִׁיבֵנִי יְהוָה יְרוּשָׁלִַם וְעָבַדְתִּי אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: for your servant vowed a vow when I stayed at Geshur in Aram, saying:If YHWH will let me return, yes, return to Jerusalem,I will serve YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵךְ בְּשָׁלוֹם וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלֶךְ חֶבְרוֹנָה׃
verses.english: The king said to him:Go in peace.So he arose and went to Hevron.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם מְרַגְּלִים בְּכָל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כְּשָׁמְעֲכֶם אֶת־קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר וַאֲמַרְתֶּם מָלַךְ אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּחֶבְרוֹן׃
verses.english: And Avshalom sent spy-runners, “foot” (see Gen. 42:9). throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying:When you hear the sound of the shofar, you are to say:Avshalom reigns as king in Hevron!

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם הָלְכוּ מָאתַיִם אִישׁ מִירוּשָׁלִַם קְרֻאִים וְהֹלְכִים לְתֻמָּם וְלֹא יָדְעוּ כָּל־דָּבָר׃
verses.english: Now with Avshalom went two hundred men from Jerusalem,invited-guests, going in their innocence—they did not know anything.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־אֲחִיתֹפֶל הַגִּילֹנִי יוֹעֵץ דָּוִד מֵעִירוֹ מִגִּלֹה בְּזָבְחוֹ אֶת־הַזְּבָחִים וַיְהִי הַקֶּשֶׁר אַמִּץ וְהָעָם הוֹלֵךְ וָרָב אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: And Avshalom sent for Ahitofel. The meaning of the name is unclear, but it seems a bit like the word for “folly” (Heb. t-p-l). the Gilonite, David’s adviser, from his town, from Gilo,when he was sacrificing sacrifices.Now the banding-in-conspiracy was powerful,and the people with Avshalom went on [and on] becoming many.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמַּגִּיד אֶל־דָּוִד לֵאמֹר הָיָה לֶב־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: And a message-teller came to David, saying:The heart of the men of Israel [inclines] after Avshalom!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לְכָל־עֲבָדָיו אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ בִירוּשָׁלִַם קוּמוּ וְנִבְרָחָה כִּי לֹא־תִהְיֶה־לָּנוּ פְלֵיטָה מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם מַהֲרוּ לָלֶכֶת פֶּן־יְמַהֵר וְהִשִּׂגָנוּ וְהִדִּיחַ עָלֵינוּ אֶת־הָרָעָה וְהִכָּה הָעִיר לְפִי־חָרֶב׃
verses.english: So David said to all his servants who were with him in Jerusalem:Arise, let us get away,for we will have no remnant [left] before Avshalom!Hurry and go,lest he hurry and overtake us and push evil (“the evil/misfortune”) as ha-’ir (“the city”), thus “push the city down upon us,” following McCarter (1984). upon usand strike the city with the mouth of the sword!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ עַבְדֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה עֲבָדֶיךָ׃
verses.english: The king’s servants said to the king:Just as my lord king chooses, here are your servants!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל־בֵּיתוֹ בְּרַגְלָיו וַיַּעֲזֹב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת עֶשֶׂר נָשִׁים פִּלַגְשִׁים לִשְׁמֹר הַבָּיִת׃
verses.english: So the king and all his household went off on foot,and the king left ten concubine women to guard the palace-house.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל־הָעָם בְּרַגְלָיו וַיַּעַמְדוּ בֵּית הַמֶּרְחָק׃
verses.english: And when the king and all the fighting-people went off on foot,they stopped at the Far House.

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־עֲבָדָיו עֹבְרִים עַל־יָדוֹ וְכָל־הַכְּרֵתִי וְכָל־הַפְּלֵתִי וְכָל־הַגִּתִּים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ בְרַגְלוֹ מִגַּת עֹבְרִים עַל־פְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Now all his servants were crossing over next to him,while all the Kereitites and all the Peleitites and all the Gittites,six hundred men who came on foot from Gat,were crossing over in front of the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אִתַּי הַגִּתִּי לָמָּה תֵלֵךְ גַּם־אַתָּה אִתָּנוּ שׁוּב וְשֵׁב עִם־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־נָכְרִי אַתָּה וְגַם־גֹּלֶה אַתָּה לִמְקוֹמֶךָ׃
verses.english: The king said to Ittai. It sounds like the phrase “with me” (Heb. itti), appropriate in a passage about loyalty (Garsiel 1985, Polzin 1993). the Gittite:Why will you go, even you, with us?Return and stay with the king,for you are a foreigner, and also you are an exile from your [own] place.

verses.hebrew: תְּמוֹל בּוֹאֶךָ וְהַיּוֹם אנועך [אֲנִיעֲךָ] עִמָּנוּ לָלֶכֶת וַאֲנִי הוֹלֵךְ עַל אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי הוֹלֵךְ שׁוּב וְהָשֵׁב אֶת־אַחֶיךָ עִמָּךְ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃
verses.english: [Just] yesterday was your coming,so today, should I make you wander with us, in [our] going-forth?I am going wherever I am going;return, and have your brothers return with you,in loyalty and faithfulness!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִתַּי אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמַר חַי־יְהוָה וְחֵי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי אִם־בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה־שָּׁם אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־לְמָוֶת אִם־לְחַיִּים כִּי־שָׁם יִהְיֶה עַבְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Ittai answered the king, he said:By the life of YHWH lives and by the life of my lord king,only in the place where my lord king is, whether for death or for life—indeed, there your servant will be!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אִתַּי לֵךְ וַעֲבֹר וַיַּעֲבֹר אִתַּי הַגִּתִּי וְכָל־אֲנָשָׁיו וְכָל־הַטַּף אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃
verses.english: David said to Ittai:Go, cross over!So Ittai the Gittite and all his men and all the families may include children and old people—namely, stragglers or dependents. who were with him crossed over.

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הָאָרֶץ בּוֹכִים קוֹל גָּדוֹל וְכָל־הָעָם עֹבְרִים וְהַמֶּלֶךְ עֹבֵר בְּנַחַל קִדְרוֹן וְכָל־הָעָם עֹבְרִים עַל־פְּנֵי־דֶרֶךְ אֶת־הַמִּדְבָּר׃
verses.english: Now the entire region was weeping in a great voice while all the fighting-people were crossing over,while the king was crossing Wadi Kidron,and while all the fighting-people were crossing over, facing the road to the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה גַם־צָדוֹק וְכָל־הַלְוִיִּם אִתּוֹ נֹשְׂאִים אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּצִּקוּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים וַיַּעַל אֶבְיָתָר עַד־תֹּם כָּל־הָעָם לַעֲבוֹר מִן־הָעִיר׃
verses.english: And here: also Tzadok and all the Levites with him were carrying the Coffer of the Covenant of God;they set down for MT va-yatziku, “poured out” (see McCarter 1984). the Coffer of God, and Evyatar also went up,until all the people had completed crossing away from the city.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְצָדוֹק הָשֵׁב אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים הָעִיר אִם־אֶמְצָא חֵן בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וֶהֱשִׁבַנִי וְהִרְאַנִי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־נָוֵהוּ׃
verses.english: The king said to Tzadok:Return the Coffer of God to the city;if I find favor in YHWH’s eyes,he will let me return and let me see it, along with his abode.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם כֹּה יֹאמַר לֹא חָפַצְתִּי בָּךְ הִנְנִי יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר טוֹב בְּעֵינָיו׃
verses.english: If thus he says: I am not pleased with you,here I am—let him do with me as is good in his eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן הֲרוֹאֶה אַתָּה שֻׁבָה הָעִיר בְּשָׁלוֹם וַאֲחִימַעַץ בִּנְךָ וִיהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר שְׁנֵי בְנֵיכֶם אִתְּכֶם׃
verses.english: And the king said [further] to Tzadok the priest:Are you a seer?Return to the city in peace,along with Ahimaatz your son and Yehonatan son of Evyatar—your two sons with you [both].

verses.hebrew: רְאוּ אָנֹכִי מִתְמַהְמֵהַּ בעברות [בְּעַרְבוֹת] הַמִּדְבָּר עַד בּוֹא דָבָר מֵעִמָּכֶם לְהַגִּיד לִי׃
verses.english: See, I myself will tarry at the plains in the wildernessuntil word comes from you, telling me [something].

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב צָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר אֶת־אֲרוֹן הָאֱלֹהִים יְרוּשָׁלִָם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם׃
verses.english: So Tzadok and Evyatar returned the Coffer of God to Jerusalem,and they stayed there.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד עֹלֶה בְמַעֲלֵה הַזֵּיתִים עֹלֶה וּבוֹכֶה וְרֹאשׁ לוֹ חָפוּי וְהוּא הֹלֵךְ יָחֵף וְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ חָפוּ אִישׁ רֹאשׁוֹ וְעָלוּ עָלֹה וּבָכֹה׃
verses.english: But David was going up the Ascent of Olives, going up and weeping;his head was covered and he was walking barefoot,while all the people who were with him covered each one his head,and were going up, going up and weeping.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד הִגִּיד לֵאמֹר אֲחִיתֹפֶל בַּקֹּשְׁרִים עִם־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד סַכֶּל־נָא אֶת־עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Now David was told, saying:Ahitofel is among those banding together with Avshalom!David said:Pray make-foolish Ahitofel’s advice, O YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי דָוִד בָּא עַד־הָרֹאשׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה שָׁם לֵאלֹהִים וְהִנֵּה לִקְרָאתוֹ חוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי קָרוּעַ כֻּתָּנְתּוֹ וַאֲדָמָה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: Now it was, when David was coming to the summit, where [they] would bow down to God,that here, [coming] to meet him was Hushai the Arkite, his tunic torn and earth on his head.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ דָּוִד אִם עָבַרְתָּ אִתִּי וְהָיִתָ עָלַי לְמַשָּׂא׃
verses.english: David said to him:If you cross over with me,you will be a burden to me,

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־הָעִיר תָּשׁוּב וְאָמַרְתָּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם עַבְדְּךָ אֲנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶהְיֶה עֶבֶד אָבִיךָ וַאֲנִי מֵאָז וְעַתָּה וַאֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ וְהֵפַרְתָּה לִי אֵת עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל׃
verses.english: but if you return to the cityand say to Avshalom: Your servant O king, will I be—servant to your father was I formerly,but now I am your servant!—then you may annul Ahitofel’s advice for me.

verses.hebrew: וַהֲלוֹא עִמְּךָ שָׁם צָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהָיָה כָּל־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמַע מִבֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ תַּגִּיד לְצָדוֹק וּלְאֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים׃
verses.english: Will not Tzadok and Evyatar, the priests, be with you there?It will bethat all the words that you hear from the king’s house, you are to tell to Tzadok and Evyatar the priests;

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־שָׁם עִמָּם שְׁנֵי בְנֵיהֶם אֲחִימַעַץ לְצָדוֹק וִיהוֹנָתָן לְאֶבְיָתָר וּשְׁלַחְתֶּם בְּיָדָם אֵלַי כָּל־דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמָעוּ׃
verses.english: here, their two sons, Ahimaatz of Tzadok and Yehonatan of Evyatar, are there with them;you are to send by their hand to me any word that you hear.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא חוּשַׁי רֵעֶה דָוִד הָעִיר וְאַבְשָׁלֹם יָבֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: So Hushai the Friend of David entered the city[just] as Avshalom was about to enter Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד עָבַר מְעַט מֵהָרֹאשׁ וְהִנֵּה צִיבָא נַעַר מְפִי־בֹשֶׁת לִקְרָאתוֹ וְצֶמֶד חֲמֹרִים חֲבֻשִׁים וַעֲלֵיהֶם מָאתַיִם לֶחֶם וּמֵאָה צִמּוּקִים וּמֵאָה קַיִץ וְנֵבֶל יָיִן׃
verses.english: Now David had crossed a little beyond the summitwhen here: Tziva, Mefiboshet’s retainer, elsewhere “serving-lad” or “fighting-lad,” but here signifying someone older., [was coming] to meet him,along with a brace of saddled donkeys,and on them were two hundred bread-loaves, a hundred raisin-cakes, a hundred fig-cakes, and a skin of wine.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־צִיבָא מָה־אֵלֶּה לָּךְ וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא הַחֲמוֹרִים לְבֵית־הַמֶּלֶךְ לִרְכֹּב ולהלחם [וְהַלֶּחֶם] וְהַקַּיִץ לֶאֱכוֹל הַנְּעָרִים וְהַיַּיִן לִשְׁתּוֹת הַיָּעֵף בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
verses.english: The king said to Tziva:What do you [mean] with these?Tziva said:The donkeys are for the king’s household, for riding,the bread and the figs are for eating by the lads,and the wine is for drinking by those weary in the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאַיֵּה בֶּן־אֲדֹנֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הִנֵּה יוֹשֵׁב בִּירוּשָׁלִַם כִּי אָמַר הַיּוֹם יָשִׁיבוּ לִי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת מַמְלְכוּת אָבִי׃
verses.english: The king said:And where is your lord’s son?Tziva said to the king:Here, he is sitting in Jerusalem,for he says [to himself]: Today the House of Israel will return my father’s kingdom to me!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ לְצִבָא הִנֵּה לְךָ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר לִמְפִי־בֹשֶׁת וַיֹּאמֶר צִיבָא הִשְׁתַּחֲוֵיתִי אֶמְצָא־חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: The king said to Tziva:Here, yours is all that was Mefiboshet’s.Tziva said:I bow down!May I find favor in your eyes, O my lord king!

verses.hebrew: וּבָא הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד עַד־בַּחוּרִים וְהִנֵּה מִשָּׁם אִישׁ יוֹצֵא מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת בֵּית־שָׁאוּל וּשְׁמוֹ שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא יֹצֵא יָצוֹא וּמְקַלֵּל׃
verses.english: Now when King David came to Bahurim,here, a man was going out from there, from the clan of the House of Sha’ul;his name was Shim’i trad. English “Shimei.” son of Gera.He was going out, going out and cursing—

verses.hebrew: וַיְסַקֵּל בָּאֲבָנִים אֶת־דָּוִד וְאֶת־כָּל־עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וְכָל־הָעָם וְכָל־הַגִּבֹּרִים מִימִינוֹ וּמִשְּׂמֹאלוֹ׃
verses.english: and he pelted David with stones, and all of King David’s court-servants,along with all the fighting-people and all the mighty-men to his right and to his left.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹה־אָמַר שִׁמְעִי בְּקַלְלוֹ צֵא צֵא אִישׁ הַדָּמִים וְאִישׁ הַבְּלִיָּעַל׃
verses.english: And thus did Shim’i say when he cursed him:Get out, get out, [you] bloodguilty man instead of dam); B-R translate as “man of bloody deeds.”, [you] base man!

verses.hebrew: הֵשִׁיב עָלֶיךָ יְהוָה כֹּל דְּמֵי בֵית־שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר מָלַכְתָּ תחתו [תַּחְתָּיו] וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָה בְּיַד אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנֶךָ וְהִנְּךָ בְּרָעָתֶךָ כִּי אִישׁ דָּמִים אָתָּה׃
verses.english: YHWH has returned upon you all the bloodguilt of the House of Sha’ul, in whose place you reign as king,and YHWH has given the kingdom into the hand of Avshalom your son,for here, you are in your evil-fate,for you are a bloodguilty man!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה יְקַלֵּל הַכֶּלֶב הַמֵּת הַזֶּה אֶת־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶעְבְּרָה־נָּא וְאָסִירָה אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: Avishai son of Tzeruya said to the king:Why should this dead dog curse my lord king?Now let me cross over and take off his head!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לִּי וְלָכֶם בְּנֵי צְרֻיָה כי [כֹּה] יְקַלֵּל וכי [כִּי] יְהוָה אָמַר לוֹ קַלֵּל אֶת־דָּוִד וּמִי יֹאמַר מַדּוּעַ עָשִׂיתָה כֵּן׃
verses.english: But the king said:What is there [in common] between me and you, O sons of Tzeruya?Let him curse, for if YHWH says to him: Curse David,who is to say: For-what-reason do you do thus?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֲבִישַׁי וְאֶל־כָּל־עֲבָדָיו הִנֵּה בְנִי אֲשֶׁר־יָצָא מִמֵּעַי מְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־נַפְשִׁי וְאַף כִּי־עַתָּה בֶּן־הַיְמִינִי הַנִּחוּ לוֹ וִיקַלֵּל כִּי אָמַר־לוֹ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And David said to Avishai and to all his servants:Here, my [own] son, who came out of my body, is seeking my life;how much more, then, the Binyaminite!Let him be, that he may curse,for YHWH told him to.

verses.hebrew: אוּלַי יִרְאֶה יְהוָה בעוני [בְּעֵינִי] וְהֵשִׁיב יְהוָה לִי טוֹבָה תַּחַת קִלְלָתוֹ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Perhaps YHWH will look on my afflictionand YHWH will return me good in place of his curses on this day!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו בַּדָּרֶךְ וְשִׁמְעִי הֹלֵךְ בְּצֵלַע הָהָר לְעֻמָּתוֹ הָלוֹךְ וַיְקַלֵּל וַיְסַקֵּל בָּאֲבָנִים לְעֻמָּתוֹ וְעִפַּר בֶּעָפָר׃
verses.english: David and his men went on the way;but Shim’i was going along the side of the hill, next to him,going along and cursing and pelting [him] with stones next to himand dumping dust). [on him].

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ עֲיֵפִים וַיִּנָּפֵשׁ שָׁם׃
verses.english: And the king and all the people that were with him came back weary,and they paused-for-breath there.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וְכָל־הָעָם אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָם וַאֲחִיתֹפֶל אִתּוֹ׃
verses.english: Now Avshalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem,and Ahitofel was with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא חוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי רֵעֶה דָוִד אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אֶל־אַבְשָׁלֹם יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: And it was, when Hushai the Arkite, David’s Friend, came to Avshalom,that Hushai said to Avshalom:May the king live! May the king live!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־חוּשַׁי זֶה חַסְדְּךָ אֶת־רֵעֶךָ לָמָּה לֹא־הָלַכְתָּ אֶת־רֵעֶךָ׃
verses.english: Avshalom said to Hushai:Is this your loyalty to your friend?Why didn’t you go with your friend?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אֶל־אַבְשָׁלֹם לֹא כִּי אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר יְהוָה וְהָעָם הַזֶּה וְכָל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל לא [לוֹ] אֶהְיֶה וְאִתּוֹ אֵשֵׁב׃
verses.english: Hushai said to Avshalom:No—rather, the one whom YHWH and his people, all the men of Israel, have chosen,for him I will be, and with him I will stay!

verses.hebrew: וְהַשֵּׁנִית לְמִי אֲנִי אֶעֱבֹד הֲלוֹא לִפְנֵי בְנוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָבַדְתִּי לִפְנֵי אָבִיךָ כֵּן אֶהְיֶה לְפָנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: And second, whom should I serve, if not in the presence of his son?As I served in the presence of your father,so I will serve in your presence.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־אֲחִיתֹפֶל הָבוּ לָכֶם עֵצָה מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה׃
verses.english: Avshalom said to Ahitofel:Give advice, [both of] you—what should we do?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחִיתֹפֶל אֶל־אַבְשָׁלֹם בּוֹא אֶל־פִּלַגְשֵׁי אָבִיךָ אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ לִשְׁמוֹר הַבָּיִת וְשָׁמַע כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־נִבְאַשְׁתָּ אֶת־אָבִיךָ וְחָזְקוּ יְדֵי כָּל־אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ׃
verses.english: Ahitofel said to Avshalom:Come in to your father’s concubines, whom he left to guard the palace-house;when all Israel hears that you have made yourself reek to your father,then the hands of all who are with you will be strengthened.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּטּוּ לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם הָאֹהֶל עַל־הַגָּג וַיָּבֹא אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־פִּלַגְשֵׁי אָבִיו לְעֵינֵי כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: So they spread out a tent for Avshalom on the roof,and Avshalom came in to his father’s concubines, before the eyes of all Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל אֲשֶׁר יָעַץ בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם כַּאֲשֶׁר יִשְׁאַל־[אִישׁ] בִּדְבַר הָאֱלֹהִים כֵּן כָּל־עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל גַּם־לְדָוִד גַּם לְאַבְשָׁלֹם׃
verses.english: Now the advice of Ahitofel which he advisedwas in those days like inquiring of the word of God;thus was all of Ahitofel’s advice, so for David, so for Avshalom.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחִיתֹפֶל אֶל־אַבְשָׁלֹם אֶבְחֲרָה נָּא שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף אִישׁ וְאָקוּמָה וְאֶרְדְּפָה אַחֲרֵי־דָוִד הַלָּיְלָה׃
verses.english: Ahitofel said to Avshalom:Pray let me choose twelve thousand men,and let me arise and pursue after David tonight.

verses.hebrew: וְאָבוֹא עָלָיו וְהוּא יָגֵעַ וּרְפֵה יָדַיִם וְהַחֲרַדְתִּי אֹתוֹ וְנָס כָּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבַדּוֹ׃
verses.english: When I come upon himand he is weary and slack of hands,I will alarm him,so that all the people that are with him will flee.Then I will strike down the king alone,

verses.hebrew: וְאָשִׁיבָה כָל־הָעָם אֵלֶיךָ כְּשׁוּב הַכֹּל הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ כָּל־הָעָם יִהְיֶה שָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: and I will return all the people to you,[so that] when all are returned—the man whom you seek and all the fighting-people—there will be peace.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּישַׁר הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי אַבְשָׁלֹם וּבְעֵינֵי כָּל־זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: The word was right in Avshalom’s eyesand in the eyes of all the elders of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם קְרָא נָא גַּם לְחוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי וְנִשְׁמְעָה מַה־בְּפִיו גַּם־הוּא׃
verses.english: But Avshalom said:Pray call as well Hushai the Arkite;we will hear what is in his mouth, his as well.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא חוּשַׁי אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה דִּבֶּר אֲחִיתֹפֶל הֲנַעֲשֶׂה אֶת־דְּבָרוֹ אִם־אַיִן אַתָּה דַבֵּר׃
verses.english: And Hushai came to Avshalom, and Avshalom said to him, saying:In accordance with this word did Ahitofel speak;shall we act on his word?Or not? You speak!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם לֹא־טוֹבָה הָעֵצָה אֲשֶׁר־יָעַץ אֲחִיתֹפֶל בַּפַּעַם הַזֹּאת׃
verses.english: Hushai said to Avshalom:Not good is the advice that Ahitofel has advised this time.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֶת־אָבִיךָ וְאֶת־אֲנָשָׁיו כִּי גִבֹּרִים הֵמָּה וּמָרֵי נֶפֶשׁ הֵמָּה כְּדֹב שַׁכּוּל בַּשָּׂדֶה וְאָבִיךָ אִישׁ מִלְחָמָה וְלֹא יָלִין אֶת־הָעָם׃
verses.english: And Hushai said [further]:You yourself know your father and his men,that they are mighty ones,and that they are bitter of feelings,like a bear bereaved in the open-field,and your father is a man of battle—he will not spend-the-night with the people.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עַתָּה הוּא־נֶחְבָּא בְּאַחַת הַפְּחָתִים אוֹ בְּאַחַד הַמְּקוֹמֹת וְהָיָה כִּנְפֹל בָּהֶם בַּתְּחִלָּה וְשָׁמַע הַשֹּׁמֵעַ וְאָמַר הָיְתָה מַגֵּפָה בָּעָם אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי אַבְשָׁלֹם׃
verses.english: Here now,he is hiding in one of the pits or in one of the halting-places;and it will bewhen fighting-people fall at the start [of battle],and a hearer hears and says:There has been a defeat for the people who [follow] after Avshalom—

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא גַם־בֶּן־חַיִל אֲשֶׁר לִבּוֹ כְּלֵב הָאַרְיֵה הִמֵּס יִמָּס כִּי־יֹדֵעַ כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־גִבּוֹר אָבִיךָ וּבְנֵי־חַיִל אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃
verses.english: that even if he be a valiant one,whose heart is like the heart of a lion,he will melt, melt away [in fear].For all Israel knows that your father is a mighty-man,and valiant ones are with him!

verses.hebrew: כִּי יָעַצְתִּי הֵאָסֹף יֵאָסֵף עָלֶיךָ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַיָּם לָרֹב וּפָנֶיךָ הֹלְכִים בַּקְרָב׃
verses.english: So I advise:let all Israel be gathered, yes, gathered to you, from Dan to Be’er-Sheva,like the sand that is by the sea in abundance,with your presence walking among them.

verses.hebrew: וּבָאנוּ אֵלָיו באחת [בְּאַחַד] הַמְּקוֹמֹת אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא שָׁם וְנַחְנוּ עָלָיו כַּאֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל הַטַּל עַל־הָאֲדָמָה וְלֹא־נוֹתַר בּוֹ וּבְכָל־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ גַּם־אֶחָד׃
verses.english: We will come upon himin one of the places where he can be found,and light upon him as dew falls upon the ground;there will not be left to him, or to all the men that are with him, even one.

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־אֶל־עִיר יֵאָסֵף וְהִשִּׂיאוּ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הָעִיר הַהִיא חֲבָלִים וְסָחַבְנוּ אֹתוֹ עַד־הַנַּחַל עַד אֲשֶׁר־לֹא־נִמְצָא שָׁם גַּם־צְרוֹר׃
verses.english: Now if he gathers himself into a town,then let all Israel bring ropes into that townand let us drag it, as far as the wadi, until even a pebble cannot be found there!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם וְכָל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל טוֹבָה עֲצַת חוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי מֵעֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל וַיהוָה צִוָּה לְהָפֵר אֶת־עֲצַת אֲחִיתֹפֶל הַטּוֹבָה לְבַעֲבוּר הָבִיא יְהוָה אֶל־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶת־הָרָעָה׃
verses.english: Avshalom and all Israel said:Better is the advice of Hushai the Arkite than the advice of Ahitofel!—Now YHWH had ordained to nullify the good advice of Ahitofel,in order that YHWH might bring an evil-fate upon Avshalom.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חוּשַׁי אֶל־צָדוֹק וְאֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים כָּזֹאת וְכָזֹאת יָעַץ אֲחִיתֹפֶל אֶת־אַבְשָׁלֹם וְאֵת זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָזֹאת וְכָזֹאת יָעַצְתִּי אָנִי׃
verses.english: And Hushai said to Tzadok and to Evyatar, the priests:Like this and like that, Ahitofel advised Avshalom and the elders of Israel,and like this and like that, I myself advised.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שִׁלְחוּ מְהֵרָה וְהַגִּידוּ לְדָוִד לֵאמֹר אַל־תָּלֶן הַלַּיְלָה בְּעַרְבוֹת הַמִּדְבָּר וְגַם עָבוֹר תַּעֲבוֹר פֶּן יְבֻלַּע לַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃
verses.english: So-now,send quickly and tell David, saying:Do not lodge tonight at the wilderness crossings,by-all-means cross over, yes, cross over,lest they be swallowed up, the king and all the people who are with him!

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹנָתָן וַאֲחִימַעַץ עֹמְדִים בְּעֵין־רֹגֵל וְהָלְכָה הַשִּׁפְחָה וְהִגִּידָה לָהֶם וְהֵם יֵלְכוּ וְהִגִּידוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד כִּי לֹא יוּכְלוּ לְהֵרָאוֹת לָבוֹא הָעִירָה׃
verses.english: Now Yehonatan and Ahimaatz were staying at En-Rogel, a spring south of Jerusalem’s main Gihon Spring. The name means “Fuller’s/Washer’s Spring,” referring to a person whose task it is to clean, dye, shrink, or expand cloth.,and a handmaid would go and tell them,and they would go and tell King David,for they could not be seen coming to the town.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֹתָם נַעַר וַיַּגֵּד לְאַבְשָׁלֹם וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בֵּית־אִישׁ בְּבַחוּרִים וְלוֹ בְאֵר בַּחֲצֵרוֹ וַיֵּרְדוּ שָׁם׃
verses.english: But a serving-lad saw them and told Avshalom,so the two of them went quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim;he had a well in his courtyard,and they went down there.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח הָאִשָּׁה וַתִּפְרֹשׂ אֶת־הַמָּסָךְ עַל־פְּנֵי הַבְּאֵר וַתִּשְׁטַח עָלָיו הָרִפוֹת וְלֹא נוֹדַע דָּבָר׃
verses.english: And the woman fetched and spread a screen over the mouth of the well,and she scattered some groats over it,so that nothing was noticeable.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה הַבַּיְתָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַיֵּה אֲחִימַעַץ וִיהוֹנָתָן וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הָאִשָּׁה עָבְרוּ מִיכַל הַמָּיִם וַיְבַקְשׁוּ וְלֹא מָצָאוּ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: So when Avshalom’s servants came to the woman in the house,and they said: Where are Ahimaatz and Yehonatan?the woman said to them:They have [already] crossed the pond) is obscure. of water.They sought but did not find [them],so they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי לֶכְתָּם וַיַּעֲלוּ מֵהַבְּאֵר וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּגִּדוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־דָּוִד קוּמוּ וְעִבְרוּ מְהֵרָה אֶת־הַמַּיִם כִּי־כָכָה יָעַץ עֲלֵיכֶם אֲחִיתֹפֶל׃
verses.english: Now it was, after their going away,that they came up out of the well, and went and told King David;they said to David:Arise and quickly cross the water,for thus-and-so has Ahitofel advised concerning you.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם דָּוִד וְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר עַד־אַחַד לֹא נֶעְדָּר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָבַר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: So David arose, and all the people who were with him;they crossed the Jordan, till the light of daybreak,until there was no one left behind who had not crossed the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחִיתֹפֶל רָאָה כִּי לֹא נֶעֶשְׂתָה עֲצָתוֹ וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת־הַחֲמוֹר וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ אֶל־עִירוֹ וַיְצַו אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וַיֵּחָנַק וַיָּמָת וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּקֶבֶר אָבִיו׃
verses.english: Now when Ahitofel saw that his advice had not been acted upon,he saddled a donkey, and arose and went to his house, to his town;and he gave charge regarding his household, and then he strangled himself, so that he died.He was buried in the burial-place of his father.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד בָּא מַחֲנָיְמָה וְאַבְשָׁלֹם עָבַר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הוּא וְכָל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל עִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: When David had come to Mahanayim, Avshalom crossed theJordan, he and all the fighting-men of Israel with him.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עֲמָשָׂא שָׂם אַבְשָׁלֹם תַּחַת יוֹאָב עַל־הַצָּבָא וַעֲמָשָׂא בֶן־אִישׁ וּשְׁמוֹ יִתְרָא הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֶל־אֲבִיגַל בַּת־נָחָשׁ אֲחוֹת צְרוּיָה אֵם יוֹאָב׃
verses.english: As for Amasa, Avshalom put him in place of Yoav, [The One] Over the Armed-Forces—Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Yitra the Yizre’elite,who had come in to Avigayil daughter of Nahash, sister of Tzeruya, Yoav’s mother.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַן יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַבְשָׁלֹם אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד׃
verses.english: Now Israel and Avshalom encamped in the region of Gil’ad.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּבוֹא דָוִד מַחֲנָיְמָה וְשֹׁבִי בֶן־נָחָשׁ מֵרַבַּת בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן וּמָכִיר בֶּן־עַמִּיאֵל מִלֹּא דְבָר וּבַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי מֵרֹגְלִים׃
verses.english: And it was, when David came to Mahanayim,that Shovi son of Nahash from Rabba of the Children of Ammonand Makhir son of Ammiel from Lo-Devar and Barzillai the Gil’adite from Rogelim

verses.hebrew: מִשְׁכָּב וְסַפּוֹת וּכְלִי יוֹצֵר וְחִטִּים וּשְׂעֹרִים וְקֶמַח וְקָלִי וּפוֹל וַעֲדָשִׁים וְקָלִי׃
verses.english: brought forward couches and basins and potter’s vessels,and wheat and barley and meal and parched-grain,and beans and lentils,

verses.hebrew: וּדְבַשׁ וְחֶמְאָה וְצֹאן וּשְׁפוֹת בָּקָר הִגִּישׁוּ לְדָוִד וְלָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ לֶאֱכוֹל כִּי אָמְרוּ הָעָם רָעֵב וְעָיֵף וְצָמֵא בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
verses.english: and honey and curds and sheep and cheese from cattle for Davidand for the people that were with him, to eat,for they had said:The people are hungry and weary and thirsty in the wilderness!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם עֲלֵיהֶם שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי מֵאוֹת׃
verses.english: And David counted [for battle] the fighting-people who were with him;he put over them commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח דָּוִד אֶת־הָעָם הַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּיַד־יוֹאָב וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּיַד אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה אֲחִי יוֹאָב וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁת בְּיַד אִתַּי הַגִּתִּי וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הָעָם יָצֹא אֵצֵא גַּם־אֲנִי עִמָּכֶם׃
verses.english: And David sent out the fighting-people:a third in the hand of Yoav,a third in the hand of Avishai son of Tzeruya, Yoav’s brother,and a third in the hand of Ittai the Gittite.The king said to the fighting-people:I will go out, yes, go out, even I myself, with you!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָעָם לֹא תֵצֵא כִּי אִם־נֹס נָנוּס לֹא־יָשִׂימוּ אֵלֵינוּ לֵב וְאִם־יָמֻתוּ חֶצְיֵנוּ לֹא־יָשִׂימוּ אֵלֵינוּ לֵב כִּי־עַתָּה כָמֹנוּ עֲשָׂרָה אֲלָפִים וְעַתָּה טוֹב כִּי־תִהְיֶה־לָּנוּ מֵעִיר לעזיר [לַעְזוֹר׃]
verses.english: But the people said:You are not to go out,for if we have to flee, yes, flee,they will not take us to heart,and [even] if half of us die,they will not take us to heart;but you The reading of LXX; MT has “for now” (a difference of one Hebrew letter). are like us ten thousandfold!So-now, it is better if you are [there] for us in the town, to provide-help.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־יִיטַב בְּעֵינֵיכֶם אֶעֱשֶׂה וַיַּעֲמֹד הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יַד הַשַּׁעַר וְכָל־הָעָם יָצְאוּ לְמֵאוֹת וְלַאֲלָפִים׃
verses.english: The king said to them:Whatever is good in your eyes, I will do.So the king stood by the gate,while all the fighting-people went out by the hundreds and by the thousands.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־יוֹאָב וְאֶת־אֲבִישַׁי וְאֶת־אִתַּי לֵאמֹר לְאַט־לִי לַנַּעַר לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וְכָל־הָעָם שָׁמְעוּ בְּצַוֺּת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־כָּל־הַשָּׂרִים עַל־דְּבַר אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: And the king charged Yoav and Avishai and Ittai, saying:Go-gently for me on the lad, on Avshalom!And all the people heard the charge of the king to all the commanders on the matter of Avshalom.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הָעָם הַשָּׂדֶה לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתְּהִי הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּיַעַר אֶפְרָיִם׃
verses.english: The fighting-people went out into the open-country to meet Israel;the battle occurred in the forest of Efrayim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּנָּגְפוּ שָׁם עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי עַבְדֵי דָוִד וַתְּהִי־שָׁם הַמַּגֵּפָה גְדוֹלָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף׃
verses.english: And the fighting-people of Israel were defeated there, before David’s servants;there occurred there a great defeat on that day—twenty thousand [dead].

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי־שָׁם הַמִּלְחָמָה נפצית [נָפֹצֶת] עַל־פְּנֵי כָל־הָאָרֶץ וַיֶּרֶב הַיַּעַר לֶאֱכֹל בָּעָם מֵאֲשֶׁר אָכְלָה הַחֶרֶב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃
verses.english: And the battle there was scattered over the face of all the ground;more did the forest devour among the fighting-people than the sword devoured on that day.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּרֵא אַבְשָׁלוֹם לִפְנֵי עַבְדֵי דָוִד וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם רֹכֵב עַל־הַפֶּרֶד וַיָּבֹא הַפֶּרֶד תַּחַת שׂוֹבֶךְ הָאֵלָה הַגְּדוֹלָה וַיֶּחֱזַק רֹאשׁוֹ בָאֵלָה וַיֻּתַּן בֵּין הַשָּׁמַיִם וּבֵין הָאָרֶץ וְהַפֶּרֶד אֲשֶׁר־תַּחְתָּיו עָבָר׃
verses.english: And Avshalom chanced upon David’s servants:Avshalom was riding on a mule,and the mule came under the thick-boughs of a great oak,and his head became held fast in the oak,so that he was left hanging between heaven and earth,while the mule that was under him crossed on.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אִישׁ אֶחָד וַיַּגֵּד לְיוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה רָאִיתִי אֶת־אַבְשָׁלֹם תָּלוּי בָּאֵלָה׃
verses.english: A man saw it and told Yoav;he said:Here, I saw Avshalom hanging from an oak!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לָאִישׁ הַמַּגִּיד לוֹ וְהִנֵּה רָאִיתָ וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא־הִכִּיתוֹ שָׁם אָרְצָה וְעָלַי לָתֶת לְךָ עֲשָׂרָה כֶסֶף וַחֲגֹרָה אֶחָת׃
verses.english: Yoav said to the man, the one telling him:Now here, you saw [him]—so for-what-reason didn’t you strike him down there to the ground?I would have to have given you ten pieces-of-silver and a belt!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ אֶל־יוֹאָב ולא [וְלוּא] אָנֹכִי שֹׁקֵל עַל־כַּפַּי אֶלֶף כֶּסֶף לֹא־אֶשְׁלַח יָדִי אֶל־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי בְאָזְנֵינוּ צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אֹתְךָ וְאֶת־אֲבִישַׁי וְאֶת־אִתַּי לֵאמֹר שִׁמְרוּ־מִי בַּנַּעַר בְּאַבְשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: The man said to Yoav:Even if I were feeling-the-weight in my palms of a thousand pieces-of-silver,I would not stretch out my hand against the king’s son,for it was in our ears that the king charged you and Avishai and Ittai, saying:Guard the lad, Avshalom, for me!

verses.hebrew: אוֹ־עָשִׂיתִי בנפשו [בְנַפְשִׁי] שֶׁקֶר וְכָל־דָּבָר לֹא־יִכָּחֵד מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאַתָּה תִּתְיַצֵּב מִנֶּגֶד׃
verses.english: Else I would have been dealing falsely with my own life,for nothing is hidden from the king—yet you, you were standing aloof!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לֹא־כֵן אֹחִילָה לְפָנֶיךָ וַיִּקַּח שְׁלֹשָׁה שְׁבָטִים בְּכַפּוֹ וַיִּתְקָעֵם בְּלֵב אַבְשָׁלוֹם עוֹדֶנּוּ חַי בְּלֵב הָאֵלָה׃
verses.english: Yoav said:I will not wait around like this before you!So he took three rods carries two usual meanings: the rod of parental discipline and the scepter of royalty. Both have their echoes here. in his palmand thrust them into Avshalom’s heart—he was still alive in the heart of the oak.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסֹבּוּ עֲשָׂרָה נְעָרִים נֹשְׂאֵי כְּלֵי יוֹאָב וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיְמִיתֻהוּ׃
verses.english: And ten fighting-lads, Yoav’s weapons bearers, surrounded him;they struck Avshalom and put him to death.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַע יוֹאָב בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיָּשָׁב הָעָם מִרְדֹף אַחֲרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־חָשַׂךְ יוֹאָב אֶת־הָעָם׃
verses.english: Then Yoav sounded a thrusting-blast on the shofar,so that the fighting-people turned back from pursuing after Israel,for Yoav held back the people.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־אַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ בַיַּעַר אֶל־הַפַּחַת הַגָּדוֹל וַיַּצִּבוּ עָלָיו גַּל־אֲבָנִים גָּדוֹל מְאֹד וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל נָסוּ אִישׁ לאהלו [לְאֹהָלָיו׃]
verses.english: They took Avshalomand threw him in the forest, into a great pit,and set up over him a heap of stones, exceedingly large,while all Israel fled, each to his tent.

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְשָׁלֹם לָקַח וַיַּצֶּב־לוֹ בחיו [בְחַיָּיו] אֶת־מַצֶּבֶת אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵמֶק־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי אָמַר אֵין־לִי בֵן בַּעֲבוּר הַזְכִּיר שְׁמִי וַיִּקְרָא לַמַּצֶּבֶת עַל־שְׁמוֹ וַיִּקָּרֵא לָהּ יַד אַבְשָׁלֹם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Now Avshalom had undertaken to set up for himself, duringhis lifetime, the standing-stone that is in the King’s Valley,for he had said [to himself]: I have no son through whom to have my name recalled.So he called the standing-stone by his name—it is called Avshalom’s Monument until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחִימַעַץ בֶּן־צָדוֹק אָמַר אָרוּצָה נָּא וַאֲבַשְּׂרָה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־שְׁפָטוֹ יְהוָה מִיַּד אֹיְבָיו׃
verses.english: Now Ahimaatz son of Tzadok said:Pray let me run and bring-the-news to the kingthat YHWH has wrought justice for him from the hand of his enemies!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יוֹאָב לֹא אִישׁ בְּשֹׂרָה אַתָּה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּבִשַּׂרְתָּ בְּיוֹם אַחֵר וְהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לֹא תְבַשֵּׂר כִּי־על [עַל־] [כֵּן] בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ מֵת׃
verses.english: Yoav said to him:You are not to be a man of news on this day;you may bring-news on another day,but on this day, you are not to bring-news,since, which makes no sense. Here, as others do, I omit. the king’s son is dead.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לַכּוּשִׁי לֵךְ הַגֵּד לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ כוּשִׁי לְיוֹאָב וַיָּרֹץ׃
verses.english: Yoav said to a Cushite:Go, tell the king what you have seen.The Cushite bowed low to Yoav and ran off.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד אֲחִימַעַץ בֶּן־צָדוֹק וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־יוֹאָב וִיהִי מָה אָרֻצָה־נָּא גַם־אָנִי אַחֲרֵי הַכּוּשִׁי וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לָמָּה־זֶּה אַתָּה רָץ בְּנִי וּלְכָה אֵין־בְּשׂוֹרָה מֹצֵאת׃
