verses.english: But once again Ahimaatz son of Tzadok said to Yoav:Come what may, pray let me run, me too, after the Cushite.Yoav said:Why should you run, my son,when you have no news [that] will find [you favor]?

verses.hebrew: וִיהִי־מָה אָרוּץ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ רוּץ וַיָּרָץ אֲחִימַעַץ דֶּרֶךְ הַכִּכָּר וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַכּוּשִׁי׃
verses.english: … Come what may, I want to run!So he said to him: Run!And Ahimaatz ran by way of the Oval, and passed the Cushite.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד יוֹשֵׁב בֵּין־שְׁנֵי הַשְּׁעָרִים וַיֵּלֶךְ הַצֹּפֶה אֶל־גַּג הַשַּׁעַר אֶל־הַחוֹמָה וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ רָץ לְבַדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Now David was sitting between the two gateways,and the watchman on the roof of the gate went over to the [city] wall;he lifted up his eyes and saw: here, a man was running alone.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא הַצֹּפֶה וַיַּגֵּד לַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־לְבַדּוֹ בְּשׂוֹרָה בְּפִיו וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְקָרֵב׃
verses.english: The watchman called out and told the king,and the king said:If he is alone, [there is] news in his mouth.And he went, going along and coming nearer,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא הַצֹּפֶה אִישׁ־אַחֵר רָץ וַיִּקְרָא הַצֹּפֶה אֶל־הַשֹּׁעֵר וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־אִישׁ רָץ לְבַדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ גַּם־זֶה מְבַשֵּׂר׃
verses.english: but the watchman saw another man running;the watchman called out to the gatekeeperand said:Here, [another] man is running alone!The king said:This one too is bringing-news.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַצֹּפֶה אֲנִי רֹאֶה אֶת־מְרוּצַת הָרִאשׁוֹן כִּמְרֻצַת אֲחִימַעַץ בֶּן־צָדוֹק וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אִישׁ־טוֹב זֶה וְאֶל־בְּשׂוֹרָה טוֹבָה יָבוֹא׃
verses.english: The watchman said:I see [that] the running of the first-one is like the running of Ahimaatz son of Tzadok.The king said:He is a good man, and with good news he comes!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֲחִימַעַץ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁלוֹם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ לְאַפָּיו אָרְצָה וַיֹּאמֶר בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר סִגַּר אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־נָשְׂאוּ אֶת־יָדָם בַּאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Ahimaatz called out and said to the king: Peace!And he bowed low to the king, his nostrils to the ground,and said:Blessed is YHWH your God,who has turned over the men who lifted their hand against my lord king!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁלוֹם לַנַּעַר לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲחִימַעַץ רָאִיתִי הֶהָמוֹן הַגָּדוֹל לִשְׁלֹחַ אֶת־עֶבֶד הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹאָב וְאֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי מָה׃
verses.english: The king said:Is there peace with the lad, with Avshalom?Ahimaatz said:I saw a great commotion when Yoav sent off the king’s servant and your servant,but I do not know what [it was].

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ סֹב הִתְיַצֵּב כֹּה וַיִּסֹּב וַיַּעֲמֹד׃
verses.english: The king said:Turn around, station yourself here.He turned around and stopped.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה הַכּוּשִׁי בָּא וַיֹּאמֶר הַכּוּשִׁי יִתְבַּשֵּׂר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־שְׁפָטְךָ יְהוָה הַיּוֹם מִיַּד כָּל־הַקָּמִים עָלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: And here, the Cushite came,and the Cushite said:Let my lord king receive-the-newsthat YHWH has wrought justice for you today from the hand of all those rising against you!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הַכּוּשִׁי הֲשָׁלוֹם לַנַּעַר לְאַבְשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר הַכּוּשִׁי יִהְיוּ כַנַּעַר אֹיְבֵי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־קָמוּ עָלֶיךָ לְרָעָה׃
verses.english: The king said to the Cushite:Is there peace with the lad, with Avshalom?The Cushite said:May they be like that lad, my lord king’s enemies and all those who have risen against you for evil!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְגַּז הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּעַל עַל־עֲלִיַּת הַשַּׁעַר וַיֵּבְךְּ וְכֹה אָמַר בְּלֶכְתּוֹ בְּנִי אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנִי בְנִי אַבְשָׁלוֹם מִי־יִתֵּן מוּתִי אֲנִי תַחְתֶּיךָ אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנִי בְנִי׃
verses.english: The king was shaken;he went up to the upper-part of the gate and wept,and thus he said as he went:My son Avshalom,my son, my son Avshalom!), with last syllables accented, to echo the grief. Who will grant my dying, myself, in your place?Avshalom, my son, my son!

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְיוֹאָב הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ בֹּכֶה וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל־אַבְשָׁלֹם׃
verses.english: And it was told to Yoav:Here, the king is weeping and mourning over Avshalom.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַתְּשֻׁעָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לְאֵבֶל לְכָל־הָעָם כִּי־שָׁמַע הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר נֶעֱצַב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: Now the victory became mourning on that day for all the people,for the people heard on that day, saying:The king is in pain over his son.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְגַּנֵּב הָעָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לָבוֹא הָעִיר כַּאֲשֶׁר יִתְגַּנֵּב הָעָם הַנִּכְלָמִים בְּנוּסָם בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: So the people stole away on that day, while coming into the cityas humiliated fighting-people steal away when they flee in battle.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ לָאַט אֶת־פָּנָיו וַיִּזְעַק הַמֶּלֶךְ קוֹל גָּדוֹל בְּנִי אַבְשָׁלוֹם אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנִי בְנִי׃
verses.english: Now the king wrapped his face,and the king cried out in a loud voice:My son Avshalom,Avshalom, my son, my son!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַבָּיִת וַיֹּאמֶר הֹבַשְׁתָּ הַיּוֹם אֶת־פְּנֵי כָל־עֲבָדֶיךָ הַמְמַלְּטִים אֶת־נַפְשְׁךָ הַיּוֹם וְאֵת נֶפֶשׁ בָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֹתֶיךָ וְנֶפֶשׁ נָשֶׁיךָ וְנֶפֶשׁ פִּלַגְשֶׁיךָ׃
verses.english: Yoav came to the king in the palace-house,and said:Today you have shamed the face of all your servantswho helped you escape with your life todayand the life of your sons and your daughters, and the life of your wives, and the life of your concubines—

verses.hebrew: לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־שֹׂנְאֶיךָ וְלִשְׂנֹא אֶת־אֹהֲבֶיךָ כִּי הִגַּדְתָּ הַיּוֹם כִּי אֵין לְךָ שָׂרִים וַעֲבָדִים כִּי יָדַעְתִּי הַיּוֹם כִּי לא [לוּ] אַבְשָׁלוֹם חַי וְכֻלָּנוּ הַיּוֹם מֵתִים כִּי־אָז יָשָׁר בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃
verses.english: by loving those-who-hate-you, and by hating those-who-love-you!For you have declared today that you have no commanders or servants;for today I know that if Avshalom were alive, and all of us today were dead,indeed, then it would be right in your eyes!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה קוּם צֵא וְדַבֵּר עַל־לֵב עֲבָדֶיךָ כִּי בַיהוָה נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי כִּי־אֵינְךָ יוֹצֵא אִם־יָלִין אִישׁ אִתְּךָ הַלַּיְלָה וְרָעָה לְךָ זֹאת מִכָּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־בָּאָה עָלֶיךָ מִנְּעֻרֶיךָ עַד־עָתָּה׃
verses.english: So-now, get up, go outand speak to the heart of your servants,for by YHWH I swear, that [if] you do not go out,no man will lodge with you tonight,and this will be more evil for youthan all the evils that have come upon you from your youth until now!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב בַּשָּׁעַר וּלְכָל־הָעָם הִגִּידוּ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב בַּשַּׁעַר וַיָּבֹא כָל־הָעָם לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיִשְׂרָאֵל נָס אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו׃
verses.english: So the king got up and sat at the gate,while to all the people they declared, saying:Here, the king is sitting at the gate!And all the people came before the king.Now Israel had fled, each one to his tent;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כָל־הָעָם נָדוֹן בְּכָל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הַמֶּלֶךְ הִצִּילָנוּ מִכַּף אֹיְבֵינוּ וְהוּא מִלְּטָנוּ מִכַּף פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַתָּה בָּרַח מִן־הָאָרֶץ מֵעַל אַבְשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: and it was that all the people were in strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying:The king rescued us from the hand of our enemies,and he himself helped us escape from the hand of the Philistines;but now he had to run away from the land, from Avshalom,

verses.hebrew: וְאַבְשָׁלוֹם אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁחְנוּ עָלֵינוּ מֵת בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְעַתָּה לָמָה אַתֶּם מַחֲרִשִׁים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: while Avshalom, whom we anointed over us, has died in battle!So-now,why are you keeping silent about having the king return?

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד שָׁלַח אֶל־צָדוֹק וְאֶל־אֶבְיָתָר הַכֹּהֲנִים לֵאמֹר דַּבְּרוּ אֶל־זִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר לָמָּה תִהְיוּ אַחֲרֹנִים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וּדְבַר כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃
verses.english: Now King David sent to Tzadok and Evyatar the priests, saying:Speak to the elders of Judah, saying:Why should you be the last to return the king to his house?—For the words of all Israel had come to the king, to his house.—

verses.hebrew: אַחַי אַתֶּם עַצְמִי וּבְשָׂרִי אַתֶּם וְלָמָּה תִהְיוּ אַחֲרֹנִים לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: You are my brothers, you are my bone and my flesh;so why should you be the last to return the king?

verses.hebrew: וְלַעֲמָשָׂא תֹּמְרוּ הֲלוֹא עַצְמִי וּבְשָׂרִי אָתָּה כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִיף אִם־לֹא שַׂר־צָבָא תִּהְיֶה לְפָנַי כָּל־הַיָּמִים תַּחַת יוֹאָב׃
verses.english: And to Amasa, say:Are you not my bone and my flesh?Thus may God do to me, and thus may he add,if you do not become commander of the armed-forces before me all the days [to come], in place of Yoav.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּט אֶת־לְבַב כָּל־אִישׁ־יְהוּדָה כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ שׁוּב אַתָּה וְכָל־עֲבָדֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Thus he inclined the heart of all the men of Judah, as one man;they sent [word] to the king:Return, you and all your servants!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּבֹא עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן וִיהוּדָה בָּא הַגִּלְגָּלָה לָלֶכֶת לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהַעֲבִיר אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: So the king returned and came to the Jordan,while Judah came to Gilgal to go and meet the king,to conduct the king across the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֵר שִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא בֶּן־הַיְמִינִי אֲשֶׁר מִבַּחוּרִים וַיֵּרֶד עִם־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד׃
verses.english: And Shim’i son of Gera, the Binyaminite who was from Bahurim, hurried out;he went down with the men of Judah to meet King David,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶלֶף אִישׁ עִמּוֹ מִבִּנְיָמִן וְצִיבָא נַעַר בֵּית שָׁאוּל וַחֲמֵשֶׁת עָשָׂר בָּנָיו וְעֶשְׂרִים עֲבָדָיו אִתּוֹ וְצָלְחוּ הַיַּרְדֵּן לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: and a thousand men were with him from Binyamin,along with Tziva, the retainer from the House of Sha’ul,and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him;they advanced to the Jordan ahead of the king,

verses.hebrew: וְעָבְרָה הָעֲבָרָה לַעֲבִיר אֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת הַטּוֹב בעינו [בְּעֵינָיו] וְשִׁמְעִי בֶן־גֵּרָא נָפַל לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּעָבְרוֹ בַּיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: while the river-crossing was being crossed, in order to conduct the king’s household across,to do what was good in his eyes.Now Shim’i son of Gera flung himself down before the king, as he was crossing the Jordan;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אַל־יַחֲשָׁב־לִי אֲדֹנִי עָוֺן וְאַל־תִּזְכֹּר אֵת אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱוָה עַבְדְּךָ בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר־יָצָא אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ מִירוּשָׁלִָם לָשׂוּם הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־לִבּוֹ׃
verses.english: he said to the king:Do not impute iniquity to me, my lord,do not call-to-mind what your servant iniquitously-did on the day that my lord king went out from Jerusalem,that the king should take it to heart!

verses.hebrew: כִּי יָדַע עַבְדְּךָ כִּי אֲנִי חָטָאתִי וְהִנֵּה־בָאתִי הַיּוֹם רִאשׁוֹן לְכָל־בֵּית יוֹסֵף לָרֶדֶת לִקְרַאת אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: For your servant knows that I myself sinned,but here: I have come today, as the first of the entire House of Yosef,going down to meet my lord king!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וַיֹּאמֶר הֲתַחַת זֹאת לֹא יוּמַת שִׁמְעִי כִּי קִלֵּל אֶת־מְשִׁיחַ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Avishai son of Tzeruya spoke up and said:For that, should not Shim’i be put to death?Indeed, he cursed YHWH’s anointed one!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד מַה־לִּי וְלָכֶם בְּנֵי צְרוּיָה כִּי־תִהְיוּ־לִי הַיּוֹם לְשָׂטָן הַיּוֹם יוּמַת אִישׁ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי הֲלוֹא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי הַיּוֹם אֲנִי־מֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: David said:What is there between me and you, O sons of Tzeruya,that you have become an adversary to me?Today should a man be put to death in Israel?Indeed, do I not know that today I am king over Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־שִׁמְעִי לֹא תָמוּת וַיִּשָּׁבַע לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: The king said to Shim’i:You will not die!And the king swore-an-oath to him.

verses.hebrew: וּמְפִבֹשֶׁת בֶּן־שָׁאוּל יָרַד לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלֹא־עָשָׂה רַגְלָיו וְלֹא־עָשָׂה שְׂפָמוֹ וְאֶת־בְּגָדָיו לֹא כִבֵּס לְמִן־הַיּוֹם לֶכֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ עַד־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר־בָּא בְשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: Now Mefiboshet [grand]son of Sha’ul went down to meet the king—he had not done his toenails, he had not done his mustache,and his garments he had not scrubbed,from the day of the king’s going away until the day that he came back in peace—

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־בָא יְרוּשָׁלִַם לִקְרַאת הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה לֹא־הָלַכְתָּ עִמִּי מְפִיבֹשֶׁת׃
verses.english: and it was, when he came from Jerusalem to meet the kingthat the king said to him:Why did you not go with me, Mefiboshet?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ עַבְדִּי רִמָּנִי כִּי־אָמַר עַבְדְּךָ אֶחְבְּשָׁה־לִּי הַחֲמוֹר וְאֶרְכַּב עָלֶיהָ וְאֵלֵךְ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי פִסֵּחַ עַבְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: He said:My lord king, my servant deceived me;for your servant said [to himself]:I will have my donkey saddled and ride it, and I will go to the king—though your servant is lame.

verses.hebrew: וַיְרַגֵּל בְּעַבְדְּךָ אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּמַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים וַעֲשֵׂה הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃
verses.english: But he slandered your servant to my lord king;yet my lord king is like a messenger of God—so do as is good in your eyes.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא הָיָה כָּל־בֵּית אָבִי כִּי אִם־אַנְשֵׁי־מָוֶת לַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתָּשֶׁת אֶת־עַבְדְּךָ בְּאֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחָנֶךָ וּמַה־יֶּשׁ־לִי עוֹד צְדָקָה וְלִזְעֹק עוֹד אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: For all my father’s household were nothing but men [deserving] death from my lord king;yet you have set your servant among those eating at your table!So what right do I still have to cry out to the king?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה תְּדַבֵּר עוֹד דְּבָרֶיךָ אָמַרְתִּי אַתָּה וְצִיבָא תַּחְלְקוּ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶה׃
verses.english: The king said to him:Why are you still speaking your words?I have decided:you and Tziva are to divide the fielded-property.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מְפִיבֹשֶׁת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ גַּם אֶת־הַכֹּל יִקָּח אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶך בְּשָׁלוֹם אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃
verses.english: Mefiboshet said to the king:Let him just take all of it,seeing that my lord has come back in peace to his house!

verses.hebrew: וּבַרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי יָרַד מֵרֹגְלִים וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן לְשַׁלְּחוֹ אֶת־בירדן [הַיַּרְדֵּן׃]
verses.english: Now Barzillai the Gil’adite had come down from Rogelimand had crossed the Jordan with the king, to send him off at the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וּבַרְזִלַּי זָקֵן מְאֹד בֶּן־שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וְהוּא־כִלְכַּל אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּשִׁיבָתוֹ בְמַחֲנַיִם כִּי־אִישׁ גָּדוֹל הוּא מְאֹד׃
verses.english: And Barzillai was exceedingly old, at eighty years;he had provided for the king when he had stayed at Mahanayim,for he was a man of exceedingly great-wealth.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־בַּרְזִלָּי אַתָּה עֲבֹר אִתִּי וְכִלְכַּלְתִּי אֹתְךָ עִמָּדִי בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: The king said to Barzillai:You, cross over with me, and I will provide for you beside me in Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בַּרְזִלַּי אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ כַּמָּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיַּי כִּי־אֶעֱלֶה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: But Barzillai said to the king:How many [more] are the days and years of my life,that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה אָנֹכִי הַיּוֹם הַאֵדַע בֵּין־טוֹב לְרָע אִם־יִטְעַם עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־אֲשֶׁר אֹכַל וְאֶת־אֲשֶׁר אֶשְׁתֶּה אִם־אֶשְׁמַע עוֹד בְּקוֹל שָׁרִים וְשָׁרוֹת וְלָמָּה יִהְיֶה עַבְדְּךָ עוֹד לְמַשָּׂא אֶל־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: I am eighty years old today;do I know between good and evil?Or does your servant taste what I eat or what I drink?Or do I still hearken to the voice of male-singers or female-singers?So why should your servant still be a burden to my lord king?

verses.hebrew: כִּמְעַט יַעֲבֹר עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְלָמָּה יִגְמְלֵנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגְּמוּלָה הַזֹּאת׃
verses.english: Scarcely could your servant cross the Jordan with the king,so why does the king reward me with this reward?

verses.hebrew: יָשָׁב־נָא עַבְדְּךָ וְאָמֻת בְּעִירִי עִם קֶבֶר אָבִי וְאִמִּי וְהִנֵּה עַבְדְּךָ כִמְהָם יַעֲבֹר עִם־אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַעֲשֵׂה־לוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־טוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Now let your servant return, that I may die in my town,beside the burial-place of my father and my mother.But here is your servant Kimham trad. English “Chimham.” This gentleman, who has the distinction of being one of the most briefly mentioned characters in the Bible, may have been Barzillai’s son.—let him cross over with my lord king,and then do for him that which is good in your eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אִתִּי יַעֲבֹר כִּמְהָם וַאֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה־לּוֹ אֶת־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תִּבְחַר עָלַי אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ׃
verses.english: The king said:With me, Kimham shall cross,and I myself will do for him what is good in your eyes;whatever you choose for me, I will do for you!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר כָּל־הָעָם אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהַמֶּלֶךְ עָבָר וַיִּשַּׁק הַמֶּלֶךְ לְבַרְזִלַּי וַיְבָרֲכֵהוּ וַיָּשָׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: So all the fighting-people crossed the Jordan,and when the king was about to cross over,the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him,and he returned to his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגִּלְגָּלָה וְכִמְהָן עָבַר עִמּוֹ וְכָל־עַם יְהוּדָה ויעברו [הֶעֱבִירוּ] אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם חֲצִי עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Then the king crossed over to Gilgal, and Kimham crossed over with him.Now all the fighting-people of Judah had conducted the king across,and also half the fighting-people of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה כָּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאִים אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ מַדּוּעַ גְּנָבוּךָ אַחֵינוּ אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וַיַּעֲבִרוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְכָל־אַנְשֵׁי דָוִד עִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: And here, all the men of Israel were coming to the king;they said to the king:Why have our brothers, the men of Judah, stolen you awayand conducted the king and his household across the Jordan,and all of David’s men with him?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן כָּל־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה עַל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־קָרוֹב הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלַי וְלָמָּה זֶּה חָרָה לְךָ עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה הֶאָכוֹל אָכַלְנוּ מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ אִם־נִשֵּׂאת נִשָּׂא לָנוּ׃
verses.english: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel:Because the king is closely-related to me!Why are you so agitated about this matter?Have we eaten, yes, eaten any of the king[’s food]?Or has any been carried, yes, carried off to us?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר עֶשֶׂר־יָדוֹת לִי בַמֶּלֶךְ וְגַם־בְּדָוִד אֲנִי מִמְּךָ וּמַדּוּעַ הֱקִלֹּתַנִי וְלֹא־הָיָה דְבָרִי רִאשׁוֹן לִי לְהָשִׁיב אֶת־מַלְכִּי וַיִּקֶשׁ דְּבַר־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה מִדְּבַר אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, they said:I have ten shares in the king,yes, in David, I more than you;so why do you insult me?Was not my word, mine, the first for having my king return?But the words of Judah’s men were rougher than the words of Israel’s men.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁם נִקְרָא אִישׁ בְּלִיַּעַל וּשְׁמוֹ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי אִישׁ יְמִינִי וַיִּתְקַע בַּשֹּׁפָר וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין־לָנוּ חֵלֶק בְּדָוִד וְלֹא נַחֲלָה־לָנוּ בְּבֶן־יִשַׁי אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now there chanced to be a base man there—his name was Sheva son of Bikhri, a Binyaminite man;he gave-a-blast on the shofar and said:We have no portion in David,nor inheritance for us in the son of Yishai;everyone to his tents, O Israel!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל כָּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַחֲרֵי דָוִד אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה דָּבְקוּ בְמַלְכָּם מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְעַד־יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: So all the men of Israel went up from [following] after David, [to following] after Sheva son of Bikhri,while the men of Judah clung to their king, from the Jordan to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ יְרוּשָׁלִַם וַיִּקַּח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת עֶשֶׂר־נָשִׁים פִּלַגְשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ לִשְׁמֹר הַבַּיִת וַיִּתְּנֵם בֵּית־מִשְׁמֶרֶת וַיְכַלְכְּלֵם וַאֲלֵיהֶם לֹא־בָא וַתִּהְיֶינָה צְרֻרוֹת עַד־יוֹם מֻתָן אַלְמְנוּת חַיּוּת׃
verses.english: And David came to his palace-house in Jerusalem.The king took the ten concubine women whom he had left to guard the houseand put them in a house under guard and provided for them,but he did not come in to them,for they were tied off until the day of their death in living widowhood.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עֲמָשָׂא הַזְעֶק־לִי אֶת־אִישׁ־יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים וְאַתָּה פֹּה עֲמֹד׃
verses.english: Then the king said to Amasa:Summon to me the men of Judah, in three days,then you—stop here.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֲמָשָׂא לְהַזְעִיק אֶת־יְהוּדָה וייחר [וַיּוֹחֶר] מִן־הַמּוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר יְעָדוֹ׃
verses.english: Amasa went to summon Judah,but he delayed echoes ahar, aharei, “after,” a theme word in this chapter, tied to the pursuit of the rebel Sheva. from the appointed-time that he had appointed.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־אֲבִישַׁי עַתָּה יֵרַע לָנוּ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי מִן־אַבְשָׁלוֹם אַתָּה קַח אֶת־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנֶיךָ וּרְדֹף אַחֲרָיו פֶּן־מָצָא לוֹ עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת וְהִצִּיל עֵינֵנוּ׃
verses.english: And David said to Avishai:Now,Sheva son of Bikhri will be more evil for us than Avshalom!So you, take your lord’s servants and pursue after him,lest he find himself fortified towns, and cast-shadows over our eye!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ אַחֲרָיו אַנְשֵׁי יוֹאָב וְהַכְּרֵתִי וְהַפְּלֵתִי וְכָל־הַגִּבֹּרִים וַיֵּצְאוּ מִירוּשָׁלִַם לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃
verses.english: So Yoav’s men went out after him,with the Kereitites and the Peleitites and all the mighty-men;they went out of Jerusalem to pursue after Sheva son of Bikhri.

verses.hebrew: הֵם עִם־הָאֶבֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר בְּגִבְעוֹן וַעֲמָשָׂא בָּא לִפְנֵיהֶם וְיוֹאָב חָגוּר מִדּוֹ לְבֻשׁוּ ועלו [וְעָלָיו] חֲגוֹר חֶרֶב מְצֻמֶּדֶת עַל־מָתְנָיו בְּתַעְרָהּ וְהוּא יָצָא וַתִּפֹּל׃
verses.english: When they were beside the great rock that is in Giv’on movies.,Amasa came up in front of them.Now Yoav was girded in his garb, his [military] dress,and on him was a girded sword bound on his loins, in its sheath;when he went out, it fell down.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב לַעֲמָשָׂא הֲשָׁלוֹם אַתָּה אָחִי וַתֹּחֶז יַד־יְמִין יוֹאָב בִּזְקַן עֲמָשָׂא לִנְשָׁק־לוֹ׃
verses.english: And Yoav said to Amasa:Are you in peace, my brother?And Yoav’s right hand took hold of Amasa’s beard, to kiss him,

verses.hebrew: וַעֲמָשָׂא לֹא־נִשְׁמַר בַּחֶרֶב אֲשֶׁר בְּיַד־יוֹאָב וַיַּכֵּהוּ בָהּ אֶל־הַחֹמֶשׁ וַיִּשְׁפֹּךְ מֵעָיו אַרְצָה וְלֹא־שָׁנָה לוֹ וַיָּמֹת וְיוֹאָב וַאֲבִישַׁי אָחִיו רָדַף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃
verses.english: but Amasa did not guard himself from the sword that was in Yoav’s [other] hand,and he struck him with it in the abdomen, so that his innards poured out on the ground;—he did not [have to] do it to him a second-time—and so he died.Now Yoav and Avishai his brother pursued after Sheva son of Bikhri,

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ עָמַד עָלָיו מִנַּעֲרֵי יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אֲשֶׁר חָפֵץ בְּיוֹאָב וּמִי אֲשֶׁר־לְדָוִד אַחֲרֵי יוֹאָב׃
verses.english: while a man was standing by him from the serving-lads of Yoav;he said:Whoever desires Yoav, and whoever is for David—[follow] after Yoav!

verses.hebrew: וַעֲמָשָׂא מִתְגֹּלֵל בַּדָּם בְּתוֹךְ הַמְסִּלָּה וַיַּרְא הָאִישׁ כִּי־עָמַד כָּל־הָעָם וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־עֲמָשָׂא מִן־הַמְסִלָּה הַשָּׂדֶה וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ עָלָיו בֶּגֶד כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאָה כָּל־הַבָּא עָלָיו וְעָמָד׃
verses.english: Now Amasa was rolling in blood in the middle of the road;and the man saw that all the people were stopping,so he turned Amasa over from the road into the open-field, and threw a garment over him—when anyone who came by saw him, he would stop.

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר הֹגָה מִן־הַמְסִלָּה עָבַר כָּל־אִישׁ אַחֲרֵי יוֹאָב לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵי שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי׃
verses.english: When he had pushed him out of the road,all the men who were [following] after Yoav crossed over to pursue after Sheva son of Bikhri.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר בְּכָל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבֵלָה וּבֵית מַעֲכָה וְכָל־הַבֵּרִים ויקלהו [וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ] וַיָּבֹאוּ אַף־אַחֲרָיו׃
verses.english: They crossed throughout all the tribes of Israel to Avel of Bet-Maakha trad. English “Abel of Beth Maacah.” , to all the Bikhrites,and assembled and came just after him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיָּצֻרוּ עָלָיו בְּאָבֵלָה בֵּית הַמַּעֲכָה וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ סֹלְלָה אֶל־הָעִיר וַתַּעֲמֹד בַּחֵל וְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אֶת־יוֹאָב מַשְׁחִיתִם לְהַפִּיל הַחוֹמָה׃
verses.english: They came and besieged him, in Avel of Bet-Maakha:they cast up a mound against the town, and stopped at the rampart,while all the fighting-people who were with Yoav were bringing-ruin, to cause the wall to fall.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרָא אִשָּׁה חֲכָמָה מִן־הָעִיר שִׁמְעוּ שִׁמְעוּ אִמְרוּ־נָא אֶל־יוֹאָב קְרַב עַד־הֵנָּה וַאֲדַבְּרָה אֵלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: But a wise woman called out from the town:Hearken! Hearken!Now say to Yoav:Come near to here—I would speak with you!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרַב אֵלֶיהָ וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַאַתָּה יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵי אֲמָתֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר שֹׁמֵעַ אָנֹכִי׃
verses.english: He came near to her.The woman said:Are you Yoav?He said:I am.She said to him:Hearken to the words of your maidservant.He said:I am hearkening.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לֵאמֹר דַּבֵּר יְדַבְּרוּ בָרִאשֹׁנָה לֵאמֹר שָׁאֹל יְשָׁאֲלוּ בְּאָבֵל וְכֵן הֵתַמּוּ׃
verses.english: She said, saying:They used to speak, yes, speak formerly, saying:When they inquired, yes, inquired in Avel,thus they ended [the matter]!

verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי שְׁלֻמֵי אֱמוּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ לְהָמִית עִיר וְאֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לָמָּה תְבַלַּע נַחֲלַת יְהוָה׃
verses.english: I [am of] those [am of] those … : The woman appears to be speaking for the whole town. most at peace, most trustworthy in Israel;you seek to deal death to a town, a mother-city in Israel!Why would you swallow up YHWH’s inheritance?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יוֹאָב וַיֹּאמַר חָלִילָה חָלִילָה לִי אִם־אֲבַלַּע וְאִם־אַשְׁחִית׃
verses.english: Yoav answered and said:[Heaven] forbid, forbid for me, if I cause it to be swallowed up, if I bring-ruin!

verses.hebrew: לֹא־כֵן הַדָּבָר כִּי אִישׁ מֵהַר אֶפְרַיִם שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי שְׁמוֹ נָשָׂא יָדוֹ בַּמֶּלֶךְ בְּדָוִד תְּנוּ־אֹתוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וְאֵלְכָה מֵעַל הָעִיר וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־יוֹאָב הִנֵּה רֹאשׁוֹ מֻשְׁלָךְ אֵלֶיךָ בְּעַד הַחוֹמָה׃
verses.english: Not so is the matter,but a man from the highlands of Efrayim, Sheva son of Bikhri his name,has lifted his hand against the king, against David.Give up him alone, and I will go from the town!The woman said to Yoav:Here, his head will be thrown to you by way of the wall.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבוֹא הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־כָּל־הָעָם בְּחָכְמָתָהּ וַיִּכְרְתוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ שֶׁבַע בֶּן־בִּכְרִי וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֶל־יוֹאָב וַיִּתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיָּפֻצוּ מֵעַל־הָעִיר אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו וְיוֹאָב שָׁב יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: And the woman came to all the people with her wisdom,and they cut off the head of Sheva son of Bikhri and threw it to Yoav;then he sounded-a-blast on the shofar,and they scattered from the town, each one to his tents,while Yoav returned to Jerusalem, to the king.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹאָב אֶל כָּל־הַצָּבָא יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְנָיָה בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע עַל־הכרי [הַכְּרֵתִי] וְעַל־הַפְּלֵתִי׃
verses.english: Now Yoav was [The One] Over All the Armed-Forces of Israel,while Benaya son of Yehoyada was [The One] Over the Kereitites and Over the Peleitites,

verses.hebrew: וַאֲדֹרָם עַל־הַמַּס וִיהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־אֲחִילוּד הַמַּזְכִּיר׃
verses.english: and Adoram was [The One] Over the Labor-Gangs,and Yehoshafat son of Ahilud was the Herald,

verses.hebrew: ושיא [וּשְׁוָא] סֹפֵר וְצָדוֹק וְאֶבְיָתָר כֹּהֲנִים׃
verses.english: and Sh’va was Scribe,and Tzadok and Evyatar were priests,

verses.hebrew: וְגַם עִירָא הַיָּאִרִי הָיָה כֹהֵן לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: while also ’Ira the Ya’irite was priest to David.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי רָעָב בִּימֵי דָוִד שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים שָׁנָה אַחֲרֵי שָׁנָה וַיְבַקֵּשׁ דָּוִד אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־שָׁאוּל וְאֶל־בֵּית הַדָּמִים עַל־אֲשֶׁר־הֵמִית אֶת־הַגִּבְעֹנִים׃
verses.english: Now there was a famine in David’s days, for three years, year after year,and David besought the face of YHWH.YHWH said:Because of Sha’ul and because of the House of Bloodguilt,because he caused the death of the Giv’onites … !

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ לַגִּבְעֹנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם וְהַגִּבְעֹנִים לֹא מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה כִּי אִם־מִיֶּתֶר הָאֱמֹרִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִשְׁבְּעוּ לָהֶם וַיְבַקֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל לְהַכֹּתָם בְּקַנֹּאתוֹ לִבְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה׃
verses.english: So the king called for the Giv’onites and said to them—now the Giv’onites were not from the Children of Israel,but rather from the remnant of the Amorites,yet the Children of Israel had sworn [an oath] to them;but Sha’ul had sought to strike them down, in his zeal for the Children of Israel and Judah—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־הַגִּבְעֹנִים מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם וּבַמָּה אֲכַפֵּר וּבָרְכוּ אֶת־נַחֲלַת יְהוָה׃
verses.english: David said to the Giv’onites:What shall I do for you?In what [way] may I effect-atonement,so that they may bless YHWH’s inheritance?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַגִּבְעֹנִים אֵין־לי [לָנוּ] כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב עִם־שָׁאוּל וְעִם־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֵין־לָנוּ אִישׁ לְהָמִית בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר מָה־אַתֶּם אֹמְרִים אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם׃
verses.english: The Giv’onites said to him:We have no [wish for] silver or gold with Sha’ul or with his house,and we have no [wish to] put any man to death in Israel!He said:Whatever you say, I will do for you.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כִּלָּנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר דִּמָּה־לָנוּ נִשְׁמַדְנוּ מֵהִתְיַצֵּב בְּכָל־גְּבֻל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: They said to the king:The man who [wanted to] destroy us,who intended for us [that] we should be wiped out from remaining in all the territory of Israel:

verses.hebrew: ינתן־[יֻתַּן־] לָנוּ שִׁבְעָה אֲנָשִׁים מִבָּנָיו וְהוֹקַעֲנוּם לַיהוָה בְּגִבְעַת שָׁאוּל בְּחִיר יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲנִי אֶתֵּן׃
verses.english: let there be given to us seven men of his descendants,and we will impale them to YHWH at Giv’a of Sha’ul, the chosen one of YHWH!The king said:I myself will give [them over].

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחְמֹל הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־מְפִי־בֹשֶׁת בֶּן־יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל עַל־שְׁבֻעַת יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּינֹתָם בֵּין דָּוִד וּבֵין יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שָׁאוּל׃
verses.english: But the king spared Mefiboshet son of Yehonatan son of Sha’ul,because of the sworn-oath of YHWH that was between them, between David and Yehonatan son of Sha’ul.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְשָׁאוּל אֶת־אַרְמֹנִי וְאֶת־מְפִבֹשֶׁת וְאֶת־חֲמֵשֶׁת בְּנֵי מִיכַל בַּת־שָׁאוּל אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְעַדְרִיאֵל בֶּן־בַּרְזִלַּי הַמְּחֹלָתִי׃
verses.english: So the king took the two sons of Ritzpa daughter of Aya, the name of a bird of prey, perhaps a kind of falcon, mentioned in Lev. 11:14 (and Deut. 14:13). It is appropriate to the action here (Garsiel 1991). , whom she had borne to Sha’ul, Armoni and Mefiboshet,and the five sons of Merav daughter of Sha’ul, whom she had borne to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholatite,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד הַגִּבְעֹנִים וַיֹּקִיעֻם בָּהָר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיִּפְּלוּ שבעתים [שְׁבַעְתָּם] יָחַד והם [וְהֵמָּה] הֻמְתוּ בִּימֵי קָצִיר בָּרִאשֹׁנִים תחלת [בִּתְחִלַּת] קְצִיר שְׂעֹרִים׃
verses.english: and gave them into the hand of the Giv’onites;they impaled them on the hill, in the presence of YHWH,and the seven of them fell together.—Now they were put to death at the time of the harvest, the firstdays, at the start of the barley harvest.—

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה אֶת־הַשַּׂק וַתַּטֵּהוּ לָהּ אֶל־הַצּוּר מִתְּחִלַּת קָצִיר עַד נִתַּךְ־מַיִם עֲלֵיהֶם מִן־הַשָּׁמָיִם וְלֹא־נָתְנָה עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם לָנוּחַ עֲלֵיהֶם יוֹמָם וְאֶת־חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה לָיְלָה׃
verses.english: And Ritzpa daughter of Aya took sackclothand spread it out for herself on a rockfrom the start of the harvest until water poured out on them from the heavens;she did not allow the birds of the heavens to alight on them by dayor the wildlife of the open-field by night.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְדָוִד אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָה רִצְפָּה בַת־אַיָּה פִּלֶגֶשׁ שָׁאוּל׃
verses.english: And David was told what Ritzpa daughter of Aya, Sha’ul’s concubine, had done,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ דָּוִד וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עַצְמוֹת שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ מֵאֵת בַּעֲלֵי יָבֵישׁ גִּלְעָד אֲשֶׁר גָּנְבוּ אֹתָם מֵרְחֹב בֵּית־שַׁן אֲשֶׁר תלום [תְּלָאוּם] שם הפלשתים [שָׁמָּה] [פְּלִשְׁתִּים] בְּיוֹם הַכּוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־שָׁאוּל בַּגִּלְבֹּעַ׃
verses.english: so David wentand took the bones of Sha’ul and the bones of Yehonatan his son from the inhabitants of Yavesh-Gil’ad,who had stealthily-taken them from the square of Bet-Shan,where the Philistines had hung them up at the time that the Philistines struck down Sha’ul at Gilboa;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם אֶת־עַצְמוֹת שָׁאוּל וְאֶת־עַצְמוֹת יְהוֹנָתָן בְּנוֹ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹת הַמּוּקָעִים׃
verses.english: he brought up from there the bones of Sha’ul and the bones of Yehonatan his son,and they gathered the bones of the impaled ones.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֶת־עַצְמוֹת־שָׁאוּל וִיהוֹנָתָן־בְּנוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ בִּנְיָמִן בְּצֵלָע בְּקֶבֶר קִישׁ אָבִיו וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּעָתֵר אֱלֹהִים לָאָרֶץ אַחֲרֵי־כֵן׃
verses.english: Then they buried the bones of Sha’ul and of Yehonatan his sonin the land of Binyamin, in the side-chamber of the burial-place of Kish his father.And when they had done all that the king had commanded them,God let-himself-be-entreated for the land after that.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד מִלְחָמָה לַפְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּרֶד דָּוִד וַעֲבָדָיו עִמּוֹ וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיָּעַף דָּוִד׃
verses.english: Now there were battles again by the Philistines with Israel;David went down, his servants with him,and they did battle with the Philistines.But David was weary,

verses.hebrew: וישבו [וְיִשְׁבִּי] בְּנֹב אֲשֶׁר בִּילִידֵי הָרָפָה וּמִשְׁקַל קֵינוֹ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת מִשְׁקַל נְחֹשֶׁת וְהוּא חָגוּר חֲדָשָׁה וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַכּוֹת אֶת־דָּוִד׃
verses.english: and he was taken captive, the name Yishbi here. by Benov, who was of the descendants of the Shades—the weight of his lance was three hundred shekel-weights of bronze,while he was girded in new [armor]—he intended to strike David down,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲזָר־לוֹ אֲבִישַׁי בֶּן־צְרוּיָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַפְּלִשְׁתִּי וַיְמִיתֵהוּ אָז נִשְׁבְּעוּ אַנְשֵׁי־דָוִד לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא־תֵצֵא עוֹד אִתָּנוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה וְלֹא תְכַבֶּה אֶת־נֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: but Avishai son of Tzeruya came to his help:he struck down the Philistine and put him to death.Then David’s men swore [an oath] to him, saying:You must not go out with us again into battle;you must not extinguish the lamp of Israel!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַתְּהִי־עוֹד הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּגוֹב עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים אָז הִכָּה סִבְּכַי הַחֻשָׁתִי אֶת־סַף אֲשֶׁר בִּילִדֵי הָרָפָה׃
verses.english: It was [some time] after thisthat there was battle again, in Gov, with the Philistines.And Sibbekhai the Hushatite struck down Saf, who was of the descendants of the Shades.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד הַמִּלְחָמָה בְּגוֹב עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּךְ אֶלְחָנָן בֶּן־יַעְרֵי אֹרְגִים בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי אֵת גָּלְיָת הַגִּתִּי וְעֵץ חֲנִיתוֹ כִּמְנוֹר אֹרְגִים׃
verses.english: And there was battle again in Gov, with the Philistines,and Elhanan son of Yaarei-Oregim the Bet-Lehemite struck down Golyat the Gittite—now the shaft of his spear was like a weavers’ beam.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי־עוֹד מִלְחָמָה בְּגַת וַיְהִי אִישׁ מדין [מָדוֹן] וְאֶצְבְּעֹת יָדָיו וְאֶצְבְּעֹת רַגְלָיו שֵׁשׁ וָשֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע מִסְפָּר וְגַם־הוּא יֻלַּד לְהָרָפָה׃
verses.english: And there was battle again in Gat:and there was an immense man—the fingers of his hands and the toes of his feet were six and six [apiece], twenty-four in number,and he too was descended from the Shades.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחָרֵף אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּהוּ יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־שמעי [שִׁמְעָה] אֲחִי דָוִד׃
verses.english: He mocked Israel,but Yehonatan son of Shim’a, David’s brother, struck him down.

verses.hebrew: אֶת־אַרְבַּעַת אֵלֶּה יֻלְּדוּ לְהָרָפָה בְּגַת וַיִּפְּלוּ בְיַד־דָּוִד וּבְיַד עֲבָדָיו׃
verses.english: These four were descended from the Shades, in Gat;they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר דָּוִד לַיהוָה אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בְּיוֹם הִצִּיל יְהוָה אֹתוֹ מִכַּף כָּל־אֹיְבָיו וּמִכַּף שָׁאוּל׃
verses.english: And David spoke forth to YHWH the words of this songat the time that YHWH rescued him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Sha’ul;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה סַלְעִי וּמְצֻדָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי־לִי׃
verses.english: he said:YHWH is my crag and my fortress, one helping me escape!

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵי צוּרִי אֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ מָגִנִּי וְקֶרֶן יִשְׁעִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי וּמְנוּסִי מֹשִׁעִי מֵחָמָס תֹּשִׁעֵנִי׃
verses.english: My God is my rock, in whom I seek-refuge,my shield, the horn of my deliverance,my secure-height, my place-of-retreat,my deliverer—from treachery you deliver me!

verses.hebrew: מְהֻלָּל אֶקְרָא יְהוָה וּמֵאֹיְבַי אִוָּשֵׁעַ׃
verses.english: Praised One I call YHWH,from my enemies I am delivered.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֲפָפֻנִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־מָוֶת נַחֲלֵי בְלִיַּעַל יְבַעֲתֻנִי׃
verses.english: For they encompassed me, the breakers of death,the torrents of Belial) for the underworld or the powers thereof. tormented me;

verses.hebrew: חֶבְלֵי שְׁאוֹל סַבֻּנִי קִדְּמֻנִי מֹקְשֵׁי־מָוֶת׃
verses.english: the ropes of Sheol surrounded me,they confronted me, the snares of death.

verses.hebrew: בַּצַּר־לִי אֶקְרָא יְהוָה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַי אֶקְרָא וַיִּשְׁמַע מֵהֵיכָלוֹ קוֹלִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי בְּאָזְנָיו׃
verses.english: In my distress I called YHWH!to my God I called.He heard my voice from his Great-Hall,my cry-for-deliverance in his ears.

verses.hebrew: ותגעש [וַיִּתְגָּעַשׁ] וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ מוֹסְדוֹת הַשָּׁמַיִם יִרְגָּזוּ וַיִּתְגָּעֲשׁוּ כִּי־חָרָה לוֹ׃
verses.english: The earth did quake and shake,the foundations of the heavens shuddered,they quaked, because he was agitated;

verses.hebrew: עָלָה עָשָׁן בְּאַפּוֹ וְאֵשׁ מִפִּיו תֹּאכֵל גֶּחָלִים בָּעֲרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: smoke arose from his nostrils;fire from his mouth, devouring,coals burned forth from him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּט שָׁמַיִם וַיֵּרַד וַעֲרָפֶל תַּחַת רַגְלָיו׃
verses.english: He spread the heavens and came down,a heavy-cloud beneath his feet,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְכַּב עַל־כְּרוּב וַיָּעֹף וַיֵּרָא עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רוּחַ׃
verses.english: he mounted a winged-sphinx and flew,he darted for va-yera. upon the wings of the wind.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָיו סֻכּוֹת חַשְׁרַת־מַיִם עָבֵי שְׁחָקִים׃
verses.english: He set darkness all around him as his hut,the [heavenly] sieve of water, in masses of clouds;

verses.hebrew: מִנֹּגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ בָּעֲרוּ גַּחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ׃
verses.english: from the brightness in front of himburned forth coals of fire.

verses.hebrew: יַרְעֵם מִן־שָׁמַיִם יְהוָה וְעֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּן קוֹלוֹ׃
verses.english: He thundered from the heavens, did YHWH,the Most-High gave forth his voice.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִצִּים וַיְפִיצֵם בָּרָק ויהמם [וַיָּהֹם׃]
verses.english: He sent forth arrows and scattered them,lightning and he panicked them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָאוּ אֲפִקֵי יָם יִגָּלוּ מֹסְדוֹת תֵּבֵל בְּגַעֲרַת יְהוָה מִנִּשְׁמַת רוּחַ אַפּוֹ׃
verses.english: Then appeared the sources of the sea,revealed, the foundations of the earth,at your rebuke, O YHWH,at the breath of his nostrils’ rush.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח מִמָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵנִי יַמְשֵׁנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים׃
verses.english: He stretched out [his hand] from on high and took me,he drew me out of mighty waters.

verses.hebrew: יַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבִי עָז מִשֹּׂנְאַי כִּי אָמְצוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: He rescued me from my enemies so fierce,from those hating me, for they were mightier than I.

verses.hebrew: יְקַדְּמֻנִי בְּיוֹם אֵידִי וַיְהִי יְהוָה מִשְׁעָן לִי׃
verses.english: They confronted me on the day of my calamity,but YHWH became support for me.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּצֵא לַמֶּרְחָב אֹתִי יְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי־חָפֵץ בִּי׃
verses.english: He brought me out to a wide-place,he saved me because he was pleased with me.

verses.hebrew: יִגְמְלֵנִי יְהוָה כְּצִדְקָתִי כְּבֹר יָדַי יָשִׁיב לִי׃
verses.english: YHWH rewarded me according to my righteousness,according to the purity of my hands, he paid me back.

verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁמַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵי יְהוָה וְלֹא רָשַׁעְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָי׃
verses.english: For I have kept the ways of YHWH,and have done no wrong in the presence of my God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כָל־משפטו [מִשְׁפָּטָיו] לְנֶגְדִּי וְחֻקֹּתָיו לֹא־אָסוּר מִמֶּנָּה׃
verses.english: For all his regulations are before me,his laws I have not turned aside from me;

verses.hebrew: וָאֶהְיֶה תָמִים לוֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמְּרָה מֵעֲוֺנִי׃
verses.english: I have been wholehearted with him,I have kept myself from iniquity.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב יְהוָה לִי כְּצִדְקָתִי כְּבֹרִי לְנֶגֶד עֵינָיו׃
verses.english: YHWH has paid me back according to my innocence,according to my purity before his eyes.

verses.hebrew: עִם־חָסִיד תִּתְחַסָּד עִם־גִּבּוֹר תָּמִים תִּתַּמָּם׃
verses.english: With the loyal ones you are loyal,with the wholehearted mighty-man you are whole,

verses.hebrew: עִם־נָבָר תִּתָּבָר וְעִם־עִקֵּשׁ תִּתַּפָּל׃
verses.english: with the pure one you are pure,but with the crooked you are devious.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עַם עָנִי תּוֹשִׁיעַ וְעֵינֶיךָ עַל־רָמִים תַּשְׁפִּיל׃
verses.english: An afflicted people you will deliver,but the haughty-eyed you will bring low.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה נֵירִי יְהוָה וַיהוָה יַגִּיהַּ חָשְׁכִּי׃
verses.english: Yes, you are my lamp, O YHWH,my God brightens my darkness.

verses.hebrew: כִּי בְכָה אָרוּץ גְּדוּד בֵּאלֹהַי אֲדַלֶּג־שׁוּר׃
verses.english: Yes, with you I assault a troop,with my God I can leap over a wall.

verses.hebrew: הָאֵל תָּמִים דַּרְכּוֹ אִמְרַת יְהוָה צְרוּפָה מָגֵן הוּא לְכֹל הַחֹסִים בּוֹ׃
verses.english: This God, whole is his way,the word of YHWH is tested,a shield is he for all who take refuge in him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִי־אֵל מִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהוָה וּמִי צוּר מִבַּלְעֲדֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: For who is God besides YHWH?Who is a rock besides our God?

verses.hebrew: הָאֵל מָעוּזִּי חָיִל וַיַּתֵּר תָּמִים דרכו [דַּרְכִּי׃]
verses.english: God encompasses me with might,he makes, from Ps. 18:33 and LXX, as opposed to MT’s va-yatteir. wholeness his way.

verses.hebrew: מְשַׁוֶּה רגליו [רַגְלַי] כָּאַיָּלוֹת וְעַל בָּמוֹתַי יַעֲמִדֵנִי׃
verses.english: He sets my feet like [those of] deer,on my heights he makes me stand.

verses.hebrew: מְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַמִּלְחָמָה וְנִחַת קֶשֶׁת־נְחוּשָׁה זְרֹעֹתָי׃
verses.english: Training my hands for battle,my arms to stretch a bow of bronze.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּתֶּן־לִי מָגֵן יִשְׁעֶךָ וַעֲנֹתְךָ תַּרְבֵּנִי׃
verses.english: You have given me your shield of deliverance,your battle-cry; some emend, following 4QSamᵃ, to 'ezratekha, "your help.” makes-me-many.

verses.hebrew: תַּרְחִיב צַעֲדִי תַּחְתֵּנִי וְלֹא מָעֲדוּ קַרְסֻלָּי׃
verses.english: You have widened my steps under me,my ankles do not slip.

verses.hebrew: אֶרְדְּפָה אֹיְבַי וָאַשְׁמִידֵם וְלֹא אָשׁוּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָם׃
verses.english: I pursue my enemies, I destroy them,I do not turn back until they are finished.

verses.hebrew: וָאֲכַלֵּם וָאֶמְחָצֵם וְלֹא יְקוּמוּן וַיִּפְּלוּ תַּחַת רַגְלָי׃
verses.english: I batter them and shatter them,. so that they rise no more,they fall beneath my feet.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּזְרֵנִי חַיִל לַמִּלְחָמָה תַּכְרִיעַ קָמַי תַּחְתֵּנִי׃
verses.english: You have armed me with might for battle,bowed my adversaries beneath me.

verses.hebrew: וְאֹיְבַי תַּתָּה לִּי עֹרֶף מְשַׂנְאַי וָאַצְמִיתֵם׃
verses.english: As for my enemies, you have given me their necks,those hating me—I annihilate them.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁעוּ וְאֵין מֹשִׁיעַ אֶל־יְהוָה וְלֹא עָנָם׃
verses.english: They cried-for-help, but there was no deliverer,to YHWH, but he did not answer them.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶשְׁחָקֵם כַּעֲפַר־אָרֶץ כְּטִיט־חוּצוֹת אֲדִקֵּם אֶרְקָעֵם׃
verses.english: I crush-them-fine like the dust of the ground,like the dirt of the streets I pulverize them, I pound them!.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּפַלְּטֵנִי מֵרִיבֵי עַמִּי תִּשְׁמְרֵנִי לְרֹאשׁ גּוֹיִם עַם לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי יַעַבְדֻנִי׃
verses.english: You have saved me from my people’s strife,you have guarded me as the head of nations;a people unknown to me serves me,

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי נֵכָר יִתְכַּחֲשׁוּ־לִי לִשְׁמוֹעַ אֹזֶן יִשָּׁמְעוּ לִי׃
verses.english: foreigners come-fawning to me,hearing by the ear, they hearken to me.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי נֵכָר יִבֹּלוּ וְיַחְגְּרוּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֹתָם׃
verses.english: Foreigners crumble,they emerge from their enclosures.

verses.hebrew: חַי־יְהוָה וּבָרוּךְ צוּרִי וְיָרֻם אֱלֹהֵי צוּר יִשְׁעִי׃
verses.english: By the life of YHWH, blessed is my rock,exalted is my God, the rock of my deliverance;

verses.hebrew: הָאֵל הַנֹּתֵן נְקָמֹת לִי וּמוֹרִיד עַמִּים תַּחְתֵּנִי׃
verses.english: the God giving me vengeance,bringing down peoples under me,

verses.hebrew: וּמוֹצִיאִי מֵאֹיְבָי וּמִקָּמַי תְּרוֹמְמֵנִי מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תַּצִּילֵנִי׃
verses.english: taking me out from my enemies.Over my adversaries you have exalted me,from the man of violence you have rescued me.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן אוֹדְךָ יְהוָה בַּגּוֹיִם וּלְשִׁמְךָ אֲזַמֵּר׃
verses.english: Therefore I praise you, O YHWH, among the nations,and to your name I sing-melodies,

verses.hebrew: מגדיל [מִגְדּוֹל] יְשׁוּעוֹת מַלְכּוֹ וְעֹשֶׂה־חֶסֶד לִמְשִׁיחוֹ לְדָוִד וּלְזַרְעוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: [the One] who magnifies, following the written text (ketiv) of MT and Ps. 18:51. the victories of his king,[the One] who shows loyalty to his anointed one,to David and to his seed,for the ages!

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה דִּבְרֵי דָוִד הָאַחֲרֹנִים נְאֻם דָּוִד בֶּן־יִשַׁי וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר הֻקַם עָל מְשִׁיחַ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב וּנְעִים זְמִרוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now these are David’s last words:Utterance of David the son of Yishai,utterance of one on high raised up,anointed one of Yaakov’s God,favored one of Israel’s Strength (here in the plural) as in Exod. 15:2. Others, famously, “the sweet singer of Israel.”:

verses.hebrew: רוּחַ יְהוָה דִּבֶּר־בִּי וּמִלָּתוֹ עַל־לְשׁוֹנִי׃
verses.english: the spirit of YHWH speaks through me,his discourse is on my tongue.

verses.hebrew: אָמַר אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִי דִבֶּר צוּר יִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשֵׁל בָּאָדָם צַדִּיק מוֹשֵׁל יִרְאַת אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: The God of Israel talks,to me the Rock of Israel speaks:A ruler over humans, a righteous one,a ruler with the awe of God,

verses.hebrew: וּכְאוֹר בֹּקֶר יִזְרַח־שָׁמֶשׁ בֹּקֶר לֹא עָבוֹת מִנֹּגַהּ מִמָּטָר דֶּשֶׁא מֵאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: is like the light of daybreak as the sun rises,a daybreak without clouds,by dint of brightness, by dint of rain,the herbage of the earth.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־לֹא־כֵן בֵּיתִי עִם־אֵל כִּי בְרִית עוֹלָם שָׂם לִי עֲרוּכָה בַכֹּל וּשְׁמֻרָה כִּי־כָל־יִשְׁעִי וְכָל־חֵפֶץ כִּי־לֹא יַצְמִיחַ׃
verses.english: —Yes, is not so my house before God?For he has made me a covenant for the ages,arranged in all and guarded!Yes, all my deliverance, all my desire,yes, will he not cause it to sprout?

verses.hebrew: וּבְלִיַּעַל כְּקוֹץ מֻנָד כֻּלָּהַם כִּי־לֹא בְיָד יִקָּחוּ׃
verses.english: But base ones:like a thorn tossed away are all of them,for not by [one’s] hand [alone] can they be taken up;

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ יִגַּע בָּהֶם יִמָּלֵא בַרְזֶל וְעֵץ חֲנִית וּבָאֵשׁ שָׂרוֹף יִשָּׂרְפוּ בַּשָּׁבֶת׃
verses.english: the man who touches them must fill [his hand] with iron or the shaft of a spear,but with fire they will burn, yes, burn where [they] stay!

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הַגִּבֹּרִים אֲשֶׁר לְדָוִד יֹשֵׁב בַּשֶּׁבֶת תַּחְכְּמֹנִי רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁלִשִׁי הוּא עֲדִינוֹ העצנו [הָעֶצְנִי] עַל־שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת חָלָל בְּפַעַם אחד [אֶחָת׃]
verses.english: These are the names of the mighty-men belonging to David:Yashav’am the Tahkemonite, head of the Three;he swung his ax over eight hundred slain at one time.

verses.hebrew: ואחרו [וְאַחֲרָיו] אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־דדי [דֹּדוֹ] בֶּן־אֲחֹחִי בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה גברים [הַגִּבֹּרִים] עִם־דָּוִד בְּחָרְפָם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ־שָׁם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיַּעֲלוּ אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now after him was El’azar son of Dodo son of Ahohi—among the three mighty-men with David when they made-mockery of the Philistines gathered there for battle,and the men of Israel went up.

verses.hebrew: הוּא קָם וַיַּךְ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים עַד כִּי־יָגְעָה יָדוֹ וַתִּדְבַּק יָדוֹ אֶל־הַחֶרֶב וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוָה תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְהָעָם יָשֻׁבוּ אַחֲרָיו אַךְ־לְפַשֵּׁט׃
verses.english: He arose and struck down the Philistines, until his hand became weary,so that his hand stuck to the sword.And YHWH wrought a great victory on that day:the fighting-people returned after him only to strip [the slain].

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרָיו שַׁמָּא בֶן־אָגֵא הָרָרִי וַיֵּאָסְפוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים לַחַיָּה וַתְּהִי־שָׁם חֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה מְלֵאָה עֲדָשִׁים וְהָעָם נָס מִפְּנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: Now after him was Shamma son of Agei the Hararite;[once,] the Philistines gathered at Lehi,and there was a plot of open-field there full of lentils,and when the people fled before the Philistines,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְיַצֵּב בְּתוֹךְ־הַחֶלְקָה וַיַּצִּילֶהָ וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוָה תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה׃
verses.english: he took a stand amid the plot and rescued it, and struck down the Philistines.Thus YHWH wrought a great victory.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ שלשים [שְׁלֹשָׁה] מֵהַשְּׁלֹשִׁים רֹאשׁ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־קָצִיר אֶל־דָּוִד אֶל־מְעָרַת עֲדֻלָּם וְחַיַּת פְּלִשְׁתִּים חֹנָה בְּעֵמֶק רְפָאִים׃
verses.english: [Once,] three of the Thirty chiefs went down, and they came at harvest-time to David at the Cave of Adullam,while a troop of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of the Shades.

verses.hebrew: וְדָוִד אָז בַּמְּצוּדָה וּמַצַּב פְּלִשְׁתִּים אָז בֵּית לָחֶם׃
verses.english: Now David was then at the fortress,while a garrison of Philistines was then at Bet-Lehem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְאַוֶּה דָוִד וַיֹּאמַר מִי יַשְׁקֵנִי מַיִם מִבֹּאר בֵּית־לֶחֶם אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׁעַר׃
verses.english: And David had a craving, he said:Who will give me water to drink from the cistern of Bet-Lehem that is at the gate?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְקְעוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִים בְּמַחֲנֵה פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּשְׁאֲבוּ־מַיִם מִבֹּאר בֵּית־לֶחֶם אֲשֶׁר בַּשַּׁעַר וַיִּשְׂאוּ וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל־דָּוִד וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁתּוֹתָם וַיַּסֵּךְ אֹתָם לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: The three mighty-men broke through into the camp of the Philistinesand drew water from the cistern of Bet-Lehem that is at the gate,and carried it away and brought it to David.But he would not drink it—he poured it out to YHWH

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חָלִילָה לִּי יְהוָה מֵעֲשֹׂתִי זֹאת הֲדַם הָאֲנָשִׁים הַהֹלְכִים בְּנַפְשׁוֹתָם וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁתּוֹתָם אֵלֶּה עָשׂוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִים׃
verses.english: and said:[Heaven] forbid for me, by YHWH, doing this;is it the blood of men who were going forth [at risk] of their lives?!And he would not drink it.These [deeds] did the three mighty-men do.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִישַׁי אֲחִי יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה הוּא רֹאשׁ השלשי [הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה] וְהוּא עוֹרֵר אֶת־חֲנִיתוֹ עַל־שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת חָלָל וְלוֹ־שֵׁם בַּשְּׁלֹשָׁה׃
verses.english: Now Avishai brother of Yoav son of Tzeruya was the head of the Thirty—he swung his spear over three hundred slain,and so he had a name among the Thirty.

verses.hebrew: מִן־הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה הֲכִי נִכְבָּד וַיְהִי לָהֶם לְשָׂר וְעַד־הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה לֹא־בָא׃
verses.english: Among the Thirty he was honored, so that he became a commander for them,but to the [status of the] Three he did not come.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע בֶּן־אִישׁ־חי [חַיִל] רַב־פְּעָלִים מִקַּבְצְאֵל הוּא הִכָּה אֵת שְׁנֵי אֲרִאֵל מוֹאָב וְהוּא יָרַד וְהִכָּה אֶת־האריה [הָאֲרִי] בְּתוֹךְ הַבֹּאר בְּיוֹם הַשָּׁלֶג׃
verses.english: Now Benayahu son of Yehoyada, the son of a valiant man, was abundant in valiant-deeds, from Kavtze’el;it was he [who] struck down the two [sons of] Ariel of Moav.And he went down and struck a lion in the midst of a cistern, on a day of snow.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא־הִכָּה אֶת־אִישׁ מִצְרִי אשר [אִישׁ] מַרְאֶה וּבְיַד הַמִּצְרִי חֲנִית וַיֵּרֶד אֵלָיו בַּשָּׁבֶט וַיִּגְזֹל אֶת־הַחֲנִית מִיַּד הַמִּצְרִי וַיַּהַרְגֵהוּ בַּחֲנִיתוֹ׃
verses.english: It was he [who] struck an Egyptian man, a man of [giant] appearance,—now in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear,

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה עָשָׂה בְּנָיָהוּ בֶּן־יְהוֹיָדָע וְלוֹ־שֵׁם בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה הַגִּבֹּרִים׃
verses.english: These [things] did Benayahu son of Yehoyada;he had a name among the Thirty mighty-men.

verses.hebrew: מִן־הַשְּׁלֹשִׁים נִכְבָּד וְאֶל־הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה לֹא־בָא וַיְשִׂמֵהוּ דָוִד אֶל־מִשְׁמַעְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: Among the Thirty he was honored,but to the [status of the] Three he did not come.And David put him over his bodyguard.

verses.hebrew: עֲשָׂה־אֵל אֲחִי־יוֹאָב בַּשְּׁלֹשִׁים אֶלְחָנָן בֶּן־דֹּדוֹ בֵּית לָחֶם׃
verses.english: Asa’el brother of Yoav was among the Thirty,[with] Elhanan son of Dodo of Bet-Lehem,

verses.hebrew: שַׁמָּה הַחֲרֹדִי אֱלִיקָא הַחֲרֹדִי׃
verses.english: Shamma the Harodite,Elika the Harodite,

verses.hebrew: חֶלֶץ הַפַּלְטִי עִירָא בֶן־עִקֵּשׁ הַתְּקוֹעִי׃
verses.english: Heletz the Paltite,Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

verses.hebrew: אֲבִיעֶזֶר הָעַנְּתֹתִי מְבֻנַּי הַחֻשָׁתִי׃
verses.english: Avi’ezer the Annatotite,Mevunnai the Hushatite,

verses.hebrew: צַלְמוֹן הָאֲחֹחִי מַהְרַי הַנְּטֹפָתִי׃
verses.english: Tzalmon the Ahohite,Mah’rai the Netofatite,

verses.hebrew: חֵלֶב בֶּן־בַּעֲנָה הַנְּטֹפָתִי אִתַּי בֶּן־רִיבַי מִגִּבְעַת בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן׃
verses.english: Helev son of Baana the Netofatite,Ittai son of Rivai from Giv’a of the Children of Binyamin,

verses.hebrew: בְּנָיָהוּ פִּרְעָתֹנִי הִדַּי מִנַּחֲלֵי גָעַשׁ׃
verses.english: Benayahu [the] Pir’atonite,Hiddai from the wadis of Gaash,

verses.hebrew: אֲבִי־עַלְבוֹן הָעַרְבָתִי עַזְמָוֶת הַבַּרְחֻמִי׃
verses.english: Avi-Almon the Arvatite,Azmavet the Barhumite,

verses.hebrew: אֶלְיַחְבָּא הַשַּׁעַלְבֹנִי בְּנֵי יָשֵׁן יְהוֹנָתָן׃
verses.english: Elyahba the Shaalvonite,the sons of Yashen, Yehonatan,

verses.hebrew: שַׁמָּה הַהֲרָרִי אֲחִיאָם בֶּן־שָׁרָר הָארָרִי׃
verses.english: Ahi’am son of Sharar the Ararite,

verses.hebrew: אֱלִיפֶלֶט בֶּן־אֲחַסְבַּי בֶּן־הַמַּעֲכָתִי אֱלִיעָם בֶּן־אֲחִיתֹפֶל הַגִּלֹנִי׃
verses.english: Elifelet son of Ahasbai the Bet-Maakhatite,Eli’am son of Ahitofel the Gilonite,

verses.hebrew: חצרו [חֶצְרַי] הַכַּרְמְלִי פַּעֲרַי הָאַרְבִּי׃
verses.english: Hetzrai the Carmelite,Paarai the Arbite,

verses.hebrew: יִגְאָל בֶּן־נָתָן מִצֹּבָה בָּנִי הַגָּדִי׃
verses.english: Yig’al son of Natan of Tzova,Bani the Gadite,

verses.hebrew: צֶלֶק הָעַמֹּנִי נַחְרַי הַבְּאֵרֹתִי נשאי [נֹשֵׂא] כְּלֵי יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרֻיָה׃
verses.english: Tzeleg the Ammonite,Nah’rai the Be’erotite, weapons bearer of Yoav son of Tzeruya,

verses.hebrew: עִירָא הַיִּתְרִי גָּרֵב הַיִּתְרִי׃
verses.english: Ira the Yitrite,Garev the Yitrite,

verses.hebrew: אוּרִיָּה הַחִתִּי כֹּל שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁבְעָה׃
verses.english: Uriyya the Hittite—altogether, thirty-seven.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף אַף־יְהוָה לַחֲרוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּסֶת אֶת־דָּוִד בָּהֶם לֵאמֹר לֵךְ מְנֵה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Once again YHWH’s anger flared up against Israel,and he incited David against them, saying:Go, take-a-census of Israel and Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יוֹאָב שַׂר־הַחַיִל אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ שׁוּט־נָא בְּכָל־שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע וּפִקְדוּ אֶת־הָעָם וְיָדַעְתִּי אֵת מִסְפַּר הָעָם׃
verses.english: So the king said to Yoav, commander of the army that was with him:Now roam throughout all the tribes of Israel, from Dan to Be’er-Sheva,and count the fighting-people,that I may know the number of the people.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיוֹסֵף יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶל־הָעָם כָּהֵם וְכָהֵם מֵאָה פְעָמִים וְעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ רֹאוֹת וַאדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ לָמָּה חָפֵץ בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Yoav said to the king:May YHWH your God add to the people, as [many as] they are, as [many as] they are, a hundredfold!My lord king’s eyes can see it;so my lord king—why does he desire this thing?

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחֱזַק דְּבַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־יוֹאָב וְעַל שָׂרֵי הֶחָיִל וַיֵּצֵא יוֹאָב וְשָׂרֵי הַחַיִל לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לִפְקֹד אֶת־הָעָם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: But the king’s word overpowered Yoav and the commanders of the fighting-forces,so Yoav and the commanders of the forces went out from the king’s presence to count the people, Israel;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיַּחֲנוּ בַעֲרוֹעֵר יְמִין הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּחַל הַגָּד וְאֶל־יַעְזֵר׃
verses.english: they crossed the Jordan and encamped in Aro’er, to the right/south of the town that is in the midst of the Wadi of Gad, toward Ya’zer,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַגִּלְעָדָה וְאֶל־אֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּים חָדְשִׁי וַיָּבֹאוּ דָּנָה יַּעַן וְסָבִיב אֶל־צִידוֹן׃
verses.english: then they came to Gil’ad and to the region of Tahtim-Hodshi,then they came to Dan-Yaan and around to Sidon,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ מִבְצַר־צֹר וְכָל־עָרֵי הַחִוִּי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי וַיֵּצְאוּ אֶל־נֶגֶב יְהוּדָה בְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃
verses.english: then they came to the fortress of Tyre and all the Hivvite and Canaanite towns,and [finally] went out into the Negev of Judah, [toward] Be’er-Sheva.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁטוּ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּבֹאוּ מִקְצֵה תִשְׁעָה חֳדָשִׁים וְעֶשְׂרִים יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: They roamed throughout the entire landand came back at the end of nine months and twenty days to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יוֹאָב אֶת־מִסְפַּר מִפְקַד־הָעָם אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתְּהִי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ־חַיִל שֹׁלֵף חֶרֶב וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה חֲמֵשׁ־מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃
verses.english: Yoav gave the number of the people thus-accounted to the king,and Israel was: eight hundred thousand mighty-men of valor, drawing the sword,and the men of Judah: five hundred thousand men.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ לֵב־דָּוִד אֹתוֹ אַחֲרֵי־כֵן סָפַר אֶת־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהוָה חָטָאתִי מְאֹד אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי וְעַתָּה יְהוָה הַעֲבֶר־נָא אֶת־עֲוֺן עַבְדְּךָ כִּי נִסְכַּלְתִּי מְאֹד׃
verses.english: But David’s heart struck him after he had numbered the people,and David said to YHWH:I have sinned exceedingly in what I have done!So-now, O YHWH, pray transfer the iniquity of your servant,for I have been exceedingly foolish!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם דָּוִד בַּבֹּקֶר וּדְבַר־יְהוָה הָיָה אֶל־גָּד הַנָּבִיא חֹזֵה דָוִד לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: David arose at daybreak,and the word of YHWH [came] to Gad the prophet, David’s visionary, saying:

verses.hebrew: הָלוֹךְ וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֶל־דָּוִד כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה שָׁלֹשׁ אָנֹכִי נוֹטֵל עָלֶיךָ בְּחַר־לְךָ אַחַת־מֵהֶם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ׃
verses.english: Go, you are to speak to David:Thus says YHWH:I will hold three [things] over you;choose yourself one of them, and I will do it to you.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא־גָד אֶל־דָּוִד וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הֲתָבוֹא לְךָ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים רָעָב בְּאַרְצֶךָ אִם־שְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים נֻסְךָ לִפְנֵי־צָרֶיךָ וְהוּא רֹדְפֶךָ וְאִם־הֱיוֹת שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים דֶּבֶר בְּאַרְצֶךָ עַתָּה דַּע וּרְאֵה מָה־אָשִׁיב שֹׁלְחִי דָּבָר׃
verses.english: Gad came to David and told him;he said to him:Shall there come upon you seven years of famine in your land,or three months of your fleeing before your foe, while he pursues you,or shall there be three days of plague in your land?So-now, know and take-note: what kind of word shall I answer to the one sending me?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־גָּד צַר־לִי מְאֹד נִפְּלָה־נָּא בְיַד־יְהוָה כִּי־רַבִּים רחמו [רַחֲמָיו] וּבְיַד־אָדָם אַל־אֶפֹּלָה׃
verses.english: David said to Gad:I am in exceedingly great distress;now let us fall into YHWH’s hand,for great is his compassion;but into human hands may I never fall!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה דֶּבֶר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל מֵהַבֹּקֶר וְעַד־עֵת מוֹעֵד וַיָּמָת מִן־הָעָם מִדָּן וְעַד־בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע שִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃
verses.english: So YHWH gave forth a plague among Israel, from morning until the appointed-time,and there died of the people, from Dan to Be’er-Sheva,seventy thousand men.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ הַמַּלְאָךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַם לְשַׁחֲתָהּ וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהוָה אֶל־הָרָעָה וַיֹּאמֶר לַמַּלְאָךְ הַמַּשְׁחִית בָּעָם רַב עַתָּה הֶרֶף יָדֶךָ וּמַלְאַךְ יְהוָה הָיָה עִם־גֹּרֶן האורנה [הָאֲרַוְנָה] הַיְבֻסִי׃
verses.english: But when the [divine] messenger stretched forth his hand against Jerusalem, to bring-it-to-ruin,YHWH relented concerning the evil,and he said to the messenger, the one bringing-ruin among the people:Enough now, slacken your hand!Now YHWH’s messenger was beside the threshing-floor of Aravna trad. English “Araunah.” The name is spelled several ways in biblical passages; the confusion stems, according to some, from the fact that it may not be a name at all but a title, meaning “lord” in Hurrian, an ancient Near Eastern language. Aravna has also been thought to have been a priest, further indicating that the Temple Mount may have been a long-standing holy site. the Yevusite.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־יְהוָה בִּרְאֹתוֹ אֶת־הַמַּלְאָךְ הַמַּכֶּה בָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי חָטָאתִי וְאָנֹכִי הֶעֱוֵיתִי וְאֵלֶּה הַצֹּאן מֶה עָשׂוּ תְּהִי נָא יָדְךָ בִּי וּבְבֵית אָבִי׃
verses.english: And David said to YHWH, when he saw the messenger, the one striking down the people,he said:Here, it is I who have sinned,it is I who have done-iniquity,but these sheep, what have they done?Pray let your hand be against me and against my Father’s House!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא־גָד אֶל־דָּוִד בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ עֲלֵה הָקֵם לַיהוָה מִזְבֵּחַ בְּגֹרֶן ארניה [אֲרַוְנָה] הַיְבֻסִי׃
verses.english: Gad came to David on that dayand said to him:Go up, erect an altar to YHWHat the threshing-floor of Aravna the Yevusite.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל דָּוִד כִּדְבַר־גָּד כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה׃
verses.english: So David went up, according to the word of Gad, as YHWH had commanded him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁקֵף אֲרַוְנָה וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־עֲבָדָיו עֹבְרִים עָלָיו וַיֵּצֵא אֲרַוְנָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ אַפָּיו אָרְצָה׃
verses.english: And Aravna looked outand saw the king and his servants crossing over to him;Aravna went out and bowed low to the king, his nostrils to the ground,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲרַוְנָה מַדּוּעַ בָּא אֲדֹנִי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־עַבְדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד לִקְנוֹת מֵעִמְּךָ אֶת־הַגֹּרֶן לִבְנוֹת מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהוָה וְתֵעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה מֵעַל הָעָם׃
verses.english: and Aravna said:For-what-reason does my lord come to his servant?David said:To acquire the threshing-floor from you, to build an altar to YHWH,so that the plague may be restrained from upon the people!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲרַוְנָה אֶל־דָּוִד יִקַּח וְיַעַל אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ הַטּוֹב בעינו [בְּעֵינָיו] רְאֵה הַבָּקָר לָעֹלָה וְהַמֹּרִגִּים וּכְלֵי הַבָּקָר לָעֵצִים׃
verses.english: Aravna said to David:May my lord king take and offer up whatever is good in his eyes!See, an ox is for the offering-upand the sledges and the gear of the oxen are for wood;

verses.hebrew: הַכֹּל נָתַן אֲרַוְנָה הַמֶּלֶךְ לַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲרַוְנָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִרְצֶךָ׃
verses.english: all [this] does Aravna give, O king, to the king!And Aravna said to the king:May YHWH your God show-you-good-will!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־אֲרַוְנָה לֹא כִּי־קָנוֹ אֶקְנֶה מֵאוֹתְךָ בִּמְחִיר וְלֹא אַעֲלֶה לַיהוָה אֱלֹהַי עֹלוֹת חִנָּם וַיִּקֶן דָּוִד אֶת־הַגֹּרֶן וְאֶת־הַבָּקָר בְּכֶסֶף שְׁקָלִים חֲמִשִּׁים׃
verses.english: The king said to Aravna:No,rather I will acquire, acquire it from you at fair-price;I will not offer up to YHWH my God offerings-up [obtained] for nothing!So David acquired the threshing-floor and the ox for silver, fifty weights,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם דָּוִד מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהוָה וַיַּעַל עֹלוֹת וּשְׁלָמִים וַיֵּעָתֵר יְהוָה לָאָרֶץ וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה מֵעַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: and David built there an altar to YHWH;he offered up offerings-up and shalom-offerings-offerings: Foreshadowing the future role of the Jerusalem Temple—obtaining God’s forgiveness and turning away his anger. .And YHWH let-himself-be-entreated for the land,so that the plague was restrained from upon Israel.
